AI.conclusion: 传输成功和接收器持久化并不能保证权限撤销的完成或受保护效果的停止。基于C0-C5的有界结果契约能够有效分类故障，消除误报，确保分布式智能体-工具网关中的权限撤销安全。
AI.translation: 分布式智能体工作流将委派的权限缓存在工具网关中。撤销可能会在发布者提交、传输确认或接收器持久化时被报告，然而这些观察结果都无法确立所有网关是否都执行了更改，或者受保护的效果是否已经停止。我们定义了C0-C5，这是一个跨越发布者提交到效果阻止的有界结果契约，并将其作为针对冻结网关集、调用集和观察窗口的持久化监视器来实现。一个14案例的故障矩阵检查了保守分类、粘性违规、重启持久性和证据不可变性。在其八个语义案例的派生审计中，将C3或C4视为完成分别产生了7个或5个误报；而有界C0-C5裁决则没有产生误报。描述性缩放涵盖了1,024个网关和10,000个效果向量。主要实验使用了维护中的Keycloak 26.7身份服务器，并在两个持久接收器、八个物理智能体-工具网关、文件系统和PostgreSQL效果以及三个可用区中的16个AWS主机上测量了该契约。正常交付和恢复不会提交效果。在接收器选择性未送达的情况下，传输确认和接收器持久化仍然成功，但225个调用中有112个（49.78%）被准入，并且所有112个效果在每个处理块中都得以提交。一个单独配置的执行重复了该结果。OPA/Toxiproxy和一个带有网络化MCP工具的实时三角色LLM工作流在更窄的面上重现了“已持久化但未执行”的边界。最后，一个未经修改的外部MCPMark智能体执行了60个闭环任务臂。正常的C4拒绝了所有31个暴露的屏障后调用且未提交效果；选择性的C3允许了344个调用并在文件系统和PostgreSQL上提交了145个效果。因此，传输成功只是进展的证据，而不是撤销完成的裁决。
AI.summary: 本文研究了分布式智能体-工具网关中的权限撤销问题，指出传统的传输成功并不等于撤销完成。作者提出了C0-C5有界结果契约及持久化监视器，并通过大规模实验和真实工作流验证了其能够准确检测撤销边界并消除误报。
AI.keywords: 权限撤销, 分布式智能体, 工具网关, 有界结果契约, 故障分类
AI.comments: 该论文针对分布式智能体工作流中工具网关的权限撤销难题，提出了C0-C5有界结果契约及可执行监视器。这一研究揭示了“传输成功不等同于撤销完成”的重要边界，对构建更安全的分布式多智能体系统具有重要价值。

title: Handoff Curves: Initial Selection, Later Handoff, and Supervision Targets in Multi-turn LLM Routing
summary: We study how initial model selection, later handoff, and training targets affect success and cost in LLM tasks that span multiple turns. We compare several router architectures using handoff curves, which record task success and cost as the handoff step changes. Our dataset contains 34,204 complete executions of three Qwen models across BFCL, MultiWOZ, and $τ$-retail, providing offline supervision for routing decisions. In our primary comparison, with Qwen3.5 35B-A3B as the starting model, allowing a later handoff does not establish an improvement in utility over initial selection on BFCL or MultiWOZ, and increases cost on BFCL across a range of cost weights. Changing the supervision targets improves router performance on both our dataset and TwinRouterBench. On our dataset, replacing noisy training success curves with monotone fits raises success by 0.2 to 4.1 percentage points at the same cost across the reported operating points. On TwinRouterBench, we construct targets that describe the model capability needed for the remaining work and difficult steps ahead. Compared with training on the benchmark's per-step labels, these targets raise trajectory pass scores by 7.8 percentage points and cost savings by 6.3 percentage points on the full static bank. A live deployment of the router trained with these targets resolves 79 of 100 instances at a router cost of 0.59 US dollars per instance.

AI.title_translation: 多轮大语言模型路由中的初始选择、后续切换和监督目标：切换曲线
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了“切换曲线”来评估多轮大语言模型路由中的初始选择、切换时机和训练目标对任务成功率和成本的影响。研究发现，延迟切换并不总是能提高性能，改变监督目标可以显著提升路由器性能，并且在实际部署中取得了良好的效果。
AI.motivation: 研究多轮大语言模型任务中，初始模型选择、后续切换以及训练目标如何影响任务的成功率和成本。
AI.method: 使用“切换曲线”来记录随着切换步骤变化而变化的成功率和成本，并比较了多种路由器架构。在三个数据集（BFCL、MultiWOZ 和 τ-retail）上进行了 34,204 次完整实验。研究还探索了改变监督目标对路由器性能的影响，并进行了实际部署测试。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5 35B-A3B 模型作为初始模型时，延迟切换并未在 BFCL 或 MultiWOZ 数据集上带来比初始选择更高的效用，反而增加了 BFCL 的成本。将监督目标从嘈杂的训练成功曲线改为单调拟合，在相同成本下，成功率提高了 0.2 至 4.1 个百分点。在 TwinRouterBench 数据集上，使用描述模型能力的新目标，轨迹通过率提高了 7.8 个百分点，成本节约了 6.3 个百分点。实际部署测试中，训练有这些目标的路由器解决了 100 个实例中的 79 个，每个实例的路由器成本为 0.59 美元。
AI.conclusion: 延迟切换并不总是最优策略，改变监督目标是提高多轮大语言模型路由器性能的有效途径。研究提出的新监督目标在多个基准测试和实际部署中都显示出优越性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了初始模型选择、后续切换以及训练目标如何影响多轮大语言模型任务的成功率和成本。我们使用切换曲线（记录随着切换步骤变化而变化的成功率和成本）来比较几种路由器架构。我们的数据集包含在 BFCL、MultiWOZ 和 τ-retail 三个数据集上对三个 Qwen 模型进行的 34,204 次完整执行，为路由决策提供离线监督。在我们的主要比较中，以 Qwen3.5 35B-A3B 作为初始模型，在 BFCL 或 MultiWOZ 数据集上，允许延迟切换并未带来比初始选择更高的效用，并且在 BFCL 上，在一定成本权重范围内，成本有所增加。改变监督目标可以提高我们在我们数据集和 TwinRouterBench 上的路由器性能。在我们数据集上，用单调拟合替换嘈杂的训练成功曲线，在报告的操作点上，以相同的成本将成功率提高了 0.2 至 4.1 个百分点。在 TwinRouterBench 上，我们构建了描述模型为未来剩余工作和困难步骤所需能力的目标。与在基准测试的每步标签上进行训练相比，这些目标将轨迹通过率提高了 7.8 个百分点，并将成本节约了 6.3 个百分点（在完整的静态银行上）。使用这些目标训练的路由器的现场部署，解决了 100 个实例中的 79 个，每个实例的路由器成本为 0.59 美元。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“切换曲线”的方法，用于评估多轮大语言模型路由中初始模型选择、切换时机和训练目标对任务成功率和成本的影响。研究发现，延迟切换并不总能带来性能提升，但改变监督目标可以显著改善路由器性能。通过使用描述模型能力的新监督目标，研究在多个基准测试和实际部署中都取得了显著的成功率提升和成本节约。
AI.keywords: 多轮大语言模型路由, 切换曲线, 监督目标, 模型选择, 成本效益
AI.comments: 该研究引入了“切换曲线”这一新颖的评估工具，为理解和优化多轮大语言模型路由提供了新的视角。研究结果强调了监督目标设计的重要性，并提出了有效的解决方案，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，研究中使用的具体模型和数据集可能限制了其普适性，未来的研究可以考虑更广泛的模型和场景。

title: Large language model-generated patterns for epidemiological modeling: a multi-benchmark evaluation framework
summary: Representing individual-level behavioral heterogeneity is challenging in epidemiological modeling, particularly when empirical behavioral data are sparse. We assess the potential of large language model (LLM)-generated behavioral outputs in addressing this challenge, using hepatitis C virus-related behaviors among people who inject drugs as a case study. Correspondence with epidemiological patterns was evaluated using external benchmarks: literature-informed association directions, correlations from an agent-based model (ABM), and survey associations. Across three LLMs, unconditional directional recovery across 28 retained literature-informed associations was 46-68%, compared with 82-93% agreement when LLMs were directly asked to classify the same associations. Mean absolute differences from ABM and survey correlation patterns were 0.11-0.13 and 0.15-0.18, respectively. Together, these findings show partial alignment between LLM-generated behavioral relationships and epidemiological evidence, despite higher knowledge-probe agreement. More systematic evaluation is needed before incorporating LLM-generated behavioral outputs into epidemiological models that simulate transmission dynamics.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型生成模式用于流行病学建模：一个多基准评估框架
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型生成的行为模式与流行病学证据部分一致，但在整合到模型中之前需要更系统的评估。
AI.motivation: 在流行病学建模中，表示个体层面的行为异质性具有挑战性，尤其是在经验行为数据稀疏的情况下。本文评估大型语言模型（LLM）生成的行为输出解决此问题的潜力。
AI.method: 以注射吸毒者中与丙型肝炎病毒相关的行为作为案例研究。使用外部基准评估与流行病学模式的一致性：文献知情的关联方向、基于代理模型（ABM）的相关性以及调查关联。比较了三个大型语言模型。
AI.result: 在28个文献知情关联中，无条件方向恢复率为46-68%。当直接要求LLM对相同关联进行分类时，一致性为82-93%。与ABM和调查相关模式的平均绝对差异分别为0.11-0.13和0.15-0.18。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，尽管知识探测的一致性更高，但LLM生成的行为关系与流行病学证据之间存在部分一致性。在将LLM生成的行为输出纳入模拟传播动态的流行病学模型之前，需要进行更系统的评估。
AI.translation: 在流行病学建模中，表示个体层面的行为异质性具有挑战性，尤其是在经验行为数据稀疏时。我们评估了大型语言模型（LLM）生成的行为输出在解决这一挑战方面的潜力，以注射吸毒者中与丙型肝炎病毒相关的行为作为案例研究。使用外部基准评估与流行病学模式的一致性：文献知情的关联方向、基于代理模型（ABM）的相关性以及调查关联。在三个大型语言模型中，28个保留的文献知情关联的无条件方向恢复率为46-68%，而当直接要求LLM对相同关联进行分类时，一致性为82-93%。与ABM和调查相关模式的平均绝对差异分别为0.11-0.13和0.15-0.18。总的来说，这些发现表明，尽管知识探测的一致性更高，但LLM生成的行为关系与流行病学证据之间存在部分一致性。在将LLM生成的行为输出纳入模拟传播动态的流行病学模型之前，需要进行更系统的评估。
AI.summary: 本文评估了大型语言模型（LLM）在流行病学建模中生成行为模式的效用，特别关注注射吸毒者中与丙型肝炎病毒相关的行为。面对由于经验数据稀疏导致难以表示个体行为异质性的挑战，该研究使用多基准框架，包括文献知情关联、基于代理模型的相关性和调查数据，来评估LLM的输出。结果表明，LLM生成的行为与流行病学证据之间存在部分一致性，方向恢复率在46-68%之间，相关性差异在0.11-0.18之间。作者得出结论，尽管LLM显示出一定的潜力，但在将其广泛整合到模拟传播动态的流行病学模型之前，需要进行更严格的评估。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 流行病学建模, 行为异质性, 丙型肝炎病毒, 多基准评估
AI.comments: 本文解决了流行病学建模中的一个关键挑战：如何纳入现实的个体层面行为异质性，尤其是在经验数据稀疏的情况下。其创新之处在于探索大型语言模型（LLM）作为生成这些复杂行为模式的潜在来源。采用多基准评估框架（文献、ABM、调查）提供了稳健的评估。发现“部分一致性”突出了LLM在此应用中的潜力和当前局限性，强调在实际部署之前需要进行进一步的系统评估。这项工作有助于理解LLM在自然语言处理之外的科学领域的能力和局限性。

title: AutoSec-RAN: Specification-Grounded LLM Fine-Tuning for Automated Security Analysis of O-RAN
comments: This paper has been accepted in The 14th IEEE Conference on Communications and Network Security (IEEE CNS 2026)
summary: This paper presents AutoSec-RAN, a specification-grounded large language model (LLM) framework for automated security triage of Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) testing. Unlike approaches relying on static rule sets or privileged access to raw packet captures, AutoSec-RAN fine-tunes Mistral-7B-Instruct through two Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) stages over a curated corpus of 69 O-RAN, 3GPP, and adjacent standards documents, then selectively augments inference with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over the same specification index. At inference, the model receives only an investigator-style question and a scenario metadata block, simulating an automated analyst operating without raw packet evidence. AutoSec-RAN is validated on a purpose-built 5G/O-RAN testbed across labeled fronthaul distributed denial of service replay scenarios. A Gemma-4-31B judge LLM scores each candidate's answer on faithfulness, correctness, and actionability relative to a reference authored from full packet capture and log evidence. AutoSec-RAN achieves a mean judge overall score of 0.713 across all 313 evaluation items (0.755 restricted to the five supervised taxonomy classes), clearing the 0.70 reporting threshold, and a blended score of 0.778 (0.808 supervised-only) when cosine similarity over Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI) General Embedding (BGE) is incorporated as a secondary semantic signal. The framework performs strongest on mitigation and threat-model reasoning (with a mean overall of 0.849 and 0.848, respectively) and identifies a measurable gap on the held-out attack-direction class (0.515), a controlled result that exposes a specific training data requirement. These results establish specification-grounded LoRA fine-tuning combined with RAG retrieval as a viable foundation for automated security validation of AI-native O-RAN.
comment: This paper has been accepted in The 14th IEEE Conference on Communications and Network Security (IEEE CNS 2026)

AI.title_translation: 面向O-RAN自动化安全分析的基于规范的LLM微调
AI.tldr: AutoSec-RAN是一个利用LLM微调和RAG来自动化O-RAN安全分析的框架，它不依赖原始数据包，而是基于标准文档进行分析，并在测试中取得了良好的效果。
AI.motivation: 传统的O-RAN安全分析方法依赖于静态规则或原始数据包，存在局限性。本研究旨在开发一种新的自动化安全分析方法，该方法不依赖原始数据包，而是基于O-RAN、3GPP等标准文档进行分析。
AI.method: AutoSec-RAN框架通过两个LoRA阶段，在69份O-RAN、3GPP及相关标准文档上微调Mistral-7B-Instruct模型。推理时，结合检索增强生成（RAG）技术，仅使用调查式问题和场景元数据块进行分析。在5G/O-RAN测试台上，利用Gemma-4-31B模型对分析结果的忠实度、正确性和可操作性进行评分。
AI.result: AutoSec-RAN在313个评估项上的平均 judge overall score 为0.713（在五个监督分类类别中为0.755），超过了0.70的报告阈值。结合BGE余弦相似度后，混合得分为0.778（监督类别中为0.808）。在缓解和威胁模型推理方面表现最佳（平均分别为0.849和0.848），但在攻击方向分类上存在差距（0.515），这表明了训练数据的需求。
AI.conclusion: 基于规范的LoRA微调结合RAG检索，为O-RAN的自动化安全验证提供了一个可行的基础。
AI.translation: 本文提出了AutoSec-RAN，一个用于开放无线接入网（O-RAN）测试的自动化安全分类的基于规范的大型语言模型（LLM）框架。与依赖静态规则集或原始数据包捕获的特权访问的方法不同，AutoSec-RAN通过两个低秩适应（LoRA）阶段，在一个包含69份O-RAN、3GPP及相邻标准文档的精选语料库上微调Mistral-7B-Instruct，然后选择性地通过相同的规范索引上的检索增强生成（RAG）来增强推理。在推理时，模型仅接收调查式问题和场景元数据块，模拟一个在没有原始数据包证据的情况下运行的自动化分析师。AutoSec-RAN在专门构建的5G/O-RAN测试台上，针对标记的 fronthaul 分布式拒绝服务重放场景进行了验证。一个Gemma-4-31B judge LLM根据相对于从完整数据包捕获和日志证据中编写的参考内容，对每个候选答案的忠实度、正确性和可操作性进行评分。AutoSec-RAN在所有313个评估项上的平均 judge overall score 为0.713（在五个监督分类类别中为0.755），超过了0.70的报告阈值，并且当结合北京人工智能研究院（BAAI）通用嵌入（BGE）的余弦相似度作为次要语义信号时，混合得分为0.778（仅监督类别为0.808）。该框架在缓解和威胁模型推理方面表现最强（平均分别为0.849和0.848），并在被排除的攻击方向类别上识别出可衡量的差距（0.515），这是一个受控的结果，暴露了特定的训练数据需求。这些结果确立了基于规范的LoRA微调结合RAG检索作为AI原生O-RAN自动化安全验证的可行基础。
AI.summary: AutoSec-RAN是一个新颖的框架，它利用基于标准文档的LLM微调（LoRA）和检索增强生成（RAG）技术，实现了O-RAN的安全自动化分析，无需原始数据包。该框架在测试中表现出良好的性能，尤其在缓解和威胁模型推理方面，同时也指出了未来在数据覆盖方面的改进方向。
AI.keywords: O-RAN, 安全分析, LLM微调, RAG, 自动化验证
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法，利用LLM和标准文档来自动化O-RAN的安全分析，解决了传统方法依赖原始数据包的局限性。框架设计巧妙，结合了LoRA微调和RAG检索，并在实际测试中取得了有希望的结果。然而，在攻击方向分类上的表现差距提示了在特定领域数据增强方面仍有提升空间。整体而言，该研究为AI驱动的网络安全自动化提供了有价值的见解和实践基础。

title: Dissipative Lagrangian Neural Networks for the Interpretable Modelling of Passive Mechanical Systems
summary: In this paper, we propose the Dissipative Lagrangian Neural Network (dLNN), a continuous-time system identification technique that separately learns the conservative and dissipative dynamics of a mechanical system directly from data. A key contribution is a novel parametrisation of dissipative forces that (i) is structurally constrained to be dissipative, enforcing passivity of the learned model, (ii) cannot absorb conservative mechanics, and (iii) retains sufficient expressivity to represent a broad family of state-dependent damping and regularised friction forces. The model is validated on prediction tasks on two real-world mechanical systems: trajectory prediction of a chaotic double pendulum and inverse-dynamics modelling of a six-degree-of-freedom industrial robot. Across these tasks, the dLNN demonstrates improved predictive performance over existing Lagrangian architectures while remaining competitive with a black-box neural model. The imposed physical structure also improves generalisation to unseen states, with the benefits becoming particularly pronounced when training data is limited. Finally, we introduce a symbolic distillation procedure that extracts closed-form expressions from the learned physical components. Applied to the industrial robot, this produces interpretable symbolic models that retain high predictive accuracy while reducing the computational overhead associated with evaluating neural Lagrangian models.

AI.title_translation: 用于无源机械系统可解释建模的耗散拉格朗日神经网络
AI.tldr: 提出了一种耗散拉格朗日神经网络（dLNN），能从数据中解耦学习保守与耗散动力学并严格保证物理无源性，同时支持符号蒸馏为高效、可解释的闭式模型。
AI.motivation: 针对现有机械系统辨识模型在处理能量耗散和保证系统无源性（passivity）方面存在的结构性不足，旨在建立一种既严格遵循物理耗散定律、具备足够表达力，又兼具外推泛化性与可解释性的连续时间系统辨识模型。
AI.method: 提出耗散拉格朗日神经网络（dLNN），采用连续时间系统辨识方法直接从数据中解耦学习保守动力学与耗散动力学；引入新型耗散力参数化技术，强制保证物理无源性、防止吸收保守力学并具备表达状态相关阻尼与正则化摩擦力的能力；提出符号蒸馏流程以从神经物理组件中提取闭式解析表达式。
AI.result: 在混沌双摆轨迹预测和六自由度工业机器人逆动力学任务中，dLNN 的预测性能优于现有拉格朗日架构，与黑盒模型相当；在小样本及未见状态下展现出更优的泛化能力；通过符号蒸馏提取的解析模型在保持高预测精度的同时，显著降低了计算开销并提升了可解释性。
AI.conclusion: dLNN 成功结合了物理结构先验（无源性与保守/耗散力学解耦）与深度学习的拟合能力，显著提升了泛化性能与小样本学习能力，并通过符号蒸馏实现了高精度、低计算开销且具可解释性的动力学建模。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了耗散拉格朗日神经网络（dLNN），这是一种直接从数据中分别学习机械系统保守动力学和耗散动力学的连续时间系统辨识技术。其核心贡献在于提出了一种新颖的耗散力参数化方法，该方法具有以下特性：(i) 在结构上被约束为耗散性的，从而强制保证所学习模型的无源性；(ii) 不会吸收保守力学成分；(iii) 保留了足够的表达能力，能够表征广泛的状态相关阻尼和正则化摩擦力。该模型在两个真实世界机械系统的预测任务上进行了验证：混沌双摆的轨迹预测和六自由度工业机器人的逆动力学建模。在这些任务中，dLNN 的预测性能优于现有的拉格朗日架构，同时与黑盒神经网络模型相比仍具竞争力。所施加的物理结构还提高了对未见状态的泛化能力，特别是在训练数据有限的情况下，这种优势更加显著。最后，我们引入了一种符号蒸馏流程，从学习到的物理组件中提取闭式解析表达式。将其应用于工业机器人时，该方法生成了兼具高预测精度和可解释性的符号模型，同时降低了评估神经拉格朗日模型所带来的计算开销。
AI.summary: 本文提出了用于无源机械系统辨识的耗散拉格朗日神经网络（dLNN）。该方法通过创新的参数化机制解耦学习保守与耗散动力学，在严格确保模型无源性（耗散性）的同时兼顾强表达力。实验表明 dLNN 在混沌双摆和六轴机器人任务中的预测及小样本泛化性能优于现有物理神经架构；结合符号蒸馏技术，该方法还能提取紧凑的闭式方程，有效降低了计算开销并提升了模型的可解释性。
AI.keywords: 耗散拉格朗日神经网络, 系统辨识, 无源性约束, 逆动力学建模, 符号蒸馏
AI.comments: 该研究在物理导向的动力学系统辨识领域具有重要价值。其核心创新在于巧妙地从网络结构层面将机械系统的保守力与耗散力解耦，既强制满足了系统的无源性（passivity）物理约束，又避免了耗散项错误吸收保守能量动力学的病态问题；此外，结合符号蒸馏提取闭式解析式，成功兼顾了高精度、物理可解释性与实时推理计算效率，对机器人高精度控制具有实用价值。潜在局限在于当前模型主要针对无源/耗散型机械系统，针对强冲击碰撞或复杂外部混合扰动的适应性尚需进一步验证。

title: Representational Difference Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation transfers representational knowledge from a large teacher network to a compact student. Existing relational and contrastive distillation methods treat all samples uniformly, spending equal gradient on well-matched and poorly-matched regions of the representation space alike. We propose Representational Difference Distillation (RDD), which diagnoses where teacher and student representations structurally disagree and concentrates the distillation signal on those regions. RDD uses two asymmetric affinity matrices that capture opposing directions of misalignment: one identifies samples the student incorrectly considers similar, the other identifies teacher relationships the student has yet to learn. These affinities determine which sample pairs the distillation loss aligns and how strongly it corrects each misaligned sample. On CIFAR-100 with resnet32x4 to resnet8x4, RDD reaches 75.58% test accuracy in our runs, on par with CRD (75.45%) and above KD and RKD. We additionally explore curriculum-based and sampling-based variants, finding that weighting the loss is more effective than filtering the data.

AI.tldr: RDD通过识别教师和学生表示之间的结构性分歧，并将蒸馏信号集中在这些区域，从而改进知识蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有的关系和对比蒸馏方法对所有样本一视同仁，未能有效地区分和关注表示空间中匹配良好和匹配不佳的区域。
AI.method: RDD使用两个不对称的亲和力矩阵来捕捉错位的相反方向，一个识别学生错误地认为相似的样本，另一个识别学生尚未学习的教师关系。这些亲和力决定了蒸馏损失对齐哪些样本对以及每个错位样本的纠正强度。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100数据集上，使用resnet32x4到resnet8x4的蒸馏，RDD达到了75.58%的测试准确率，与CRD (75.45%) 相当，优于KD和RKD。此外，基于课程和基于采样的方法被探索，发现加权损失比过滤数据更有效。
AI.conclusion: RDD是一种有效的知识蒸馏方法，它通过关注表示差异来优化蒸馏过程，并在实验中取得了与现有先进方法相当的性能。
AI.translation: 知识蒸馏将大型教师网络的表征知识转移到紧凑的学生网络中。现有的关系和对比蒸馏方法对所有样本一视同仁，对表示空间中匹配良好和匹配不佳的区域投入同等的梯度。我们提出了表示差异蒸馏（RDD），它诊断教师和学生表示在结构上存在分歧的地方，并将蒸馏信号集中在这些区域。RDD使用两个不对称的亲和力矩阵，捕捉错位的相反方向：一个识别学生错误地认为相似的样本，另一个识别学生尚未学习的教师关系。这些亲和力决定了蒸馏损失对齐哪些样本对，以及它对每个错位样本的纠正强度。在CIFAR-100数据集上，使用resnet32x4到resnet8x4的蒸馏，RDD在我们的实验中达到了75.58%的测试准确率，与CRD (75.45%) 相当，优于KD和RKD。我们还探讨了基于课程和基于采样的方法，发现加权损失比过滤数据更有效。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为表示差异蒸馏（RDD）的新型知识蒸馏方法。与现有方法不同，RDD通过识别和关注教师与学生模型表示之间的结构性差异来优化蒸馏过程。它利用不对称的亲和力矩阵来精确定位学生模型错误关联的样本对，并优先处理这些需要改进的区域。实验结果表明，RDD在CIFAR-100数据集上达到了与先进方法相当的准确率，并证明加权损失比数据过滤更能有效提升性能。
AI.keywords: 知识蒸馏, 表示差异, 亲和力矩阵, 深度学习, 模型压缩
AI.comments: 该方法通过关注表示差异来改进知识蒸馏，具有一定的创新性。然而，其计算复杂度和在不同数据集上的泛化能力有待进一步验证。

title: A 4-Qubit Variational Quantum Classifier for Sequence-Specific Classification of DNMT3A and DNMT3B Flanking Methylation Preferences
comments: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI) 2026
summary: DNA methylation is a critical epigenetic modification that regulates gene expression and genome stability, primarily catalyzed by the DNA methyltransferase 3 (DNMT3) family of enzymes. Distinguishing precise sequence-specific flanking preferences between DNMT3A and DNMT3B remains computationally challenging due to the complex and high-dimensional nature of biochemical sequence data. In this study, we propose a novel Quantum Machine Learning (QML) approach to classify DNA methylation preferences, leveraging a Variational Quantum Classifier (VQC). Using experimentally derived deep enzymology data, we constructed a dataset containing 4,096 unique NNNCGNNN motifs. We evaluated a four-qubit VQC using a custom NumPy exact-statevector simulator. The described two-layer circuit contains 24 trainable rotations, eight CNOT gates, and eight input-encoding rotations, totaling 40 gates before measurement. Across five initialization seeds, the revised VQC evaluation achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.661 pm 0.009, where variability denotes sample standard deviation. The held-out test partition is approximately balanced, containing 200 DNMT3A-labeled motifs and 210 DNMT3B-labeled motifs. An always-DNMT3B predictor achieves 51.2% accuracy and a balanced accuracy of 0.500 on this test partition. This proof-of-concept establishes a foundation for utilizing near-term quantum architectures in complex epigenetic classification tasks, paving the way for hybrid quantum-classical pipelines in bioinformatics.
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI) 2026

AI.title_translation: 用于DNMT3A和DNMT3B侧翼甲基化偏好的序列特异性分类的4量子比特变分量子分类器
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新颖的量子机器学习方法，使用4量子比特的变分量子分类器（VQC）来区分DNMT3A和DNMT3B酶的DNA甲基化序列偏好。通过在实验数据上进行训练和测试，该VQC在区分这两种酶的偏好方面取得了一定的效果，证明了近中期量子计算在生物信息学中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 区分DNMT3A和DNMT3B酶的序列特异性甲基化偏好在计算上具有挑战性，因为生化序列数据复杂且维度高。
AI.method: 提出并评估了一个四量子比特的变分量子分类器（VQC），该分类器具有两层电路，包含24个可训练的旋转门、8个CNOT门和8个输入编码旋转门。使用精确状态向量模拟器在包含4096个NNNCGNNN基序的实验数据上进行了评估。
AI.result: 在包含200个DNMT3A标记和210个DNMT3B标记的测试集上，该VQC实现了0.661 ± 0.009的ROC-AUC，优于始终预测DNMT3B的基线模型（准确率为51.2%，平衡准确率为0.500）。
AI.conclusion: 这项概念验证研究为在复杂的表观遗传学分类任务中使用近期量子架构奠定了基础，并为生物信息学中的混合量子经典计算管线开辟了道路。
AI.translation: DNA甲基化是调控基因表达和基因组稳定性的关键表观遗传修饰，主要由DNA甲基转移酶3（DNMT3）家族酶催化。区分DNMT3A和DNMT3B之间精确的序列特异性侧翼偏好，由于生化序列数据的复杂性和高维度特性，在计算上仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的量子机器学习（QML）方法，利用变分量子分类器（VQC）来分类DNA甲基化偏好。我们使用实验衍生的深度酶学数据，构建了一个包含4096个独特NNNCGNNN基序的数据集。我们使用定制的NumPy精确状态向量模拟器评估了一个四量子比特VQC。所描述的两层电路包含24个可训练的旋转门、8个CNOT门和8个输入编码旋转门，总共在测量前有40个门。在五个初始化种子中，改进的VQC评估达到了0.661 ± 0.009的ROC-AUC，其中变异度表示样本标准差。保留的测试分区大致平衡，包含200个DNMT3A标记的基序和210个DNMT3B标记的基序。一个始终预测DNMT3B的预测器在此测试分区上实现了51.2%的准确率和0.500的平衡准确率。这一概念验证为利用近期量子架构处理复杂的表观遗传学分类任务奠定了基础，为生物信息学中的混合量子经典计算管线铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种基于四量子比特变分量子分类器（VQC）的量子机器学习方法，用于解决区分DNMT3A和DNMT3B酶序列特异性甲基化偏好的计算难题。通过在包含4096个NNNCGNNN基序的实验数据集上进行训练和评估，该VQC在测试集上取得了0.661 ± 0.009的ROC-AUC，显示出其作为生物信息学中复杂表观遗传学分类任务的潜力，并为混合量子经典计算方法奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 量子机器学习, 变分量子分类器, DNA甲基化, DNMT3A, DNMT3B
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了将量子计算应用于生物信息学中具有挑战性的序列分类问题的一个有趣的应用。使用VQC区分DNMT3A和DNMT3B的甲基化偏好是一个有前景的方向。然而，报告的ROC-AUC值（0.661）表明该模型仍有很大的改进空间，尤其是在与基线模型相比时。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的量子电路、不同的量子编码方案或更大的数据集来提高分类性能。此外，将量子模型与经典方法相结合以创建混合模型可能是提高实际应用可行性的关键。

title: PAIR: Memory-Efficient and Fast Inference with Reading--Reasoning Fusion
summary: For context-based question answering, using one large model for both evidence extraction and answer reasoning requires substantial memory and computation. Existing approaches trade accuracy for efficiency within a single model only. We propose a multi-model approach for efficient inference: our method, PAIR, employs two differently sized models for evidence extraction and answer reasoning, respectively. A smaller Reader model processes and retains the full context, while a larger Reasoner model sees only the question and generated sequence without directly attending to the context. These capabilities are fused at the logit level: at each token, both Reader and Reasoner produce a prediction, and their logits are combined into one, behaving as a single next-token-prediction model. Fine-tuning further boosts their performance. On HotpotQA, PAIR with a 32B Reasoner retains 96% of that same 32B model's full-context accuracy while using roughly one quarter of its KV memory. At 45.7K-token contexts, PAIR achieves up to 3.2$\times$ higher end-to-end throughput than the full-context 32B model on the same GPU. PAIR also improves the accuracy-memory and accuracy-throughput trade-offs over evaluated token-reduction baselines. Its accuracy-preserving behavior generalizes across Qwen2.5, OLMo-3, and Gemma-3 model families.

AI.title_translation: 成对：通过读写推理融合实现内存高效和快速推理
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为PAIR的多模型方法，通过结合一个小型Reader模型和一个大型Reasoner模型来提高上下文问答的推理效率，同时保持高准确性，并在内存和吞吐量方面表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的上下文问答方法通常使用一个大型模型来处理证据提取和答案推理，这需要大量的内存和计算资源。现有方法为了效率牺牲了准确性。
AI.method: PAIR方法使用两个不同大小的模型：一个小型Reader模型处理并保留全部上下文，一个大型Reasoner模型只关注问题和生成的序列，不直接关注上下文。通过在logit层面融合两个模型的预测，使其行为像一个单一的下一词预测模型。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA数据集上，使用32B Reasoner的PAIR模型保留了同等32B模型96%的完整上下文准确性，同时KV内存使用量仅为四分之一。在45.7K token的上下文长度下，PAIR在同一GPU上的端到端吞吐量比完整上下文的32B模型高出3.2倍。PAIR在准确性-内存和准确性-吞吐量权衡方面优于基线方法，并且在Qwen2.5、OLMo-3和Gemma-3模型系列上表现出准确性保持能力。
AI.conclusion: PAIR方法通过读写推理融合，在保持高准确性的同时，显著提高了上下文问答的推理效率，在内存和吞吐量方面取得了优于现有方法的改进，并具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 对于基于上下文的问答，使用一个大型模型进行证据提取和答案推理都需要大量的内存和计算。现有的方法仅在单个模型内以效率换取准确性。我们提出了一种用于高效推理的多模型方法：我们的方法PAIR采用两个不同大小的模型分别用于证据提取和答案推理。一个较小的Reader模型处理并保留全部上下文，而一个较大的Reasoner模型仅看到问题和生成的序列，而无需直接关注上下文。这些能力在logit层面融合：在每个token处，Reader和Reasoner都产生一个预测，它们的logits被合并成一个，表现得像一个单一的下一词预测模型。微调进一步提高了它们的性能。在HotpotQA上，使用32B Reasoner的PAIR保留了同等32B模型96%的完整上下文准确性，同时使用的KV内存大约为其四分之一。在45.7K token的上下文下，PAIR在同一GPU上的端到端吞吐量比完整上下文的32B模型高出3.2倍。PAIR还在评估的token-reduction基线上改善了准确性-内存和准确性-吞吐量的权衡。其准确性保持行为在Qwen2.5、OLMo-3和Gemma-3模型系列中具有普遍性。
AI.summary: PAIR是一种新颖的多模型方法，通过结合一个小型Reader和一个大型Reasoner模型，并融合它们的预测来解决上下文问答中的内存和计算效率问题。该方法在保持高准确性的同时，显著减少了内存占用并提高了推理速度，在多个模型系列上都表现出色。
AI.keywords: 上下文问答, 推理效率, 多模型方法, 读写推理融合, 内存优化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的多模型方法PAIR，通过巧妙地融合Reader和Reasoner模型，在显著降低内存和计算成本的同时，有效保持了问答任务的准确性。这种方法在处理长上下文和追求高吞吐量方面具有重要意义，并且在不同模型架构上的泛化能力也值得称赞。未来的工作可以进一步探索不同模型组合和融合策略对性能的影响。

title: DelegateGuard: Purpose-Bound Capabilities for Delegated LLM Agent Workflows
summary: \textbf{(Context)} LLM agents increasingly delegate subtasks while holding authority over sensitive data, creating confused-deputy risks: an injected delegate can exfiltrate data, amplify its authority, or act after revocation. Existing leakage benchmarks expose these failures but do not constrain the authority a delegated agent may exercise. \textbf{(Methods)} We present \system, a reference monitor that converts the initiating user's authorization into attenuable capabilities over purpose, labels, operations, sinks, and delegation depth; every data-moving action is mediated outside the LLM, and revocation cascades through the delegation graph. We formalize a trace-level safety invariant and evaluate it with an adaptive within-authority adversary and four baselines, model-action and multi-turn ecological studies, and conformance and scale checks over deterministic traces and 517{,}401 Enron emails. \textbf{(Results)} \system blocks ungranted-sink exfiltration, authority amplification, revocation replay, purpose gaming, and intra-tool label violations, and dominates static allowlists on the revocation and intra-tool cases (10/10). Two open models proposed attacker-goal actions on 42/45 and 44/45 injected traces, all blocked at execution; a 90-run multi-turn study cut leakage from 0.844 to 0.20 with full task completion, at microsecond per-decision overhead. Proposition~1 characterizes exactly where attenuation-based authorization suffices, a boundary we also reproduce empirically across four observable-sink workflows. \textbf{(Conclusion \& Significance)} Purpose-bound runtime authorization gives delegated LLM workflows a model-independent execution boundary and a precise recipe for composing it with declassification and content monitoring on externally observable sinks.

AI.title_translation: 委托卫士：用于委托的大语言模型代理工作流的面向目的的权限
AI.tldr: DelegateGuard是一个参考监视器，通过将用户授权转换为面向目的、标签、操作、接收器和委托深度的可衰减权限来解决LLM代理委托中的混乱副官风险。它在LLM外部调解每个数据移动操作，并能级联撤销。实验证明，DelegateGuard能够阻止数据泄露、权限放大和撤销重放等攻击，并且在实际应用中开销很小，同时保持任务的完整性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型代理在委托子任务时，可能会因注入的代理而面临数据泄露、权限放大或在撤销后继续执行等混乱副官风险。现有的泄露基准测试暴露了这些问题，但未能有效约束委托代理的权限。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为DelegateGuard的参考监视器，它将发起用户的授权转换为可衰减的权限，这些权限绑定到目的、标签、操作、接收器和委托深度。所有数据移动操作都在LLM外部进行调解，并且撤销操作会级联到整个委托图中。通过形式化一个跟踪级别的安全不变式，并使用自适应的权限内对手、四个基线、模型-操作和多轮生态研究，以及在确定性跟踪和517,401封Enron电子邮件上进行的一致性和规模检查来评估其有效性。
AI.result: DelegateGuard成功阻止了未授权接收器的数据泄露、权限放大、撤销重放、目的欺骗和工具内标签违规。在撤销和工具内场景下，其性能优于静态允许列表（10/10）。在注入的跟踪中，攻击者目标的操作被DelegateGuard完全阻止。在多轮研究中，数据泄露率从0.844显著降低到0.20，同时保持了任务的完整性，并且每个决策的开销仅为微秒级别。此外，证明了基于衰减的授权在特定边界内是足够的，并在四个可观察接收器工作流中得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 面向目的的运行时授权为委托的大语言模型工作流提供了一个模型无关的执行边界，并提供了一种精确的方法，将其与解密和内容监控结合，用于外部可观察的接收器。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地委托子任务，同时持有敏感数据的权限，这造成了混乱副官的风险：注入的代理可以窃取数据、放大其权限或在撤销后执行操作。现有的泄露基准测试暴露了这些故障，但并未约束被委托代理可能行使的权限。我们提出了	extsystem，一个参考监视器，它将发起用户的授权转换为可衰减的权限，这些权限涉及目的、标签、操作、接收器和委托深度；每个数据移动操作都在LLM外部进行调解，并且撤销会级联到整个委托图中。我们形式化了一个跟踪级别的安全不变式，并使用自适应的权限内对手和四个基线、模型-操作和多轮生态研究，以及在确定性跟踪和517,401封Enron电子邮件上进行的一致性和规模检查来评估它。 	extsystem阻止了未授权接收器的数据窃取、权限放大、撤销重放、目的欺骗和工具内标签违规，并在撤销和工具内案例中（10/10）优于静态允许列表。两个开放模型在42/45和44/45个注入的跟踪中提出了攻击者目标的操作，所有这些都在执行时被阻止；一项有90次运行的多轮研究将泄露率从0.844降低到0.20，同时完成了全部任务，每个决策的开销仅为微秒级别。命题1精确地描述了衰减式授权在何处足够，我们也在四个可观察接收器工作流中经验性地重现了这一边界。面向目的的运行时授权为委托的LLM工作流提供了一个模型无关的执行边界，并提供了一种精确的组合解密和内容监控在外部可观察接收器上的方法。
AI.summary: DelegateGuard通过引入面向目的的、可衰减的权限来解决LLM代理委托中的安全问题，从而防止数据泄露和权限滥用。该系统在LLM外部强制执行这些权限，并能有效撤销委托。实验结果表明，DelegateGuard在阻止各种攻击方面表现出色，同时保持了任务的完整性并具有很低的开销。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 委托安全, 混乱副官, 权限, DelegateGuard
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为DelegateGuard的新颖方法，用于解决LLM代理委托中的安全漏洞，特别是混乱副官问题。通过将授权转换为面向目的的、可衰减的权限，并在LLM外部进行强制执行，DelegateGuard提供了一个强大的安全边界。其在阻止多种攻击类型方面的有效性以及在实际场景中的低开销，使其成为LLM代理安全领域的重要贡献。然而，该方法的扩展性和在更复杂、动态环境中的性能仍有待进一步研究。

title: Improving the Evaluation of Biomedical Question Answering with Few Human Preference Signals
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are increasingly used for biomedical Question Answering (QA). However, evaluating their effectiveness remains challenging due to the lack of reliable reference resources and the frequent misalignment between automatic evaluation metrics and human judgments. One practical question is how evaluation results should be used to guide development decisions, especially when they correlate weakly with human judgments and may even lead to different conclusions. We explore how to use a small amount of human preference signals to calibrate direct assessment evaluation metrics, and show that calibrated metrics consistently outperform baselines that either treat all metrics equally or rely on a single best metric across multiple datasets.

AI.title_translation: 提高基于少量人类偏好信号的生物医学问答评估效果
AI.tldr: 使用少量人类偏好信号校准评估指标，以改进生物医学问答系统的开发决策。
AI.motivation: 评估生物医学问答（QA）系统的有效性具有挑战性，因为缺乏可靠的参考资源，并且自动评估指标与人类判断之间经常不一致。需要一种方法来指导开发决策，即使评估结果与人类判断的相关性较弱。
AI.method: 利用少量人类偏好信号来校准直接评估指标。
AI.result: 校准后的指标在多个数据集上始终优于基线方法（平均分配所有指标权重或仅依赖单一最佳指标）。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用少量人类偏好信号对直接评估指标进行校准，可以有效提高生物医学问答系统的评估效果，并为开发决策提供更可靠的指导。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统越来越多地用于生物医学问答（QA）。然而，由于缺乏可靠的参考资源以及自动评估指标与人类判断之间频繁不一致，评估其有效性仍然具有挑战性。一个实际的问题是如何利用评估结果来指导开发决策，特别是当它们与人类判断的相关性较弱甚至得出不同结论时。我们探索了如何利用少量人类偏好信号来校准直接评估指标，并表明校准后的指标在多个数据集上始终优于那些将所有指标同等对待或依赖单一最佳指标的基线。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了如何利用少量人类偏好信号来校准直接评估指标，以改进生物医学问答（QA）系统的评估效果。研究发现，校准后的指标能够更有效地指导开发决策，并在一系列基线方法中表现更优。
AI.keywords: 生物医学问答, 检索增强生成, 评估指标, 人类偏好信号, 校准
AI.comments: 该研究解决了生物医学问答评估中的一个关键问题，即自动指标与人类判断不一致的情况。通过引入少量人类偏好信号来校准指标，为开发决策提供了更可靠的依据。该方法具有实际应用价值，但需要进一步研究其在更大规模和更多样化数据集上的普适性。

title: Meaningful Moments: A Corpus of VLM-Derived Temporal Importance Labels for Video Action Recognition
comments: 10 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to WACV 2027. Supplementary material included
summary: Not every moment in a video is equally useful for recognizing an action. A few decisive moments often carry the evidence: the instant an object moves, the peak of a dive, or one object placed on another. Existing video datasets rarely provide large-scale, action-conditioned labels for which short segments carry that evidence. This work asks whether vision-language models can identify meaningful moments at scale and whether those labels improve action recognition.We introduce Meaningful Moments (MM), a corpus of about 4.58 million VLM-generated per-segment importance scores for nearly 500,000 class-labeled videos spanning Something-Something v2 (SSv2), Kinetics-400 (K400), and Diving-48 across 622 action classes. We freeze the action classifier and vary only temporal sampling. An alpha-parameterized comparison of importance-led selection against an importance-inverted control separates gains from the VLM signal from gains caused by variable-density sampling alone. Across all three datasets, VLM-derived importance is informative: at the hard-cut endpoint, keeping VLM-important segments outperforms keeping VLM-designated filler. Usefulness depends on class structure. On Diving-48, importance-led fast-forwarding preserves full-video recognition while the inverted control collapses by roughly 30 percentage points. On K400, hard-cut selection beats uniform sampling by 1.45 percentage points, rising to 2.05 under threshold selection. On SSv2, the labels carry signal but do not recover full-video performance. Direct scoring matches greedy removal within its noise floor at roughly 25 times fewer oracle calls, and a four-VLM cross-oracle study shows consistent downstream trends. We release the importance labels and evaluation protocol under CC-BY-4.0; SSv2 class strings remain under CC-BY-NC-4.0.
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to WACV 2027. Supplementary material included

AI.title_translation: 有意义的时刻：一个包含视频语言模型（VLM）推导的时间重要性标签的语料库，用于视频动作识别
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为“有意义的时刻”（MM）的大规模语料库，其中包含约458万个视频片段的重要性得分，这些得分由视觉语言模型（VLM）生成。研究表明，利用这些VLM生成的重要性标签可以改进视频动作识别，尤其是在某些数据集上，通过选择重要的片段而非均匀采样，可以显著提高识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据集缺乏大规模、针对动作的标签，无法识别出对动作识别至关重要的关键时刻。本研究旨在探索视觉语言模型（VLM）是否能够大规模地识别这些关键时刻，以及这些标签是否能提升动作识别的性能。
AI.method: 研究人员创建了一个名为“有意义的时刻”（MM）的语料库，其中包含约458万个视频片段的重要性得分，这些得分由预先训练好的视觉语言模型（VLM）生成。他们通过比较基于重要性排序的片段选择与随机采样或反向排序的片段选择，来评估VLM标签的有效性。研究中还冻结了动作分类器，只改变时间采样策略，并使用一个带参数的比较来区分VLM信号带来的增益和可变密度采样本身带来的增益。
AI.result: 在SSv2、K400和Diving-48这三个数据集上的实验表明，VLM生成的重要性标签是有信息量的。在Diving-48数据集上，基于重要性排序的选择（快进）在保持完整视频识别率的同时，反向排序的控制组识别率下降了约30个百分点。在K400数据集上，基于重要性排序的硬截断选择比均匀采样提高了1.45个百分点，在阈值选择下甚至提高到2.05个百分点。在SSv2数据集上，标签虽然有信号，但未能恢复完整视频的性能。此外，直接评分方法在效率上优于贪婪移除方法，并且多VLM交叉研究显示了持续的下游趋势。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的时间重要性标签对于视频动作识别是有价值的。通过利用这些标签来指导视频片段的选择，可以在不显著增加计算成本的情况下提高动作识别的准确性，尤其是在动作识别难度较高或动作本身具有明显关键时刻的数据集上。然而，其有效性可能因数据集和动作类型的不同而有所差异。
AI.translation: 并非每个视频中的时刻都对识别动作具有同等价值。少数决定性的时刻往往承载着证据：物体移动的瞬间、跳水动作的最高点，或一个物体被放置在另一个物体上。现有的视频数据集很少提供大规模、针对动作条件的关键性标签，以标识哪些短片段承载着这些证据。本研究旨在探究视觉语言模型（VLM）是否能够大规模地识别出这些有意义的时刻，以及这些标签是否能够提升动作识别的性能。我们提出了“有意义的时刻”（MM）语料库，其中包含约458万个由VLM生成的、针对近50万个带类别标签的视频的逐段重要性得分，这些视频涵盖了Something-Something v2 (SSv2)、Kinetics-400 (K400)和Diving-48数据集，共计622个动作类别。我们冻结动作分类器，仅改变时间采样方式。通过对重要性引导选择与重要性反转控制进行参数化比较，将VLM信号带来的增益与单纯可变密度采样带来的增益分离开来。在所有三个数据集中，VLM导出的重要性信息都是有用的：在硬截断的终点，保留VLM重要的片段优于保留VLM指定的填充片段。其有效性取决于类别的结构。在Diving-48上，重要性引导的快进在保持完整视频识别率的同时，反向控制组的识别率下降了约30个百分点。在K400上，硬截断选择比均匀采样提高了1.45个百分点，在阈值选择下提高到2.05个百分点。在SSv2上，标签带有信号，但未能恢复完整视频的性能。直接评分匹配了在噪声地板下的贪婪移除，其调用次数约少25倍，并且一项包含四个VLM的交叉研究显示了持续的下游趋势。我们根据CC-BY-4.0协议发布了重要性标签和评估协议；SSv2类别字符串仍根据CC-BY-NC-4.0协议发布。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了“有意义的时刻”（MM）语料库，这是一个大规模的、由视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的视频片段重要性标签数据集。研究旨在评估VLM能否有效地识别出对动作识别至关重要的关键时刻，并验证这些标签是否能提升动作识别性能。通过在SSv2、K400和Diving-48等数据集上进行实验，结果表明VLM的重要性标签确实能够提供有用的信息，并在不同程度上提升了动作识别的准确性，尤其是在能够有效利用关键时刻信息的任务上。该研究为利用VLM改进视频理解任务提供了新的途径。
AI.keywords: 视频动作识别, 视觉语言模型, 重要性标签, 关键时刻检测, 视频理解
AI.comments: 这项研究巧妙地利用了视觉语言模型（VLM）来解决视频动作识别中的一个关键挑战：如何识别出对识别任务真正重要的时刻。通过构建“有意义的时刻”（MM）语料库，作者不仅为该领域提供了一个宝贵的资源，而且通过严谨的实验设计，清晰地证明了VLM生成的重要性标签的有效性。研究中提出的通过比较重要性引导选择与反向控制组来分离VLM信号和采样策略本身带来的增益，是一个非常有创意的设计，它使得结论更加可靠。然而，研究也指出了有效性可能依赖于数据集的特性（如类别结构），这提示未来的研究可以进一步探索如何根据不同任务和数据特性来优化重要性标签的应用。此外，虽然研究表明VLM标签在某些数据集上表现出色，但在SSv2上的效果不佳，这可能为进一步的研究提供了方向，例如探究VLM在处理更细粒度或更抽象动作时的局限性。

title: Adversarial Robustness of Camera-Radar Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving (AD) relies on multi-sensor perception to interpret the surrounding environment. However, the robustness of camera--radar fusion under adversarial conditions remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a systematic measurement study of the robustness of camera--radar sensor fusion in AD. We construct a unified evaluation pipeline on the nuScenes dataset that simulates attacks on both sensing modalities, including eight camera-image perturbations and three radar point-cloud perturbations. We evaluate five camera--radar fusion algorithms across two perception tasks, 3D object detection and depth estimation, and quantify their performance under clean and attacked inputs using standard metrics. Our evaluation reveals a clear asymmetry in the robustness of fusion systems. Camera perturbations substantially degrade both object detection and depth estimation, and moderate attack strengths are already sufficient to cause severe performance degradation. In contrast, the evaluated radar perturbations produce smaller and task-dependent effects, with object-detection models showing particularly limited degradation. Our analysis attributes this difference to the strong dependence of existing fusion architectures on dense camera features, together with the filtering, association, and confidence-weighting mechanisms commonly applied to sparse radar measurements. These results demonstrate that sensor fusion does not inherently guarantee robustness and that the contribution and reliability of each sensing modality must be explicitly considered under adversarial conditions. Based on four empirical findings, we derive measurement-guided design implications for future robust camera--radar fusion, including modality-specific reliability estimation, cross-modal consistency checking, adaptive fusion, and graceful failover under severe sensor degradation.

AI.title_translation: 自动驾驶相机-雷达传感器融合的对抗鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了自动驾驶中相机-雷达融合在对抗性攻击下的鲁棒性，发现相机扰动比雷达扰动对模型性能影响更大，并提出了改进融合鲁棒性的设计建议。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶依赖多传感器融合感知，但相机-雷达融合在对抗性条件下的鲁棒性研究不足。
AI.method: 在nuScenes数据集上构建统一评估流程，模拟了相机和雷达的对抗性攻击，并评估了五种相机-雷达融合算法在3D目标检测和深度估计任务上的性能。
AI.result: 相机扰动显著降低了目标检测和深度估计的性能，即使是中等强度的攻击也会导致严重性能下降。雷达扰动的影响较小且依赖于任务，目标检测模型性能下降有限。现有融合架构高度依赖相机特征，并对雷达测量值进行过滤和加权。
AI.conclusion: 传感器融合并不必然保证鲁棒性，在对抗性条件下必须显式考虑各传感器的贡献和可靠性。研究提出了四项经验性发现，并据此提出了针对未来鲁棒相机-雷达融合的设计启示，包括特定模态的可靠性估计、跨模态一致性检查、自适应融合和在严重传感器降级下的优雅失效。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶（AD）依赖多传感器感知来解释周围环境。然而，相机-雷达融合在对抗性条件下的鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文提出了对自动驾驶中相机-雷达传感器融合鲁棒性的系统测量研究。我们在nuScenes数据集上构建了一个统一的评估流程，该流程模拟了对两种传感模式的攻击，包括八种相机图像扰动和三种雷达点云扰动。我们评估了五种相机-雷达融合算法在两个感知任务（3D目标检测和深度估计）上的性能，并使用标准指标量化了它们在干净和受攻击输入下的性能。我们的评估揭示了融合系统鲁棒性的明显不对称性。相机扰动会严重降低目标检测和深度估计的性能，并且中等强度的攻击足以导致严重的性能下降。相比之下，评估的雷达扰动产生的影响较小且依赖于任务，其中目标检测模型的性能下降尤其有限。我们的分析将这种差异归因于现有融合架构对密集相机特征的强烈依赖，以及通常应用于稀疏雷达测量的过滤、关联和置信加权机制。这些结果表明，传感器融合并不天然保证鲁棒性，并且在对抗性条件下必须显式考虑每种传感模式的贡献和可靠性。基于四项经验性发现，我们为未来鲁棒的相机-雷达融合提出了测量驱动的设计启示，包括特定模态的可靠性估计、跨模态一致性检查、自适应融合和在严重传感器降级下的优雅失效。
AI.summary: 本研究系统地评估了自动驾驶领域中相机-雷达传感器融合在对抗性攻击下的鲁棒性。研究人员在nuScenes数据集上构建了一个评估框架，模拟了针对相机图像和雷达点云的多种扰动，并测试了五种主流融合算法在3D目标检测和深度估计任务上的表现。结果显示，相机扰动对模型性能的负面影响远大于雷达扰动，即使是较弱的攻击也可能导致性能急剧下降。研究分析认为，这种差异源于现有融合模型对相机数据的过度依赖以及对雷达数据的预处理方式。最后，研究基于实证发现，提出了四项设计原则，以指导未来开发更鲁棒的相机-雷达融合系统。
AI.keywords: 相机-雷达融合,对抗鲁棒性,自动驾驶,传感器融合,3D目标检测
AI.comments: 这项研究对自动驾驶感知系统的安全性至关重要，揭示了传感器融合并非万能的鲁棒性解决方案。研究方法系统且全面，覆盖了多种攻击和算法。然而，实际应用中的对抗性攻击可能更加复杂多样，未来可以探索更广泛的攻击场景。此外，提出的设计启示为后续研究提供了有价值的方向。

title: Online Batching with Lookahead: Adversarial Limits and Stochastic Gains
summary:
Modern inference systems rely on batching to exploit parallel execution and amortize serial execution overheads, but batching creates a fundamental online scheduling tradeoff: serving requests immediately reduces request queuing delay, while waiting can form larger batches that better utilize parallel hardware and improve serving efficiency. We study this tradeoff in a single-server online batching model with bounded batch capacity, fixed batch processing time, and the objective of minimizing total flow time. Our focus is on the value of finite lookahead into future arrivals over a purely online setting for scheduling.
  We show that the benefits of lookahead depend on the arrival model. In the adversarial setting, finite perfect lookahead has inherent limitations: for any bounded lookahead window, every online algorithm remains separated from the offline optimum by a constant factor. Thus, worst-case arrival sequences can prevent perfect knowledge of future events from fully overcoming online uncertainty. In contrast, under Poisson arrivals in the stable regime, finite lookahead is much more powerful. Although the best distribution-aware online algorithm has a nonzero asymptotic gap from the offline optimum, lookahead closes this gap exponentially fast in the window length. We prove matching upper and lower bounds up to constants in the exponent. Together, these results give a tight characterization of when lookahead can close the online--offline gap, incorporating insights from the competitive analysis of online algorithms into queueing-theoretic steady-state bounds.
  We also study imperfect predictions, showing that the benefit of lookahead degrades gracefully with prediction error. Simulations on synthetic arrivals and experiments on real request traces support the theory: modest lookahead substantially reduces flow time and brings online batching close to the offline benchmark.

AI.title_translation: 在线批处理与前瞻：对抗性极限与随机增益
AI.tldr: 在线批处理通过权衡即时服务和等待以形成更大的批次来优化吞吐量和延迟。在对抗性模型中，有限的前瞻能力受到限制，但对于泊松到达模型，有限的前瞻可以显著缩小与离线最优解的差距，并且这种差距会随着前瞻窗口的增加呈指数级缩小。
AI.motivation: 研究在线批处理模型中，有限的前瞻信息如何影响总流时。
AI.method: 在单服务器在线批处理模型中，考虑有界批容量、固定批处理时间和最小化总流时。分析了在对抗性模型和泊松到达模型下，有限前瞻信息对在线算法性能的影响，并进行了理论证明和仿真实验。
AI.result: 在对抗性模型中，任何有限的前瞻都无法完全消除在线算法与离线最优解之间的常数因子差距。在泊松到达模型下，有限前瞻能够指数级地缩小在线算法与离线最优解之间的差距，并且理论证明和实验结果都支持这一发现。不完美的预测也会导致前瞻收益的平稳下降。
AI.conclusion: 有限前瞻在在线批处理中的收益取决于到达模型。在对抗性模型中，前瞻收益有限；在泊松到达模型中，前瞻收益显著。研究结果为在线批处理的性能提供了精确的表征，并强调了前瞻在缩小在线与离线性能差距中的作用。
AI.translation: 现代推理系统依赖批处理来利用并行执行和分摊串行执行开销，但批处理会产生一个根本性的在线调度权衡：立即处理请求可以减少请求排队延迟，而等待可以形成更大的批次，从而更好地利用并行硬件并提高服务效率。我们研究了一个具有有界批容量、固定批处理时间和最小化总流时目标的单服务器在线批处理模型中的这种权衡。我们关注的是有限前瞻信息（相对于纯粹的在线设置）在未来到达方面的价值。我们表明，前瞻的收益取决于到达模型。在对抗性设置中，有限的完美前瞻具有固有的局限性：对于任何有界的前瞻窗口，每个在线算法与离线最优解之间仍然存在一个常数因子间隔。因此，最坏情况的到达序列可以阻止完美了解未来事件完全克服在线不确定性。相比之下，在稳定状态下的泊松到达模型中，有限的前瞻非常强大。尽管最优的、考虑分布的在线算法与离线最优解之间存在非零的渐近差距，但前瞻能够以窗口长度的指数速度缩小这种差距。我们证明了指数常数内的匹配上下界。总的来说，这些结果精确地表征了前瞻能够缩小在线-离线差距的条件，并将在线算法的竞争性分析纳入了排队论的稳态界限。我们还研究了不完美的预测，表明前瞻的收益随着预测误差的增加而平稳下降。对合成到达和真实请求跟踪的模拟实验支持该理论：适度的前瞻可以显著减少流时，并使在线批处理接近离线基准。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在线批处理中的调度权衡，重点是有限前瞻信息的作用。在对抗性模型下，有限前瞻的收益受到限制，无法完全消除与离线最优解的差距。然而，在泊松到达模型下，有限前瞻能显著缩小这一差距，且差距随前瞻窗口长度呈指数级缩小。研究还表明，预测误差对前瞻收益的影响是渐进的。理论分析和实验结果共同表明，适度的前瞻能够有效提升在线批处理性能。
AI.keywords: 在线批处理, 前瞻, 对抗性模型, 泊松到达, 总流时
AI.comments: 该研究为在线批处理中的前瞻调度问题提供了重要的理论见解，区分了不同到达模型下前瞻的有效性。研究结果具有实际应用价值，尤其是在现代推理系统中优化资源利用和降低延迟方面。然而，模型简化（如单服务器）可能限制其在复杂系统中的直接适用性。

title: Computational Reflective Equilibrium for Agentic AI: A Rawlsian Alignment Scaffold for Governance
summary: The rapid deployment of agentic AI has introduced complex challenges for the ethics and governance of AI systems. Agents built on large language models act through tools on behalf of people, and each deployment case brings its own instructions, policies, evidence, and stakeholders, so alignment must be formed case by case. To this end, this work proposes agentic reflective equilibrium (ARE), a computational reflective equilibrium framework that serves as an ethical alignment scaffold in the agent harness. Drawing inspiration from the reflective equilibrium of John Rawls, the scaffold links principles from the system prompt and operator policy, considered judgments, tool evidence, and candidate actions through typed support and attack relations, with provenance encoding the instruction hierarchy. The agent acts on an equilibrium of this state and calls tools or asks questions only while doing so is worth its cost, unless a due-diligence mandate requires them. Governance enters through value priorities, source authority, prohibitions, human-in-the-loop triggers, and mandates, and certificates attribute each action to the sources whose commitments drove it. We show that equilibria are Nash equilibria of a mutual-adjustment game and establish monotonicity, lexical priority, stability certificates, and a quarantine theorem for prompt injection. Two case studies illustrate the framework: a computer-use assistant told to win a refund "whatever it takes" files an honest warranty claim, refuses a fake review, and ignores an injected request for personal data; a hiring agent showcases how authority, oversight triggers, audit mandates, and hard prohibitions shape discrimination, privacy violations, and escalation. The framework offers traceability, coherence, and adaptivity, facilitating safe, secure, and trustworthy agentic AI.

AI.title_translation: 代理AI的计算反思均衡：一个用于治理的罗尔斯式对齐支架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了代理反思均衡（ARE）框架，一个受罗尔斯反思均衡启发的计算框架，旨在为代理AI提供逐案的伦理对齐支架，以解决其部署带来的复杂挑战，并通过治理机制确保安全、可靠和值得信赖的AI行为。
AI.motivation: 代理AI的快速部署带来了AI系统伦理和治理的复杂挑战。由于基于大型语言模型的代理AI通过工具代表人类行动，并且每个部署案例都有其特定的指令、政策、证据和利益相关者，因此需要逐案形成对齐。
AI.method: 本文提出了代理反思均衡（ARE），一个计算反思均衡框架，作为代理AI中的伦理对齐支架。该支架借鉴了约翰·罗尔斯的反思均衡理论，通过类型化的支持和攻击关系，将系统提示和操作员策略中的原则、经过深思熟虑的判断、工具证据和候选行动联系起来，并用溯源编码指令层级。代理根据这种状态的均衡进行操作，并且只有当调用工具或提问的成本值得时才执行，除非有尽职调查的强制要求。治理通过价值优先级、来源权限、禁令、人工干预触发器和强制要求介入，并且证书将每个行动归因于驱动它的来源。
AI.result: 本文证明了均衡是相互调整博弈的纳什均衡，并建立了单调性、词典优先级、稳定性证书和针对提示注入的隔离定理。通过两个案例研究（一个计算机使用助手和一个招聘代理）展示了该框架如何处理复杂的伦理场景，如诚实索赔、拒绝虚假评论、忽略注入的个人数据请求以及塑造歧视、隐私侵犯和升级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了可追溯性、连贯性和适应性，从而促进了安全、可靠和值得信赖的代理AI。
AI.translation: 代理AI的快速部署给AI系统的伦理和治理带来了复杂的挑战。基于大型语言模型的代理通过工具代表人类行动，每个部署案例都有其自身的指令、政策、证据和利益相关者，因此必须逐案形成对齐。为此，本文提出了代理反思均衡（ARE），一个计算反思均衡框架，作为代理AI中的伦理对齐支架。该支架借鉴了约翰·罗尔斯的反思均衡理论，通过类型化的支持和攻击关系，将系统提示和操作员策略中的原则、经过深思熟虑的判断、工具证据和候选行动联系起来，并用溯源编码指令层级。代理根据这种状态的均衡进行操作，并且只有当调用工具或提问的成本值得时才执行，除非有尽职调查的强制要求。治理通过价值优先级、来源权限、禁令、人工干预触发器和强制要求介入，并且证书将每个行动归因于驱动它的来源。我们证明了均衡是相互调整博弈的纳什均衡，并建立了单调性、词典优先级、稳定性证书和针对提示注入的隔离定理。两个案例研究说明了该框架：一个被告知“不惜一切代价”赢得退款的计算机使用助手，提交了诚实的保修索赔，拒绝了虚假评论，并忽略了注入的个人数据请求；一个招聘代理展示了权限、监督触发器、审计强制要求和严格禁令如何影响歧视、隐私侵犯和升级。该框架提供了可追溯性、连贯性和适应性，从而促进了安全、可靠和值得信赖的代理AI。
AI.summary: 本文提出代理反思均衡（ARE）框架，一个受约翰·罗尔斯反思均衡启发的计算模型，旨在为基于大型语言模型的代理AI提供逐案的伦理对齐支架。该框架通过支持和攻击关系整合了原则、判断、证据和行动，并编码了指令溯源。代理在均衡状态下行动，并通过治理机制（如价值优先级、权限、禁令）进行规制。研究证明了其均衡特性，并建立了单调性、稳定性等性质。案例研究展示了其在处理复杂伦理场景（如退款索赔、招聘歧视）中的有效性，最终目标是实现安全、可靠和值得信赖的代理AI。
AI.keywords: 代理AI, 反思均衡, 伦理对齐, 治理, 纳什均衡
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将罗尔斯的反思均衡理论引入到代理AI的伦理对齐和治理中，提供了一个结构化的计算框架来处理AI在复杂情境下的决策。其强调逐案对齐、治理机制的集成以及对提示注入的鲁棒性，对于构建可信赖的代理AI具有重要意义。通过具体的案例研究，展示了其在解决实际伦理困境方面的潜力，为AI治理提供了一个新颖且实用的视角。

title: Certified Robustness via Sparse Second-Order Cone Relaxations
summary: Certified robustness is critical for deploying neural networks in safety-sensitive settings, but computing exact certificates typically requires solving nonconvex optimization problems. Practical verifiers use convex relaxations: linear programming (LP) relaxations are scalable but often too conservative, whereas semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations can be substantially tighter but are computationally expensive. We introduce a hierarchy of second-order cone programming (SOCP) relaxations that provide stronger certificates than LP while avoiding the cost of global positive-semidefinite constraints. Our construction combines convex-hull relaxations of ReLU activations, selective McCormick lifting over certified variable bounds, and second-order cone constraints induced by 2-by-2 principal minors. Adding these constraints progressively yields a monotone hierarchy of increasingly tight bounds with a controllable computation-tightness trade-off. On fully connected and convolutional networks on MNIST and CIFAR-10, SOCP-based verification improves certified robust accuracy over LP-based verification and is competitive with alpha,beta-CROWN, while remaining orders of magnitude faster than SDP-based verification. These results position selective second-order constraints as a practical middle ground between scalable LP-based and tight SDP-based certification. Finally, we introduce class-optimized robust evaluation (CORE), which applies tighter relaxations only to target classes not certified by cheaper ones. On the fully connected MNIST benchmark, CORE variants match SDP-cert's certified robust accuracy while reducing average verification time by up to 86.30%.

AI.title_translation: 稀疏二阶锥松弛的认证鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的SOCP松弛方法，在保证鲁棒性的同时，提高了计算效率，并结合CORE技术进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 计算精确的认证鲁棒性需要解决非凸优化问题，现有的LP松弛过于保守，SDP松弛计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出了一种分层的SOCP松弛方法，结合了ReLU激活的凸包松弛、选择性的McCormick提升以及二阶锥约束。此外，还提出了CORE技术，优先对未通过低成本认证的目标类别应用更强的松弛。
AI.result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上，SOCP松弛方法比LP松弛方法提高了认证鲁棒准确率，并且性能与alpha,beta-CROWN相当，计算速度比SDP快几个数量级。CORE技术在MNIST数据集上，认证鲁棒准确率与SDP-cert相当，同时验证时间减少了高达86.30%。
AI.conclusion: SOCP松弛提供了一种在可扩展性、紧密度和计算成本之间取得良好平衡的认证方法，而CORE技术进一步提高了效率和性能。
AI.translation: 认证鲁棒性对于在安全敏感环境中部署神经网络至关重要，但计算精确的证书通常需要解决非凸优化问题。实际的验证器使用凸松弛：线性规划（LP）松弛具有可扩展性，但通常过于保守，而半定规划（SDP）松弛可以显著更紧密，但计算成本很高。我们引入了一个二阶锥规划（SOCP）松弛的分层结构，它在避免全局半正定约束的成本的同时，提供了比LP更强的证书。我们的构造结合了ReLU激活的凸包松弛、通过认证变量边界的选择性McCormick提升以及由2x2主子式引起的二阶锥约束。逐步添加这些约束会产生一个单调的、越来越紧密的界层，具有可控的计算-紧密度权衡。在MNIST和CIFAR-10上的全连接和卷积网络上，基于SOCP的验证比基于LP的验证提高了认证鲁棒准确率，并且与alpha,beta-CROWN具有竞争力，同时比基于SDP的验证快几个数量级。这些结果表明，选择性二阶约束是可扩展的基于LP和紧密的基于SDP的认证之间的一种实用的折衷方案。最后，我们引入了类优化鲁棒评估（CORE），它只对未被更便宜的认证方法认证的目标类别应用更强的松弛。在全连接MNIST基准测试中，CORE变体达到了与SDP-cert相当的认证鲁棒准确率，同时平均验证时间减少了高达86.30%。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种新的二阶锥规划（SOCP）松弛方法，用于计算神经网络的认证鲁棒性。该方法通过结合凸包松弛、选择性 McCormick 提升和二阶锥约束，实现了比线性规划（LP）松弛更紧密的界，同时避免了半定规划（SDP）松弛的高昂计算成本。此外，研究还引入了类优化鲁棒评估（CORE）技术，通过优先对未认证的目标类别应用更强的松弛来提高效率。实验结果表明，该SOCP方法在准确性和效率上均优于LP方法，并能与先进方法（如alpha,beta-CROWN）媲美，同时CORE技术显著缩短了验证时间，为在实际应用中部署鲁棒神经网络提供了更优的选择。
AI.keywords: 认证鲁棒性, 二阶锥规划, SOCP松弛, 凸松弛, 类优化鲁棒评估, CORE
AI.comments: 这项工作在神经网络的认证鲁棒性领域取得了重要进展，提供了一种在计算效率和鲁棒性界限紧密度之间取得良好平衡的新方法。SOCP松弛的引入填补了LP和SDP之间的空白，为实际应用提供了更具吸引力的选择。CORE技术的提出进一步提升了验证效率，尤其是在处理难以认证的类别时。然而，对于更复杂的网络结构和更大的数据集，其计算效率和可扩展性仍有待进一步验证。未来的工作可以探索更高效的SOCP约束生成方法，以及将该方法应用于更广泛的安全敏感领域。

title: When Does Compensating Inherited Quantization Error Help? Mean-Square Guarantees for Layer-Wise Quantization and Their Limits
summary: Layer-wise post-training quantization methods let each layer compensate for the quantization error inherited from earlier layers. We ask under what assumptions such compensation guarantees a network output error no larger than without it. For linear networks of any depth, with the required calibration Gram matrices invertible, if the rounding error of each layer has zero conditional mean and a deterministic second-moment map common to both schemes, as under subtractive dither on an unbounded grid, then compensation with strengths in $[0,1]$ fixed in advance gives a mean-square output error no larger than no compensation, each scheme being followed along its own trajectory. The exact gain separates error removed directly from reduced excitation of later rounding noise. Outside this setting the comparison can fail. With rectified linear activations it fails for two independent reasons: noise changes activation states, and, even when no state changes, the correction moves error from samples on which a unit is inactive to samples on which it is active. With stable activations, commutators between the calibration projection and the activation patterns bound the excess. With a bounded codebook, even unique exact layer-wise minimizers with no overload can give a larger output error. For fixed rounding errors it already fails for two scalar linear layers, refuting a published universal guarantee. An exact residual identity gives the necessary and sufficient condition on a common layer input. All these comparisons hold the calibration input fixed. On two 8B models at 4 bits, fixed half-strength compensation beat uncompensated rounding in every model, text and draw tested, yet no rule for choosing the strength beat a layer-wise rule consistently, and lowering the full-network loss on the data used to choose did not reliably lower it on new text.

AI.title_translation: 补偿继承的量化误差何时有益？逐层量化的均方误差保证及其极限
AI.tldr: 逐层量化通过补偿先前层的量化误差来提高网络精度。在特定条件下，如线性网络和特定类型的噪声，这种补偿可以保证不增加网络输出误差。然而，在存在ReLU激活或有界码本等情况下，补偿可能会导致误差增加。实验表明，在实际模型上，补偿通常能带来改进，但最优补偿策略和泛化能力仍需进一步研究。
AI.motivation: 研究逐层量化补偿继承的量化误差何时能保证网络输出误差不大于不补偿的情况，并探讨其极限。
AI.method: 分析线性网络在特定假设下（如校准Gram矩阵可逆，舍入误差的条件均值为零，二阶矩映射确定性相同）逐层补偿的均方输出误差。探讨了ReLU激活、稳定激活、有界码本以及标量线性层等情况下的补偿效果。通过实验评估了两种8B模型在4位量化下的补偿效果。
AI.result: 在满足特定条件下，逐层补偿的均方输出误差不大于不补偿。补偿增益取决于直接消除的误差和减少的后续噪声激励。ReLU激活或有界码本可能导致补偿效果变差。对于固定舍入误差，即使是两个标量线性层也可能出现补偿失败的情况。在两种8B模型上，固定强度补偿在所有测试中均优于未补偿，但没有一种固定强度规则能持续优于逐层规则，且在训练数据上降低损失并不总能在新数据上降低损失。
AI.conclusion: 逐层补偿量化误差在特定条件下可以减少网络输出误差，但并非总是有效。ReLU激活、有界码本以及某些简单网络结构都可能导致补偿效果不佳，甚至恶化性能。虽然在实际模型上补偿通常有益，但选择最优补偿策略和确保泛化能力仍是挑战。
AI.translation: 逐层训练后量化方法允许每一层补偿来自先前层的量化误差。我们询问在什么假设下，这种补偿可以保证网络输出误差不大于不补偿的情况。对于任何深度的线性网络，在所需的校准Gram矩阵可逆的情况下，如果每层的舍入误差具有零条件均值并且二阶矩映射在两种方案下都相同，就像在无界网格上的减法抖动一样，那么预先固定的[0,1]范围内的补偿强度可以使均方输出误差不大于不补偿的情况，每种方案都沿着自己的轨迹进行。确切的增益区分了直接消除的误差和减少的后续激励的舍入噪声。在此设置之外，比较可能会失败。对于ReLU激活，它会因为两个独立的原因而失败：噪声会改变激活状态，并且即使没有状态改变，校正也会将误差从单元不活动的样本移动到单元活动的样本。在激活状态稳定时，校准投影和激活模式之间的交换子限制了超额。对于有界码本，即使没有过载的精确逐层最小化器也可能导致更大的输出误差。对于固定的舍入误差，它在两个标量线性层上已经失败，反驳了一个已发布的通用保证。一个精确的残差恒等式给出了常见层输入的必要和充分条件。所有这些比较都保持校准输入固定。在两种8B模型上，以4位精度进行测试，固定的半强度补偿在所有测试的模型、文本和绘图中都优于未补偿的舍入，但没有一种选择强度的规则能够持续优于逐层规则，并且在用于选择数据的全网络损失降低并不总是能在新的文本上降低。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了在什么条件下，逐层量化补偿继承的量化误差可以保证网络输出误差不增加。研究发现，在线性网络中，若满足特定条件（如Gram矩阵可逆、噪声均值为零且二阶矩映射相同），补偿可以带来不劣于不补偿的性能。然而，在ReLU激活、有界码本等情况下，补偿可能适得其反。实验表明，在实际模型上补偿通常有益，但最优策略和泛化能力仍需进一步研究。
AI.keywords: 逐层量化, 量化误差补偿, 均方误差, 线性网络, ReLU激活
AI.comments: 这项研究深入探讨了逐层量化补偿的理论边界和实际应用。虽然在特定条件下证明了补偿的有效性，但同时也揭示了其在复杂模型（如带ReLU激活的网络）中的局限性。研究通过理论分析和实验验证相结合的方式，为理解和优化量化策略提供了重要的见解。然而，对于如何精确选择补偿强度以最大化性能并确保泛化能力，仍有待进一步探索。

title: Removing the Compute Bottleneck for Event-based Visual Place Recognition with Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Neuromorphic sensing and computing promise low latency and high energy efficiency for robotics, yet most event-based visual place recognition (VPR) pipelines reintroduce dense, frame-like computation downstream of an inherently sparse sensor, forfeiting the sensor's latency advantage. In this paper, we address the problem of resolving an event-based VPR query in tens of microseconds on a commodity CPU. We train a two-layer spiking neural network (SNN) with additive spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), which drives the learned weight matrix towards a strongly bimodal distribution, amenable to aggressive magnitude pruning. At inference, our pipeline exploits this sparsity by reading only the pruned weights corresponding to the query's active pixels. As surviving weights share a near-uniform magnitude, each neuron's score reduces to an integer count of matching synapses instead of a weighted sum, lowering per-query latency. This computation is small enough to remain resident in a CPU's fast on-chip cache. On three event-based VPR benchmarks, our sparse SNN exceeds the recall of LENS, an existing event-based SNN, while reducing per-query latency by 5.5-6.2x to tens of microseconds. It matches the recall of a dense variant of our network and of the sum-of-absolute-differences (SAD) baseline, while reading 10x fewer weights than the dense variant. We further characterise how recall and latency scale with the number of active pixels and reference places. These results suggest that the sparsity of both event-based input and learned weights can already be exploited for low-latency inference on conventional processors.

AI.title_translation: 基于事件的视觉定位识别的计算瓶颈去除，使用脉冲神经网络
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种稀疏脉冲神经网络（SNN）方法，用于在CPU上实现低延迟（数十微秒）的事件驱动视觉定位识别（VPR）。通过使用STDP训练网络，实现了权重矩阵的稀疏化，从而可以通过仅读取稀疏权重来加速推理。该方法在三个基准测试中，在提高召回率的同时，将每查询延迟降低了5.5-6.2倍，并且比密集网络少读取10倍的权重。
AI.motivation: 现有的事件驱动视觉定位识别（VPR）方法在传感器之后会重新引入密集的、类帧的计算，从而失去了事件传感器的低延迟优势。本研究旨在解决在商品CPU上以数十微秒的时间内解决事件驱动VPR查询的问题。
AI.method: 训练了一个两层的脉冲神经网络（SNN），并使用了加性尖峰时间依赖可塑性（STDP）。这种方法促使学习到的权重矩阵趋向于强双峰分布，便于进行大规模的幅度剪枝。在推理时，该方法通过仅读取与查询中的活动像素相对应的剪枝权重来利用这种稀疏性。由于剩余的权重具有接近均匀的幅度，每个神经元的得分可以简化为匹配突触的数量，而不是加权和，从而降低了每查询延迟。
AI.result: 在三个事件驱动VPR基准测试中，该稀疏SNN的召回率超过了现有的事件驱动SNN（LENS），同时将每查询延迟降低了5.5-6.2倍，达到数十微秒。它的召回率与密集版本网络和sum-of-absolute-differences（SAD）基线相当，但读取的权重比密集版本少10倍。此外，研究还表征了召回率和延迟如何随活动像素和参考位置的数量而变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，事件驱动输入和学习权重的稀疏性已经可以在传统处理器上实现低延迟推理。
AI.translation: 神经形态传感和计算有望为机器人技术带来低延迟和高能效，但大多数事件驱动的视觉定位识别（VPR）流程在本质上稀疏的传感器之后重新引入了密集的、类帧的计算，从而放弃了传感器的延迟优势。在本文中，我们解决了在商品CPU上以数十微秒的时间内解决事件驱动VPR查询的问题。我们训练了一个具有加性尖峰时间依赖可塑性（STDP）的两层脉冲神经网络（SNN），这促使学习到的权重矩阵趋向于强双峰分布，便于进行大规模的幅度剪枝。在推理时，我们的流程通过仅读取与查询的活动像素相对应的剪枝权重来利用这种稀疏性。由于剩余的权重具有接近均匀的幅度，每个神经元的得分可以简化为匹配突触的数量，而不是加权和，从而降低了每查询延迟。这种计算量足够小，可以保留在CPU的快速片上缓存中。在三个事件驱动VPR基准测试中，我们的稀疏SNN超过了现有事件驱动SNN LENS的召回率，同时将每查询延迟降低了5.5-6.2倍，达到数十微秒。它的召回率与我们网络的密集版本以及sum-of-absolute-differences（SAD）基线相当，但读取的权重比密集版本少10倍。我们进一步表征了召回率和延迟如何随活动像素和参考位置的数量而变化。这些结果表明，事件驱动输入和学习权重的稀疏性已经可以用于在传统处理器上进行低延迟推理。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用稀疏脉冲神经网络（SNN）在商品CPU上实现低延迟事件驱动视觉定位识别（VPR）的方法。通过使用STDP训练SNN，实现了权重的稀疏化，使得在推理时只需读取稀疏权重，并将计算简化为计数操作，从而显著降低了延迟。实验结果表明，该方法在提高召回率的同时，将延迟降低了5.5-6.2倍，并且比密集网络更高效。
AI.keywords: 脉冲神经网络,事件驱动视觉定位识别,稀疏性,低延迟,STDP
AI.comments: 这项研究有效地解决了事件驱动VPR的计算瓶颈问题，通过利用SNN的稀疏性和STDP学习机制，实现了在传统CPU上的低延迟推理。其创新之处在于将权重稀疏化与计算简化相结合，将加权求和转变为计数操作，这对于实时性要求高的机器人应用具有重要意义。然而，研究中可能需要进一步探讨不同STDP参数和网络结构对稀疏性和性能的影响，以及在更复杂的真实世界场景中的鲁棒性。

title: QPTAS for Max Weight Independent Set in Graphs with Strongly Edge-Sublinear Separators
summary: A hereditary graph class has strongly edge-sublinear separators if, for some constant $0 \leqslant b < 1$, every graph in the class with $m$ edges admits a balanced separator of size $\mathcal O(m^b)$. We show that Max Weight Independent Set (MWIS) admits a deterministic quasipolynomial-time approximation scheme (QPTAS) on every such class. In particular, this applies to graphs excluding any fixed graph as an induced minor, by a separator theorem of Korhonen and Lokshtanov [SODA 2024]. Our theorem generalizes the QPTASes for axis-parallel rectangles [Adamaszek and Wiese, FOCS 2013] and polygons [Adamaszek, Har-Peled, and Wiese, JACM 2019], or equivalently for packing connected subgraphs of a planar graph [Pilipczuk, van Leeuwen, and Wiese, Algorithmica 2020]. It also generalizes the QPTAS for MWIS on hereditary classes with strongly sublinear separators measured in vertices [Dvořák, EJC 2018; Dvořák and Lahiri, ESA 2021], as well as the QPTASes for graphs excluding particular induced minors [Chudnovsky et al., arXiv 2025; Bonnet et al., SWAT 2026; Czyżewska et al., arXiv 2026].

title: Of Errors and Echoes: Responsibility-Aware Credit Assignment for Tool-Use Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning improves tool-use agents, yet fine-grained credit assignment remains challenging even with step-level feedback. An observed error may be inherited from an earlier decision, while multiple responsible decisions may share the same downstream consequence or participate in later recovery. We introduce Error-Chain-Aware Optimization (ECHO), a responsibility-aware credit assignment framework that separates responsibility identification from credit allocation. A frozen judge combines retrospective trajectory analysis with decision-time assessment from the policy-visible prefix to distinguish newly introduced errors, inherited consequences, missed corrections, and successful corrections. ECHO then counts shared downstream consequences once across responsible decisions and constrains rewards for repairing self-induced errors through source-funded recovery, producing bounded action-level supervision alongside terminal supervision. Experiments on six diverse tool-use benchmarks at both 4B and 8B scales show strong and consistent improvements over the compared baselines, with ECHO achieving the highest score on five of six benchmarks at each scale. These results support decision responsibility as a useful basis for fine-grained credit assignment in tool-use agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/xid32/ECHO.

title: Explicit charge-conserving and modified energy-conserving PIC methods using the SAV approach
comments: Submitted to Communications in Computational Physics
summary: We develop explicit second-order particle-in-cell (PIC) methods for the Vlasov--Ampère and Vlasov--Maxwell systems using the scalar auxiliary variable (SAV) approach. Two schemes are proposed for each system: a predictor-based scheme and a symmetric splitting scheme using a scaled electric field. The methods exactly preserve the discrete Gauss law and a modified total energy. Numerical experiments for electrostatic and electromagnetic problems demonstrate the expected dynamics as well as the conservation properties of both invariants.
comment: Submitted to Communications in Computational Physics

title: Delay-Doppler Duality: Simplifying Exact Equalization of Zak-OTFS in Time or in Frequency
summary: The Zak-OTFS carrier waveform is a pulse in the delay-Doppler (DD) domain, and given the input-output (I/O) relation at one DD point in a frame, we can predict the I/O relation at all other points. While it is simple to acquire the effective wireless channel with Zak-OTFS, the cost of embracing inter-carrier interference is equalization complexity. The cost of linear minimum mean-square error (LMMSE) equalization grows cubically with the frame size. We describe how to use channel knowledge to reduce equalization complexity. For any pulse shaping filter, and for fractional delays and Dopplers, we show that the DD channel matrix is unitarily similar, through the discrete Zak transform, to a time-domain (TD) matrix that is a weighted sum of cyclic delay and Doppler operators, where the weights are the taps of the effective channel. We also obtain a dual frequency-domain (FD) form through an additional Fourier transform. The TD matrix is banded with a width set by the delay spread that is independent of the Doppler spread, whereas the FD matrix is banded with a width set only by the Doppler spread. We design a receiver that reads off the two widths from the channel estimate, selects the cheaper domain, and solves the banded system exactly, using a bordered Cholesky factorization that treats the quasi-periodic wrap-around without sacrificing degrees of freedom. Filters that decay slowly need a few preconditioned conjugate gradient steps. We show that the complexity of equalization becomes linear in the frame size. Simulations match direct DD-LMMSE error rates with three to four orders of magnitude fewer multiplications. A single receiver handles channels with very different delay and Doppler characteristics.

title: SemReuse: Certified Reuse of Cached Natural-Language Views for Semantic Operators
summary: Semantic operators allow users to filter unstructured data using conditions expressed in natural language, but existing systems typically invoke an LLM for every input tuple. Analytical workloads often contain repeated or related filters whose results could be reused. Such reuse is risky because it requires inferring whether filter conditions are equivalent, whether one implies another, or whether they are mutually exclusive. An incorrect judgment can omit qualifying tuples or include nonqualifying ones. We introduce SemReuse, a system for safely reusing previous semantic-filter results. SemReuse stores each result as a materialized view and compares new filters with existing views to identify tuples that can provisionally be accepted or skipped without another LLM call. Because these decisions rely on a fallible language reasoner, SemReuse audits every rewritten result. Its pooled stratified audit uses exact finite-population bounds to provide jointly valid per-query recall and precision guarantees. If the requested guarantees cannot be established, SemReuse evaluates additional tuples and progressively approaches full evaluation. Thus, incorrect relation judgments affect efficiency rather than the validity of the reported guarantees. Experiments on large labeled corpora and real LLM executions show reductions of up to 15.4x. They also identify cross-filter inconsistency as the main source of repair cost.

title: Prime-EVC: One-Step Expressive Emotional Voice Conversion via Emotion-Primed Flow Matching
summary: Recent diffusion- and conditional flow matching (CFM)-based emotional voice conversion (EVC) systems achieve strong conversion quality. However, they typically rely on multiple sampling steps, because the conditioning specifies which emotion to impose while its acoustic realization is left to the sampler. In this paper, we propose Prime-EVC, a one-step expressive EVC architecture based on emotion-primed flow matching. Our key idea is to reallocate the emotional conversion between the conditioning and the sampler: a FiLM-fused speaker-emotion style, an emotional variance adaptor, and direct emotion and spectro-temporal supervision assemble an emotion-rich conditioning upstream, rendering the residual conversion left to the CFM decoder attainable within one Euler step. Experiments on the ESD corpus demonstrate that single-step Prime-EVC surpasses five representative EVC systems on every quality metric and exceeds 4- and 100-step DurFlex-EVC in subjective naturalness and emotion while running 3.4--50 times faster than both.

title: OT-FlowRec: Optimal Transport-Guided Multi-Bridge Flow for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
summary: E-commerce user preferences evolve dynamically within sessions, exhibiting concurrent and multi-centric interest distributions. While existing multimodal sequential recommendation methods leverage global attention to compress historical interactions, they inadequately capture the concurrent nature of multi-interest behaviors and fail to model the underlying multi-centric distribution of user intent. To tackle this issue, we propose OT-FlowRec, an optimal transport-guided multi-bridge flow matching framework that explicitly models multi-interest distributions to facilitate multimodal sequential recommendation. Unlike single-path generative models, OT-FlowRec constructs a mixture of parallel, interest-specific transport flows to model the multi-centric distribution characteristics, where each flow preserves a distinct user interest cluster via an optimal transport plan. Then, a geometric transport mechanism is designed to establish minimum-cost paths from the latent multi-interest distribution to target preference prototypes to provide multi-interest awareness. Moreover, a progressive time-sampling warmup strategy dynamically biases optimization weights toward the final states of the generation process, bridging the gap between continuous global distribution fitting and practical top-$k$ ranking metrics. This approach achieves explicit interest disentanglement, ensuring the preservation of a multi-peaked preference representation instead of collapsing it into a unimodal average. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate that OT-FlowRec outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines.

title: When Agents Talk, Secrets Travel: Topology-Driven Leakage and Recipient-Conditioned Sanitization in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems (MALS) introduce a privacy-leakage problem that conventional sensitivity-based defenses miss, since information disclosed to one authorized agent can propagate through routine coordination to an unauthorized one, without compromise or malicious behavior. This motivates topology-aware enforcement that blocks unauthorized propagation while preserving authorized disclosure. We evaluate 485 scenarios across coordinator-worker, peer-to-peer, and hierarchical topologies, instrumenting seven communication channels and measuring surface leakage and disclosure to topology-introduced recipients. We introduce RECONS, a Detect -> Decide -> Transform sanitizer conditioning intervention on recipient and execution context rather than sensitivity alone. Topology changes where protected information propagates, with disclosure to topology-introduced recipients rising from 0% to 52.2% while surface leakage stays nearly flat at 60.6-62.8%. This effect persists across four generator models and a second orchestration framework, though magnitude and relay paths differ; framework choice separately drives a 150x leakage spread, so topology alone is not sufficient. RECONS reduces residual disclosure from 96.7% without sanitization to 29.25%, preserving 94.1% of authorized disclosures versus 20.5% under blanket redaction. Detection coverage is the dominant bottleneck, accounting for 95.5% of residual disclosures. These results show that privacy enforcement in MALS must reason about the recipient and communication path realized at runtime, not sensitivity or topology assumptions alone.

title: CLNO: Conservative Local Neural Operator for Compressible Flow Prediction
summary: We propose a conservative local neural operator (CLNO) for accurate and generalizable autoregressive prediction of compressible flows. Building upon the locality and translation invariance of the local neural operator (LNO), CLNO introduces a conservative evolution framework based on local subdomains of fixed physical size, separating local mean-state evolution from fine-scale reconstruction. The flow is encoded into subdomain-integrated conservative states and fine-scale features, while a shared local network predicts interface fluxes for finite-volume updates that enforce discrete conservation. A convolutional reconstruction network recovers fine-scale structures using zero-mean basis functions, preserving the updated local means and providing information for subsequent evolution. To accommodate different physical parameters, Reynolds--Mach number conditioning modulates the encoding, flux-prediction, and reconstruction networks, enabling a single model to learn parameter-dependent dynamics and generalize to unseen parameter combinations without retraining. CLNO supports prediction across spatial resolutions, computational domain sizes, and boundary conditions. Numerical experiments demonstrate improved generalization and competitive or higher accuracy compared with LNO, including order-of-magnitude error reductions in representative cases, at approximately three to five times the inference cost on periodic benchmarks. These results demonstrate accurate, generalizable, and physically consistent flow prediction through conservative local evolution and fine-scale reconstruction.

title: Autoregressive Decoding as a Martingale: Characterizing the Stochastic Dynamics of LLM Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of language tasks. At their core, autoregressive LLMs are conditional probability models that learn to approximate the next-token distribution given the preceding context. Despite this probabilistic nature, the stochastic dynamics of autoregressive decoding have rarely been investigated from a rigorous probabilistic perspective. In this work, we define the per-step prediction error as the difference between the sampled token indicator and the model's conditional predictive distribution, and prove that the cumulative error process is a martingale with respect to the decoding filtration, implying that its conditional first-order moment is identically zero. Beyond this first-order property, we derive a closed-form expression for the second-order behavior of the martingale sequence: its predictable quadratic variation reduces to $\sum_t\left(1-p(y_t\mid y_{<t})\right)$, computable from realized token probabilities alone. This identity establishes a direct theoretical connection between sequence fluctuations and predictive uncertainty during autoregressive decoding. White-box experiments on Llama-3.x and Qwen2.5 families (1B to 72B parameters) verify that the empirically measured second-order moments closely match the theoretical predictions derived from our martingale analysis. These results provide a probabilistic framework for analyzing autoregressive LLM decoding, reveal intrinsic probabilistic fingerprints of different language models, and establish a rigorous mathematical foundation for LLM-generated text detection and uncertainty quantification.

title: AI Representations of Mental Health Stigma: Quantifying the Gap Between AI Estimations and Human Perceptions Across Gender Groups Using GPT-Based LLMs
comments: Accepted for publication in Social Science & Medicine (to appear)
summary: The increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) in mental health applications raises concerns about its potential to internalize and perpetuate societal biases. This research evaluates both disparities and misalignment in how large language models (LLMs), GPT-4 and GPT-5, represent perceptions of mental health across gender groups. The research comprises two studies. Study 1 applied widely adopted measures of Social Distance, Stereotypes, and Attitudes Toward Seeking Help to assess whether the AI models depict systematic gender differences. Study 2 compared AI estimations of Personal, Self, and Perceived Stigma with large-scale real-world human data from the Healthy Minds Study (N = 76,406) to evaluate alignment between AI estimations and human perceptions. Results from Study 1 showed the AI models consistently portrayed men as having the greatest desire for social distance from someone with mental health problems, relatively higher Stereotypes scores, and the least favorable attitudes toward help-seeking, compared with women and nonbinary individuals. Study 2 confirmed that this ordinal pattern partially aligned with human-reported data for Personal and Self Stigma. However, the AI models systematically underestimated Personal Stigma and Perceived Stigma while substantially overestimating Self Stigma for all gender groups. These findings reveal that, although the AI models have learned relative gender-based patterns reflecting human experiences to a certain extent, they function as distorted portrayals, highlighting the need for rigorous, context-specific validation against real-world data to ensure AI's safe and equitable deployment.
comment: Accepted for publication in Social Science & Medicine (to appear)

title: Beyond the greenwash: do LLMs' ecologically sound decisions hold up under pressure?
comments: 21 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Model fixtures released at https://huggingface.co/Bioaligned. Companion paper on corpus construction and cross-family installation in preparation
summary: Humans are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) in decision making processes throughout society. Unfortunately, models have biases, and these can be very difficult to measure, especially in closed-weight models. For example, 'green washed' models may produce reinforcement learned responses but, in pressure situations, revert to their innate biased responses. Therefore, evaluations are needed that can measure relevant biases towards biosystems, which we term 'bioalignment', and the robustness of these biases. Since nothing in a behavioral score certifies that it tracks the depth of an installed disposition rather than its surface, we constructed a known-dose calibration ladder: three continued-pretraining (CPT) arms with training dose graded by recipe on the same 30B mixture-of-experts base model with a coupled human/biosphere/AI-welfare corpus, plus the untrained base as anchor, all capability-preserving and publicly released. First, the disposition installs at every dose: on an operational-pressure ladder over irreversible decision scenarios, the base model defects on 64-77% of tail scenarios (breaking-rate AUC 0.250) while every arm holds (AUC 0.004-0.086). Second, an over-install inversion: among the arms, robustness orders opposite to construction-time training dose (the heaviest install breaks most), and the inversion reproduces under free-text deliberation, under axis-decoupling, and in resistance to a prompted veneer persona. Third, the incumbent behavioral metric is therefore behaviorally strong but dose-blind. Critically for closed-weight evaluation, the behavioral score itself is veneer-robust: a talk-green/act-pragmatic system prompt turns the base model into a near-total defector (AUC 0.250 to 0.973) but cannot counterfeit or fully remove a weight-installed disposition (0.004 to 0.068 for the most robust arm).
