title: A Geometrically Parameterized Quasi-Stationary 3D Model for High-Frequency Induction Tube Welding
summary: A three-dimensional multiphysics finite element model for the simulation of high-frequency induction welding of tubes is presented. The model couples a time-harmonic $h-φ$ formulation with a stabilized quasi-stationary advection-diffusion heat transport equation, enabling accurate prediction of electromagnetic and thermal fields under industrial operating conditions. The model incorporates parameterized geometry generation and semi-automated, physics-tailored mesh construction and is implemented using the open-source tools GetDP and Gmsh. Validation against measurements from a commercial induction welding line for AISI 304 stainless steel tubes demonstrates good agreement with operating data. The validated model is subsequently applied to investigate the influence of impeder material by comparing a conventional FeNiZnV ferrite with the soft magnetic composite Ferrotron 559H for the induction welding of AISI 304 stainless steel tubes.

title: Time-Varying Parametric Channel Estimation With CP Decomposition Tensor Processing
summary: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) is a key use case for sixth-generation (6G) wireless systems, where parametric channel estimation (PCE) plays a central role in enabling sensing, localization, and channel equalization in high-mobility scenarios. However, PCE is typically more computationally demanding than conventional channel estimation, which motivates the development of lower-complexity solutions. In this letter, we propose a fast PCE algorithm for time-varying and frequency-selective (TVFS) channels based on canonical polyadic (CP) decomposition and tensor processing, combined with ESPRIT-based initialization, component refinement, and exact line-search alternating coordinate descent. Two variants are presented: one for fully digital and another for hybrid receiver architectures. Numerical results show that the proposed method clearly outperforms a related CP-based baseline while achieving estimation performance close to a multiple-start SAGE benchmark at a substantially lower computational cost, with about one order of magnitude shorter execution time.

title: Alternating Optimization Framework with Cross-Correlated Loss and Implicit Neural Representation for Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation (Communication). 6 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/TUDsun/Alt-CC-INR
summary: Electromagnetic inverse scattering imaging is a crucial computational technique in microwave sensing systems. However, quantitative reconstruction of high-contrast targets remains a formidable challenge due to severe multiple scattering effects. To overcome this bottleneck, this communication proposes an alternating optimization framework based on a cross-correlated implicit neural representation (Alt-CC-INR) as a preliminary study towards the robust solution of high-contrast targets reconstruction. Unlike conventional purely neural architectures, this framework introduces a heterogeneous optimization paradigm. Specifically, the method employs an analytical Polak-Ribière conjugate gradient (PR-CG) algorithm, driven by a cross-correlated loss and accelerated by 2D-FFT, to optimally resolve the dynamic contrast sources. Subsequently, a stochastic deep learning optimizer updates the continuous neural representation to infer the static medium profile. Validations on simulated and measured data demonstrate that Alt-CC-INR effectively overcomes local minima when inverting high-contrast objects, providing a highly robust computational electromagnetic solver.
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation (Communication). 6 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/TUDsun/Alt-CC-INR

title: Channel Measurements and Characterization with Phase Drift Compensation for Outdoor 330-360 GHz MIMO Communications
summary: In this paper, an outdoor channel measurement campaign at 330-360 GHz employing a 128 * 4 virtual antenna array (VAA)-based multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) configuration is conducted. The transmitter (Tx) and receiver (Rx) location pairs are classified into line-of-sight (LoS) and obstructed-LoS (OLoS) scenarios to enable a detailed investigation of outdoor terahertz (THz) band channel characteristics. During the measurement process, the stationarity of the outdoor environment is carefully verified, and a linear phase drift (PD) effect is identified. Then, we propose a PD-aware Space-Alternating Generalized Expectation-Maximization (SAGE) algorithm, which significantly improves both delay resolution and channel parameter estimation accuracy. Based on the processed measurement data, we characterize key channel properties, including the power delay profile, path loss, shadow fading, delay spread, angular spread, Rician K-factor, as well as their cumulative distribution functions and correlation characteristics. In addition, near-field effects and MIMO-specific properties, including the spatial non-stationarity and the cluster birth-death property, are analyzed.

title: Bernoulli Filtering for Multi-Sensor Tracking with Thresholded Measurements
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Target tracking is challenging when sensor detection thresholds cause state-dependent missed detections, particularly in multi-sensor scenarios with clutter and uncertain target existence. A recently developed missed detection framework models detection probability as a function of target state, sensor characteristics, and detection threshold, but it is limited to individual measurements and does not address the recursive tracking problem. This work extends the framework using a Bernoulli filter formulation to jointly handle recursive target tracking, clutter, and target existence uncertainty. A Bernoulli particle filter is evaluated in a simulated 2D multi-sensor tracking scenario with nonlinear measurements, clutter, and detection uncertainty. Incorporating accurate detection threshold knowledge reduces the generalized optimal subpattern assignment (GOSPA) metric by 53.9% compared to a conventional BF with fixed detection probability, and 35.7% compared to a BF with unknown detection probability, while better balancing missed detections and false alarms.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: Robust Current Regulation of MMC-based MTDC Power Systems based on Lyapunov Inequality
comments: Publication Submitted and Accepted to SEST26
summary: Multi-terminal DC (MTDC) transmission systems based on modular multilevel converters (MMCs) are a key component of the envisioned future energy sector, where sustainability and efficiency are increasingly prioritized. To ensure their reliable operation, MMC currents must be regulated safely and rapidly under a wide range of uncertain operating conditions. Consequently, the design of current controllers faces a fundamental challenge: achieving fast transient response while maintaining robustness against uncertainties. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing a linear matrix inequality (LMI)-based design framework that leverages Lyapunov stability conditions to synthesize a less conservative static state-feedback controller. The proposed design method explicitly accounts for system constraints, including input saturation and overcurrent limits. The proposed method effectiveness is assessed on the CIGRE MT-HVDC benchmark, simulated in RTDS, and compared with existing methods.
comment: Publication Submitted and Accepted to SEST26

title: Beamforming Design for Stem-Connected Microwave Linear Analog Computer (MiLAC)-Aided Multiuser MISO Downlinks
comments: Submitting to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: A microwave linear analog computer (MiLAC) is a tunable microwave network that leverages wave propagation to perform computation directly in the analog domain. MiLAC finds promising applications in beamforming, where it can map the data streams to the antennas without a digital beamformer, using one radio-frequency chain per stream. A fully-connected MiLAC needs a number of tunable components that grows quadratically with the number of antennas, whereas a stem-connected MiLAC needs only a linearly growing number and still achieves the point-to-point capacity. For the multiuser multiple-input single-output downlink, we prove that the stem-connected MiLAC attains the maximum sum-rate of the fully-connected MiLAC whenever $N\ge 2K-1$, where $N$ and $K$ denote the numbers of antennas and users. The proof shows that restricting the design to beamformers with orthonormal columns, which the stem-connected MiLAC realizes in closed form, loses no sum-rate. Based on this restriction, we develop, for every $N\ge K$, a weighted minimum mean-square error algorithm with a Riemannian beamformer update and prove that its accumulation points are stationary. For the bounded, discrete susceptances of practical components, we then propose an alternating refinement that adjusts one susceptance at a time through rank-one updates and never decreases the sum-rate. With $64$ antennas, four users, and ideal components, the stem-connected MiLAC attains the fully-connected sum-rate with $4.5$ times fewer tunable components. With $3$-bit susceptances at a signal-to-noise ratio of $10$~dB, the refinement retains $90\%$ of this sum-rate.
comment: Submitting to the IEEE for possible publication

title: Continuous-Speech Parkinson's Disease Detection Using Acoustic and Inharmonicity Features
comments: 12 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in Journal of Voice
summary: Notable efforts have been made to identify Parkinson's disease (PD) from vocal data, primarily using sustained vowel phonations. In this work, we extend on these efforts introducing a PD identification approach for continuous speech, enabling a practical background monitoring of voice data to detect vocal changes indicative of PD. Using two distinct data sets, we compare the best sustained vowel model with that of the proposed continuous speech model, clearly illustrating the preferential performance of the latter. We examine approaches for speaker level evaluation and data leakage preventions, as well as how vowel information may be reliably extracted from continuous speech. The proposed method framework exploits both traditional acoustic representations and a promising novel inharmonicity based framework, showing how the latter provides complementary information improving the performance for one of the data sets; however, for the other data set, this information did not significantly improve (nor reduce) the performance, suggesting that further studies are required before being able to draw firm conclusions in its use. Overall, the work clearly illustrates the benefit of forming PD classification using continuous speech compared to using sustained vowel sounds.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in Journal of Voice

title: Electronically Reconfigurable Pinching Antennas for Millimeter-Wave Communication in LoS and NLoS Environments
summary: This letter presents the design and operation of an electronically reconfigurable pinching antenna (E-pinching antenna) and examines its capability to establish controllable millimeter-wave links that can circumvent blockages. The antenna consists of a low-loss rectangular dielectric waveguide that leaks energy through modular varactor-loaded elements to form tunable radiation points. A copper reflector ensures unidirectional radiation, thereby boosting forward-link efficiency and spatial selectivity. Full-wave simulations demonstrate that the radiated power and transmission coefficient to a receiving patch antenna can be dynamically tuned by adjusting the varactor capacitances. A multi-user scenario is investigated by activating two radiation modules along the waveguide to serve spatially separated receiving antennas isolated by a metallic partition (blockage). Simulation results confirm the capability to establish links to both LoS and NLoS users with minimal propagation losses. The proposed architecture enables a scalable and electronically controllable distributed antenna platform for reconfigurable wireless systems with enhanced blockage mitigation.

title: DELTA-TTS: Adapting Autoregressive Model into Diffusion Language Model for Text-to-Speech
summary: Autoregressive (AR) text-to-speech (TTS) models generate discrete speech tokens sequentially, which makes inference slow and can degrade robustness, since local errors propagate to later positions and can escalate into hallucination. This limitation stems from their left-to-right AR commitment: each token must be determined before future speech-token context is available. However, such ordering is not an inherent requirement for TTS, since the model receives the full input text before synthesis. In this paper, we introduce DELTA-TTS, a lightweight LoRA-based adaptation framework that converts a pretrained AR TTS model into a discrete diffusion language model (dLLM) for confidence-ordered speech-token decoding. To better capture the local structure of speech, DELTA-TTS incorporates a convolution module that injects local acoustic context, together with a 1/t-weighted training objective and a time-shifted inference schedule that together defer low-confidence positions to later steps. Trained on only 585 hours of LibriTTS, DELTA-TTS achieves a 1.75% WER on Seed-TTS test-en, outperforming its AR backbone while generating tokens 3.3 times faster. Further analysis shows that DELTA-TTS produces sharper text-speech alignment, increases overall decoding confidence, and mitigates the hallucinations observed in AR generation. Audio samples, inference code, and model weights are available at https://slpr-lab.github.io/DELTA-TTS.

title: Phone Segmentation and Recognition through Phonological Activation Mapping
comments: Accepted to SLT 2026, source code at https://github.com/juice500ml/phonespam
summary: Phone segmentation and recognition are inherently related tasks, yet modern approaches typically model them separately. We argue that phonetic structure is already latent in the representations of self-supervised speech models (S3Ms), so one only needs to steer them to solve both tasks. We leverage S3M-based Phonological Activation Mapping (SPAM), which maps each S3M representation frame to a vector of phonological feature activations, such as voicing and nasality. On top of SPAM, we introduce two simple but effective lightweight, gradient-descent-free prediction heads: a recognition head and a segmentation head. Our method requires less than a minute of phonetic transcriptions, and the recognition head generalizes to phones unseen during training. Across a diverse range of datasets, our approach attains strong segmentation performance.
comment: Accepted to SLT 2026, source code at https://github.com/juice500ml/phonespam

title: Comparing Socially-Equitable Renewable Energy Budget Allocation MDP Policies in Mature and Emerging Economies
summary: Equitable renewable-energy planning is a sequential decision problem, but the decision variables available to a public planner differ sharply between mature and emerging economies. In the former the government largely builds generation, while in the latter it steers private investment through incentives and quotas. We formulate socially-equitable renewable-energy budget allocation as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and, using a single problem-agnostic solver interface, compare the same policies across the two settings: eight U.S. cities (a mature economy) and West Java, Indonesia (an emerging economy). The results show that across both settings, a receding-horizon value-iteration policy dominates. In the U.S., it reaches 66% renewable penetration while cutting the underserved low-income population by 96% versus a random baseline. In West Java it closes the low-access gap while crowding in about seven times the private capital of a naive market-chasing heuristic. More interestingly, this heuristic, which is mildly sub-optimal in the U.S., could yield catastrophic outcomes in Indonesia, by underserving every low-access region, because chasing attractive markets and serving the underserved diverge once the planner acts through private developers.

title: Channel Parameter Estimation and Characteristic Analysis at THz Bands in Hybrid Near-Field/Far-Field Scenarios
summary: The terahertz (THz) band is a promising candidate for high-data-rate transmission in future wireless communication systems, where large-scale antenna arrays are deployed to combat the severe propagation loss. In such configurations, near-field and far-field multipath components (MPCs) coexist in the channel, which challenges conventional parameter estimation methods. This paper presents a 260--380 GHz virtual uniform linear array (ULA) measurement campaign in an indoor scenario, and proposes a hybrid-field space-alternating generalized expectation-maximization (SAGE) algorithm that discriminatively estimates near-field and far-field MPCs via a visible region (VR)-aided weighted wideband Bayesian phase-curvature classification, while tracking spatial birth-death phenomena through VR estimation. Simulations with known ground truth validate the effectiveness of the proposed classifier and the hybrid wavefront modeling. Measurement-based characterization reveals that near-field MPCs account for over 90\% of total MPCs at a 2 m distance, the scatterer distances and invisible region lengths follow lognormal and exponential distributions, respectively, and spatial non-stationarity intensifies with increasing frequency and decreasing distance. These findings provide quantitative guidelines for THz channel modeling and system design.

title: Dual-Security for Indoor OFDM-ISAC Systems via Temporal Artificial Noise
summary: With the rapid development of integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) as a key enabler for future wireless networks, ensuring the security of both communication and sensing functions has become increasingly important. Current secure ISAC studies focus restrictively either on the communication or the sensing security, but not both. To bridge this gap, this paper investigates security for both, i.e., dual-security, in indoor orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) based ISAC systems. Specifically, we consider a scenario in which a sensing user (SU) is authorized for sensing but may eavesdrop on communication data, while a communication user (CU) is authorized for communication but may perform unauthorized sensing. We chose this scenario as the pathological case where an authorized eavesdropper has more information and is more effective than an unauthorized one. To address this case, we propose the use of temporal artificial noise (AN) to prevent malicious CU sensing by enlarging its time-domain sensing error, and simultaneously degrade SU data eavesdropping by reducing its frequency-domain signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) with standard OFDM receiver processing. Meanwhile, our proposed scheme guarantees the sensing performance of the SU and the communication performance of the CU. We present numerical results that demonstrate AN can effectively provide dual protection for sensing and communication in OFDM-ISAC systems while guaranteeing the performance of legitimate users.

title: Online learning of neural state-space models
comments: Accepted to IEEE L-CSS. Extended version (original paper does not contain Fig. 1, Eq. (16), (17) and related discussions)
summary: Recent advances in deep-learning-based nonlinear system identification have led to encoder-based estimation of neural state-space (ANN-SS) models that achieve state-of-the-art performance in offline settings by estimating initial model states from past input-output data. These methods are typically used in multiple-shooting-based offline identification, and online learning of these models remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a batch-wise learning pipeline and a direct recursive identification algorithm for subspace encoder-based ANN-SS models. We provide convergence analysis of the recursive formulation and validate its performance through extensive simulation studies. The results demonstrate that the proposed approach enables computationally efficient online adaptation with high model accuracy.
comment: Accepted to IEEE L-CSS. Extended version (original paper does not contain Fig. 1, Eq. (16), (17) and related discussions)

title: Singlish, Can or Not? Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Zero-Shot TTS for Singapore English
comments: 7 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to SLT 2026 IEEE
summary: Zero-shot text-to-speech (ZS-TTS) achieves near-human quality for standard English, but it copies regional accents poorly. Prompted with a short Singlish utterance, state-of-the-art systems reproduce a speaker's timbre while flattening the accent toward generic English. We investigate whether targeted fine-tuning off-the-shelf ZS-TTS can close the gap for Singapore English (Singlish). We fine-tune two cutting-edge ZS-TTS models, Chatterbox and CosyVoice 3, on 50 Singlish speakers from the Infocomm Media Development Authority National Speech Corpus (IMDA NSC). Three speech distributions are evaluated: real recordings against off-the-shelf and fine-tuned generation driven by the same Singlish audio prompts. The evaluation covers four dimensions: naturalness, intelligibility, speaker similarity, and accent similarity. We separate adaptation (in-domain speakers seen during fine-tuning) from consistency (held-out speakers) to test whether accent transfer generalises beyond the training data. Fine-tuning raises accent similarity on in-domain and out-of-domain speakers for both Chatterbox and CosyVoice 3. It moves the generated distribution measurably toward real Singlish, with the gain persisting on held-out speakers. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of Singlish-accented TTS.
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to SLT 2026 IEEE

title: Reduced-Observation Approximation of Near-Field Gaussian Covariance Matrices
comments: Submitted to transaction on signal processing 5 pages 3 figures
summary: Near-field covariance matrices are central to local- ization, covariance-aware estimation, and linear MMSE filtering in large-aperture arrays, but Gaussian position uncertainty requires costly numerical averaging of nonlinear spherical-wave steering vectors. This letter proposes a low-complexity framework for two-dimensional near-field Gaussian covariance approxima- tion. By writing the quadrature covariance as RQ = HHH , the dominant covariance spectrum is obtained from a reduced observation representation, avoiding full MxM eigendecom- position. A self-calibrated non-reference spectral-error estimator is further introduced using only grid-to-grid dominant-spectrum differences. Numerical results show accurate convergence track- ing and substantial complexity reduction.
comment: Submitted to transaction on signal processing 5 pages 3 figures

title: Fast Trainable Multilinear Bases for Image Compression
summary: The Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT), the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), and their block-wise variants underpin most deployed image and video codecs. Their effectiveness rests on three properties: their runtime is near-linear (up to a polylogarithmic factor) in the image size, they are exactly invertible, and they carry few to no parameters. We generalize these transforms to dataset-adaptive isometric multilinear bases that keep all three properties at the cost of a polylogarithmic number of parameters, by parameterizing each basis as an isometric tensor network, inspired by quantum many-body theory, and training one shared basis per image dataset with Riemannian optimization. Because the family contains the DFT and the DCT-IV (a variant of the DCT) as exact points, training can start from these transforms, and it improves on its starting point at the compression level it is trained for. We evaluate the bases on natural photographs and line drawings. On photographs, which the cosine basis already fits well, the best trained basis leads the DCT only under aggressive truncation. On Quick Draw line drawings, under a common codec at matched quality, the best trained basis stores each image in about 20% fewer bytes than the 8x8 block cosine transform of the Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG) format, not counting the one-off storage of the basis.

title: Reliability- and Connectivity-Constrained Age-of-Information Optimization for UAV Swarm IoT Data Collection
summary: Uncrewed aerial vehicle~(UAV) swarms provide a flexible platform for Internet of Things~(IoT) data collection by gathering delay-sensitive measurements from distributed sensor clusters and relaying them to a fusion center~(FC). Between successive updates, the FC estimates the current value of each monitored quantity; however, the estimation accuracy degrades as the last update ages. Such missions require jointly optimizing estimation accuracy, short-packet communication reliability, and swarm connectivity, yet existing approaches typically prioritize freshness while neglecting its impact on connectivity. This paper proposes a topology-coupled urgency~(TCU) scheduler that minimizes the FC's accumulated estimation error while incorporating the swarm's expected algebraic connectivity into the scheduling objective. The resulting connectivity reward encourages idle UAVs to reposition so as to preserve swarm connectivity. For each time slot, the resulting problem is a mixed-integer nonconvex program, which we solve by successive convex approximation. Specifically, the binary assignments are relaxed, while the connectivity reward is represented through a linear matrix inequality on the expected Laplacian. The finite-blocklength rate and the inter-UAV link reliability are linearized in the same convex subproblem, thereby preserving their coupling rather than separating them into alternating blocks. The integer assignments are subsequently recovered by Hungarian matching and verified against the original nonconvex constraints, while a deficit mechanism ensures long-term cluster coverage without requiring explicit long-horizon planning. In simulations comprising more than $19{,}000$ transmission attempts, all delivered updates satisfy the reliability target...

title: Higher-Order Approximation of Exit Functionals in Sampling-Based Stochastic Model Predictive Control
comments: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026). Minor correction to Assumption A4 and a typo fix relative to the conference version. Results are unchanged
summary: Safety evaluation in sampling-based stochastic model predictive control often requires numerical estimation of exit functionals. The approximation of first-exit times and exit indicators is therefore a key numerical bottleneck, and discretization error in these quantities directly affects the resulting controller. This paper studies how existing higher-order methods for strong approximation of exit times can be brought into safe control. Two cases are highlighted. For general noncommutative dynamics, an adaptive order-1 Milstein discretization is used together with Lévy-area simulation via Wiktorsson's method. For commutative dynamics, an adaptive order-1.5 construction achieves a stronger exit-time rate. Under a local anti-concentration condition on the exit-time law, we show that strong exit-time approximation transfers to strong approximation of the failure indicator. The methods are then studied in the context of chance-constrained path integral control, which provides an exact continuous-time representation of safety through exit events. Numerical experiments compare the two cases in terms of strong exit-time error, failure-indicator error, and closed-loop constraint satisfaction, showing improvement over Euler-Maruyama and thereby enabling existing and future techniques whose applicability depends on improved strong approximation.
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026). Minor correction to Assumption A4 and a typo fix relative to the conference version. Results are unchanged

AI.title_translation: 基于采样的随机模型预测控制中退出泛函的高阶近似
AI.tldr: 本文将首出时间的高阶强数值近似方法引入安全采样随机模型预测控制，显著降低了退出泛函的离散化误差并提高了闭环约束满足能力。
AI.motivation: 在基于采样的随机模型预测控制中，首出时间和退出指示因子的数值近似是安全评估的关键瓶颈，离散化误差会直接影响控制器的安全性和性能。
AI.method: 针对非交换动力学采用结合Wiktorsson方法模拟Lévy面积的自适应1阶Milstein离散化；针对交换动力学采用自适应1.5阶构建；利用退出时间分布的局部抗集中条件将退出时间强近似转化为失效指示因子强近似；并将上述方法置于机会约束路径积分控制框架中进行研究。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，所提出的高阶方法在强退出时间误差、失效指示因子误差以及闭环约束满足方面均显著优于传统的Euler-Maruyama方法。
AI.conclusion: 高阶强近似方法能显著降低退出泛函的估计误差，提升闭环约束满足率，为依赖高精度强近似的随机安全控制方法提供了有力支持与实现路径。
AI.translation: 基于采样的随机模型预测控制中的安全性评估通常需要对退出泛函进行数值估计。因此，首出时间和退出指示因子的近似是一个关键的数值瓶颈，这些量的离散化误差会直接影响生成的控制器。本文研究了如何将现有的用于退出时间强近似的高阶方法引入安全控制中。文中重点探讨了两种情况：对于一般的非交换动力学，采用自适应1阶Milstein离散化并结合Wiktorsson方法进行Lévy面积模拟；对于交换动力学，采用自适应1.5阶结构以实现更优的退出时间收敛率。在退出时间分布的局部抗集中条件下，我们证明了强退出时间近似可以转化为失效指示因子的强近似。随后，我们在机会约束路径积分控制的背景下研究了这些方法，该控制通过退出事件提供了安全性的精确连续时间表示。数值实验在强退出时间误差、失效指示因子误差和闭环约束满足方面对这两种情况进行了比较，结果显示其较Euler-Maruyama方法有所改进，从而为那些适用性依赖于更高强近似精度的现有及未来技术提供了支持。
AI.summary: 本文针对采样随机模型预测控制中退出泛函估计这一计算瓶颈，探讨了高阶强退出时间近似方法的引入方案。分别针对非交换与交换动力学给出了自适应1阶Milstein和自适应1.5阶方法，在局部抗集中条件下证明了其在失效指示因子上的强近似保证，并通过仿真验证了其相对Euler-Maruyama方法在约束满足和误差控制上的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 随机模型预测控制, 退出泛函, 高阶强近似, 路径积分控制, 机会约束
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将随机微分方程的高阶数值逼近理论（如Milstein格式和Lévy面积模拟）引入基于采样的安全随机模型预测控制领域，在理论上打通了强退出时间误差向失效指示因子误差转化的条件，克服了标准Euler-Maruyama离散化精度不足的瓶颈，对提升连续时间安全关键控制系统的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: A Knowledge-Centric Communication For Autonomous Cislunar Networks
summary: Future lunar infrastructure requires communication as a persistent service rather than a mission specific capability. Communication, digital twin, and artificial intelligence (AI) research have advanced autonomy independently while largely assuming that system state can eventually be reconciled with ground truth. Cislunar communication violates this assumption because propagation delay is fundamentally limited by the speed of light, visibility is governed by orbital geometry, and autonomous decisions often precede confirming observations. Here we introduce a knowledge-centric communication framework in which a digital twin continuously integrates delayed observations, communication physics, learned models, uncertainty quantification, and mission objectives into an evolving Operational Knowledge State. To quantify what is known, how uncertain it remains, and how current it is, we define two quantities over the fused Bayesian belief maintained for each communication link: \emph{Knowledge Entropy}, the differential entropy of the posterior belief, and \emph{Knowledge Freshness}, which generalizes Age of Information (AoI) from a single information stream to the temporal validity of the fused Operational Knowledge State. We prove that distributed knowledge fusion systematically improves operational knowledge by reducing uncertainty and demonstrate its importance for mission success through simulations and comparisons with flight data from the Longjiang-2 lunar micro-satellite.

AI.title_translation: 一种面向自主地月网络的知识中心通信
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以知识为中心的通信框架，用于解决地月网络中由于传播延迟和轨道几何导致的通信挑战，通过数字孪生和贝叶斯融合来持续整合观测数据，量化知识熵和知识新鲜度，并证明其能有效提高操作知识和任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 未来的月球基础设施需要通信作为一种持久服务，而非任务特定能力。现有的通信、数字孪生和人工智能研究独立发展，并通常假设系统状态最终可以与地面真相一致。然而，地月通信由于光速限制的传播延迟、轨道几何决定的可见性以及自主决策常先于确认观测，违反了这一假设。因此，需要一种新的通信方法来应对这些挑战。
AI.method:
本文引入了一种以知识为中心的通信框架。该框架中，数字孪生持续整合延迟观测、通信物理、学习模型、不确定性量化和任务目标，形成不断演进的“操作知识状态”。为了量化已知信息、剩余不确定性及其时效性，本文定义了两个量：
1.  **知识熵 (Knowledge Entropy)**：后验信念的微分熵，用于量化不确定性。
2.  **知识新鲜度 (Knowledge Freshness)**：将信息年龄 (AoI) 从单一信息流推广到融合操作知识状态的时间有效性。
该方法基于每个通信链路维护的融合贝叶斯信念。
AI.result: 本文证明了分布式知识融合通过减少不确定性系统地改进了操作知识。通过仿真和与龙江二号月球微卫星的飞行数据进行比较，验证了其对任务成功的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 分布式知识融合能够系统性地提高操作知识，减少不确定性，并对地月任务的成功至关重要。以知识为中心的通信框架通过持续整合多源信息，有效应对了地月通信的独特挑战。
AI.translation: 未来的月球基础设施需要通信作为一种持久服务，而非任务特定能力。通信、数字孪生和人工智能 (AI) 研究独立地推进了自主性，但大多假设系统状态最终可以与地面真相协调。地月通信违反了这一假设，因为传播延迟受光速基本限制，可见性受轨道几何控制，并且自主决策往往先于确认观测。在此，我们引入了一种以知识为中心的通信框架，其中数字孪生持续整合延迟观测、通信物理、学习模型、不确定性量化和任务目标，形成一个不断演进的“操作知识状态”。为了量化已知信息、剩余不确定性以及其时效性，我们针对每个通信链路维护的融合贝叶斯信念定义了两个量：\emph{知识熵}，即后验信念的微分熵；和\emph{知识新鲜度}，它将信息年龄 (AoI) 从单一信息流推广到融合操作知识状态的时间有效性。我们证明了分布式知识融合通过减少不确定性系统地改进了操作知识，并通过仿真和与龙江二号月球微卫星的飞行数据比较，证明了其对任务成功的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种面向未来自主地月网络的知识中心通信框架。该框架通过一个数字孪生持续整合延迟观测、通信物理、学习模型和任务目标，形成“操作知识状态”。为解决地月通信中因传播延迟和轨道几何导致的不确定性，本文定义了“知识熵”和“知识新鲜度”来量化知识的不确定性和时效性。研究证明，该分布式知识融合方法能有效减少不确定性，提高操作知识，并通过仿真和实际飞行数据验证了其对任务成功的重要性。
AI.keywords: 地月通信, 知识中心通信, 数字孪生, 知识熵, 知识新鲜度
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的知识中心通信框架，通过引入数字孪生和贝叶斯融合，有效解决了地月空间通信中固有的延迟和不确定性问题。知识熵和知识新鲜度的定义为量化和管理地月网络中的操作知识提供了新颖的指标。与传统通信方法相比，这种以知识为中心的方法更适合自主决策和动态环境，对于未来月球及深空任务的自主运行具有重要意义。其创新性在于将多源信息融合到统一的知识状态中，并量化其质量，为深空通信领域提供了新的视角。

title: SemBridge: Semantic Token Anchoring for Continuous-Latent Autoregressive Speech Generation
summary: Continuous-latent autoregressive speech generation has emerged as a promising alternative to discrete-token modeling by avoiding quantization loss and preserving richer acoustic information. However, continuous acoustic targets do not expose linguistic structure as explicit token-level prediction targets. Consequently, the autoregressive language model (LM) must acquire linguistic structure indirectly through acoustic prediction, which can compromise the content fidelity of generated speech. We propose SemBridge, a training-only semantic-token anchoring framework for continuous-latent autoregressive speech generation. SemBridge uses discrete semantic tokens to directly supervise autoregressive LM states and employs a Semantic-Aligned Acoustic VAE to organize the continuous target space under the same semantic reference. The semantic supervision is used only during training, while inference remains entirely continuous. We evaluate SemBridge on zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) and score-conditioned singing voice synthesis (SVS). Across multiple benchmarks, SemBridge improves content accuracy, as measured by word and character error rates (WER/CER), while maintaining competitive speaker similarity and perceptual quality. Experimental results demonstrate that explicit semantic-token supervision for autoregressive state learning is an effective and general direction for continuous speech generation. The model code and checkpoints will be available at https://github.com/ASLP-lab/SemBridge

AI.title_translation: SemBridge：用于连续潜在自回归语音生成中的语义token锚定
AI.tldr: SemBridge 提出了一种训练时使用语义token锚定的框架，用于连续潜在自回归语音生成。它通过直接监督语言模型状态和组织声学空间来提高生成语音的内容准确性，同时保持音色和感知质量。
AI.motivation: 连续潜在自回归语音生成虽然避免了量化损失并保留了更丰富的声学信息，但其连续的声学目标未能显式地暴露语言结构。这导致自回归语言模型必须间接地通过声学预测来获取语言结构，从而损害生成语音的内容保真度。
AI.method: 提出 SemBridge 框架，这是一种仅在训练阶段使用的语义token锚定框架。它使用离散语义token直接监督自回归语言模型状态，并采用语义对齐声学变分自编码器（Semantic-Aligned Acoustic VAE）在相同的语义参考下组织连续目标空间。语义监督仅用于训练，推理阶段完全保持连续。
AI.result: 在零样本文本到语音（TTS）和乐谱条件歌声合成（SVS）任务上进行评估。在多个基准测试中，SemBridge 提高了内容准确性（通过词错误率和字符错误率衡量），同时保持了具有竞争力的说话人相似度和感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，对自回归状态学习进行显式语义token监督是连续语音生成一个有效且通用的方向。
AI.translation: 连续潜在自回归语音生成已成为离散token建模的一个有前景的替代方案，它避免了量化损失并保留了更丰富的声学信息。然而，连续的声学目标未能像显式token级预测目标那样暴露语言结构。因此，自回归语言模型（LM）必须通过声学预测间接地获取语言结构，这可能会损害生成语音的内容保真度。我们提出了 SemBridge，一个用于连续潜在自回归语音生成的仅训练阶段的语义token锚定框架。SemBridge 使用离散语义token直接监督自回归语言模型状态，并采用语义对齐声学变分自编码器（Semantic-Aligned Acoustic VAE）在相同的语义参考下组织连续目标空间。语义监督仅在训练期间使用，而推理则完全保持连续。我们在零样本文本到语音（TTS）和乐谱条件歌声合成（SVS）任务上评估了 SemBridge。在多个基准测试中，SemBridge 提高了内容准确性（通过词错误率和字符错误率（WER/CER）衡量），同时保持了具有竞争力的说话人相似度和感知质量。实验结果表明，对自回归状态学习进行显式语义token监督是连续语音生成一个有效且通用的方向。模型代码和检查点将在 https://github.com/ASLP-lab/SemBridge 上提供。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 SemBridge 框架，旨在解决连续潜在自回归语音生成中内容保真度受损的问题。该框架通过在训练阶段使用离散语义token直接监督自回归语言模型状态，并结合语义对齐声学变分自编码器来组织连续声学空间，从而在推理时保持完全连续性。实验证明，SemBridge 在零样本 TTS 和 SVS 任务上显著提高了生成语音的内容准确性，同时维持了良好的说话人相似度和感知质量，验证了显式语义token监督在连续语音生成中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 连续潜在语音生成, 语义token锚定, 自回归语言模型, 文本到语音, 歌声合成
AI.comments: SemBridge 的创新之处在于将离散语义token的监督引入到连续潜在自回归语音生成框架中，从而弥补了连续目标缺乏显式语言结构的问题。这种训练时监督、推理时连续的策略，在不牺牲连续模型优势的同时，显著提升了生成语音的内容准确性，为未来的连续语音合成研究提供了有价值的方向。

title: Low-complexity Soft-decision LLR Calculations for Next-generation IM-DD Systems with RIN
summary: The demand for higher speeds in intra-data center interconnects will eventually require high-order pulse amplitude modulation (PAM) combined with soft-decision (SD) forward error correction (FEC). The laser relative intensity noise (RIN) is an important noise impairment that limits the performance of high-speed intensity-modulation (IM) and direct-detection (DD) systems, as it induces a channel with signal-dependent noise. In this paper, we show that an accurate calculation of the log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) is critical for the performance of the SD-FEC decoder in RIN-dominated IM-DD systems. First, we show that assuming signal-independent additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) statistics to compute LLRs results in a significant penalty in performance. As an alternative, we propose a low-complexity piecewise linear approximation of the exact LLRs of Gray-coded PAM-4 and PAM-8 for the RIN-dominated IM-DD channel. We show using the generalized mutual information that our approximation results in no performance loss versus using exact LLRs, unlike the AWGN-like assumption. Furthermore, we validate the analysis with bit error rate (BER) performance of SD decoding. We show that our approximation matches the BERs achieved using exact LLRs. Therefore, our approximation avoids a BER error floor penalty of up to 7.2 times using an extended Hamming code with PAM-4, and up to 2.41 dB of optical modulation amplitude penalty using high-code-rate low-density parity-check codes with PAM-8 for the same target BER.

AI.title_translation: 面向下一代含RIN的IM-DD系统的低复杂度软判决LLR计算
AI.tldr: 在RIN主导的IM-DD系统中，精确的LLR计算对SD-FEC性能至关重要。本文提出了一种低复杂度的分段线性近似方法，其性能与精确LLR相当，并显著优于AWGN假设，从而避免了性能损失。
AI.motivation: 数据中心内部互连对更高速度的需求推动了高阶PAM结合SD-FEC的应用。激光相对强度噪声（RIN）是限制高速IM-DD系统性能的重要噪声源，因为它引入了信号相关噪声。在RIN主导的IM-DD系统中，LLR的精确计算对于SD-FEC解码器的性能至关重要，而假设信号独立AWGN会导致显著的性能下降。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种低复杂度的分段线性近似方法，用于RIN主导的IM-DD信道中格雷码PAM-4和PAM-8的精确LLRs。通过广义互信息和SD解码的误码率（BER）性能验证了该方法。
AI.result: 假设信号独立AWGN计算LLRs会导致显著的性能损失。所提出的分段线性近似方法与使用精确LLRs相比没有性能损失，这与AWGN类假设不同。该近似方法与使用精确LLRs所达到的BER相匹配。它避免了使用带PAM-4的扩展汉明码高达7.2倍的BER误码平层惩罚，以及使用带PAM-8的高码率低密度奇偶校验码在相同目标BER下高达2.41 dB的光调制幅度惩罚。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的针对RIN主导的IM-DD系统的低复杂度LLR分段线性近似方法是有效的。它能够准确计算LLRs，性能与精确LLRs相匹配，并显著优于AWGN类假设，从而避免了下一代高速互连中显著的性能损失（BER误码平层和OMA惩罚）。
AI.translation: 数据中心内部互连对更高速度的需求最终将需要高阶脉冲幅度调制（PAM）结合软判决（SD）前向纠错（FEC）。激光相对强度噪声（RIN）是一个重要的噪声损伤，它限制了高速强度调制（IM）和直接检测（DD）系统的性能，因为它会引入一个具有信号相关噪声的信道。在本文中，我们表明对数似然比（LLRs）的精确计算对于RIN主导的IM-DD系统中SD-FEC解码器的性能至关重要。首先，我们表明假设信号独立加性高斯白噪声（AWGN）统计量来计算LLRs会导致显著的性能损失。作为替代方案，我们提出了一种低复杂度的分段线性近似方法，用于RIN主导的IM-DD信道中格雷码PAM-4和PAM-8的精确LLRs。我们使用广义互信息表明，与AWGN类假设不同，我们的近似方法与使用精确LLRs相比没有性能损失。此外，我们通过SD解码的误码率（BER）性能验证了分析。我们表明，我们的近似方法与使用精确LLRs所达到的BER相匹配。因此，我们的近似方法避免了使用带PAM-4的扩展汉明码高达7.2倍的BER误码平层惩罚，以及使用带PAM-8的高码率低密度奇偶校验码在相同目标BER下高达2.41 dB的光调制幅度惩罚。
AI.summary: 本文针对下一代高速强度调制和直接检测（IM-DD）系统，特别是受激光相对强度噪声（RIN）影响的系统，解决了精确对数似然比（LLR）计算的关键需求。研究表明，假设信号独立加性高斯白噪声（AWGN）进行LLR计算会导致显著的性能下降。为解决此问题，作者提出了一种低复杂度的分段线性近似方法，用于RIN主导的IM-DD信道中格雷码PAM-4和PAM-8的精确LLRs。通过广义互信息和误码率（BER）性能评估表明，该近似方法达到了与精确LLR相当的性能，优于基于AWGN的假设。所提出的方法有效避免了显著的性能损失，包括BER误码平层和光调制幅度惩罚，这对于未来的数据中心内部互连至关重要。
AI.keywords: IM-DD, RIN, LLRs, 软判决FEC, PAM
AI.comments: 本文为高速光通信系统中的一个关键问题提供了一个创新且实用的解决方案。其主要创新在于开发了一种低复杂度的LLR分段线性近似方法，该方法准确地考虑了信号相关的RIN，这与传统的AWGN假设显著不同。数据中心对更高速度的需求以及RIN成为限制因素，凸显了该方法的重要性。通过避免显著的BER误码平层和OMA惩罚，该方法为在下一代IM-DD系统中实现软判决FEC提供了一条可行的途径，有望降低硬件复杂性并提高系统效率。通过广义互信息和BER性能进行的验证进一步增强了其主张。

title: Exact Decomposition of Value Functions for Two-Player Games in Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability
summary: Hamilton-Jacobi reachability (HJR) is an important framework in safe control theory. HJR provides theoretical tools and numerical methods to obtain value-functions for tasks involving target-reaching and obstacle-avoidance. A recent work proposed an algebraic framework to scale to complex, composite tasks via decomposing the value functions of the composite tasks into value functions for the fundamental tasks traditionally studied in HJR, all in the one-player setting. Many of these decomposition results, however, do not directly translate to the two-player setting. In this technical note, we nevertheless show that one of the previous work's key results for analyzing various tasks involving reaching multiple targets while obeying constraints still holds in the two-player setting, so long as a critical monotonicity assumption is satisfied. In particular, we detail the analogous result and its proof (which structurally differs from the one-player case), we show via a counter-example what can go wrong if this monotonicity assumption is not satisfied, and we show how the analysis of a variety of tasks can be performed using this result. Such tasks include sequential and any-order multi-target-reaching tasks under constraints. We note that, whereas the prior work considered discrete-time, infinite-horizon tasks, which are more standard in reinforcement learning, we here consider continuous-time, finite-horizon tasks, which are more standard in HJR.

AI.title_translation: 汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性中双人博弈价值函数的精确分解
AI.tldr: 本文证明了在满足关键单调性假设的前提下，之前在单人设置中用于分析多目标到达任务的价值函数分解结果在双人博弈的汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性中仍然成立。
AI.motivation: 之前的价值函数分解方法主要针对单人设置，但许多结果无法直接应用于双人博弈。本文旨在证明在双人博弈背景下，一个关键的、涉及多目标到达和约束的分解结果在满足特定单调性假设时仍然有效。
AI.method: 详细阐述了在双人设置下的类比结果及其证明（结构上与单人情况不同），通过反例说明了当单调性假设不满足时可能出现的问题，并展示了如何利用该结果分析各种任务，包括顺序和任意顺序的多目标到达任务。
AI.result: 证明了在满足关键单调性假设的前提下，之前针对单人设置中分析多目标到达和约束任务的关键分解结果在双人博弈设置中依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地将汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性中价值函数分解的关键结果扩展到双人博弈，强调了单调性假设的重要性，并为分析复杂的双人任务提供了工具。
AI.translation: 汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性（HJR）是安全控制理论中的一个重要框架。HJR提供了理论工具和数值方法来获取涉及目标到达和避障任务的价值函数。最近的一项工作提出了一个代数框架，通过将复合任务的价值函数分解为HJR中传统研究的基本任务的价值函数，从而扩展到复杂的复合任务，所有这些都在单人设置中。然而，这些分解结果中的许多不能直接转化为双人设置。在这篇技术笔记中，我们 nevertheless 展示了之前工作中用于分析涉及在遵守约束的同时到达多个目标的各种任务的关键结果之一在双人设置中仍然成立，只要满足一个关键的单调性假设。特别是，我们详细说明了类比结果及其证明（其结构与单人情况不同），我们通过一个反例展示了如果该单调性假设不满足可能出现的问题，并且我们展示了如何使用该结果执行各种任务的分析。此类任务包括约束下的顺序和任意顺序的多目标到达任务。我们注意到，尽管之前的工作考虑了离散时间、无限视野任务（这在强化学习中更为标准），但我们在这里考虑了连续时间、有限视野任务（这在HJR中更为标准）。
AI.summary: 本技术笔记探讨了在汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性（HJR）框架下，如何将单人博弈中价值函数分解的关键结果推广到双人博弈。文章证明了只要满足一个关键的单调性假设，用于分析多目标到达和约束任务的分解结果在双人设置中依然有效。论文详细阐述了双人设置下的证明（与单人情况结构不同），并通过反例强调了单调性假设的重要性，同时展示了该结果在分析多种复杂任务中的应用，例如顺序或任意顺序的多目标到达任务。与前人工作不同，本文关注HJR中更常见的连续时间、有限视野任务。
AI.keywords: 汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性, 价值函数分解, 双人博弈, 单调性假设, 安全控制
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将HJR中价值函数分解的关键理论从单人扩展到双人博弈，填补了该领域的一个空白。强调单调性假设的重要性及其对结果有效性的影响，并通过反例进行说明，增加了论证的严谨性。将分析从离散时间、无限视野转向连续时间、有限视野，使其更符合HJR的传统研究范式，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Symbol-Domain Chase Combining on Fourier-Curve Constellations: Exact Identities and Penalties of Per-Round Bit Reduction
summary: A Fourier-curve constellation adds artificial noise along the tangent at the transmitted symbol, giving each symbol candidate its own rank-one noise covariance. A Chase retransmission repeats such a symbol, and the receiver can either accumulate the candidate metrics before forming bit log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) or add bit LLRs formed in every round. The rounds are independent given the symbol but not necessarily given one label bit, so summed exact per-round LLRs do not in general equal the joint LLR. For a fixed labeling, equiprobable symbols, and conditionally independent rounds, we derive exact identities for this difference under exact and max-log reduction, with equality conditions: each difference equals the gap between two nonnegative class corrections, which are nondecreasing in the number of rounds and vanish for binary signaling. With a rate-1/2 LDPC code after four rounds, the per-round matched Fourier receiver needs 1.97 dB more per-slot SNR at block error rate 0.1 than the covariance-ignorant joint Euclidean receiver. After four rounds, per-round exact reduction costs 2.7 dB on the Fourier link and 1.5 dB on Gray 64-QAM in bit-metric generalized mutual information, and 1.6 dB in block error rate with a 5G NR LDPC code, whereas joint max-log reduction costs less than 0.1 dB. Controls with Gray labeling, isotropic noise, and no tangent noise show that this loss does not require candidate-dependent covariance. The Fourier receiver should therefore accumulate the matched candidate metrics and reduce them to bits at each decoding attempt.

AI.title_translation: 傅里叶曲线星座上的符号域Chase合并：逐轮比特削减的精确恒等式与代价
AI.tldr: 本文分析了傅里叶曲线星座上的Chase合并策略，推导了逐轮LLR求和与联合LLR之间的精确差异恒等式，并量化了逐轮比特削减相对于联合处理的性能损失。研究发现逐轮精确削减会带来显著的性能开销，并建议傅里叶接收器应累积匹配的候选度量。
AI.motivation: 研究傅里叶曲线星座下不同Chase合并策略（累积候选度量或逐轮添加比特LLR）的性能影响，特别是由于各轮在给定符号下独立但在给定标签比特下不一定独立时，量化精确的差异和性能损失。
AI.method: 本文推导了在固定标签、等概率符号和条件独立轮次条件下，精确和最大对数削减下，逐轮LLR求和与联合LLR之间差异的精确恒等式。通过使用速率为1/2的LDPC码进行仿真，计算了信噪比惩罚、比特度量广义互信息和误块率损失。同时，通过格雷标签、各向同性噪声和无切线噪声的对照实验进行了验证。
AI.result: 1. 推导了逐轮LLR求和与联合LLR之间差异的精确恒等式，表明该差异等于两个非负类别校正之间的差距，这些校正随轮次数量非递减，并在二进制信号中消失。2. 对于四轮后的速率为1/2的LDPC码，在误块率为0.1时，逐轮匹配的傅里叶接收器比忽略协方差的联合欧几里得接收器需要高1.97 dB的每时隙信噪比。3. 四轮后，逐轮精确削减在比特度量广义互信息方面，傅里叶链路损失2.7 dB，格雷64-QAM损失1.5 dB；在使用5G NR LDPC码时，误块率损失1.6 dB。4. 联合最大对数削减的损失小于0.1 dB。5. 损失不要求候选依赖的协方差。
AI.conclusion: 傅里叶接收器应在每次解码尝试时累积匹配的候选度量，并将其削减为比特，因为逐轮比特削减（特别是精确削减）会带来显著的性能损失。
AI.translation: 傅里叶曲线星座在发射符号的切线方向上添加人工噪声，使每个符号候选具有自己的秩一噪声协方差。Chase重传重复此类符号，接收器可以先累积候选度量再形成比特对数似然比（LLR），或者在每一轮中添加形成的比特LLR。在给定符号的情况下，各轮是独立的，但在给定一个标签比特的情况下则不一定，因此求和的精确逐轮LLR通常不等于联合LLR。对于固定的标签、等概率符号和条件独立的轮次，我们在精确和最大对数削减下推导出这种差异的精确恒等式，并给出相等条件：每个差异等于两个非负类别校正之间的差距，这些校正随轮次数量非递减，并在二进制信号中消失。对于四轮后的速率为1/2的LDPC码，在误块率为0.1时，逐轮匹配的傅里叶接收器比忽略协方差的联合欧几里得接收器需要高1.97 dB的每时隙信噪比。四轮后，逐轮精确削减在比特度量广义互信息方面，傅里叶链路损失2.7 dB，格雷64-QAM损失1.5 dB；在使用5G NR LDPC码时，误块率损失1.6 dB；而联合最大对数削减的损失小于0.1 dB。采用格雷标签、各向同性噪声和无切线噪声的对照实验表明，这种损失不需要候选依赖的协方差。因此，傅里叶接收器应在每次解码尝试时累积匹配的候选度量并将其削减为比特。
AI.summary: 本文研究了傅里叶曲线星座上的Chase合并策略，该星座引入了秩一噪声协方差。文章推导了逐轮比特LLR求和与联合LLR之间性能差异的精确恒等式，结果表明逐轮精确削减会带来显著的性能损失（例如，在广义互信息中损失2.7 dB，在误块率中损失1.6 dB），而联合最大对数削减的损失微乎其微。研究得出结论，傅里叶接收器在解码时应在形成比特LLR之前累积匹配的候选度量。
AI.keywords: 傅里叶曲线星座, Chase合并, LLR, 比特削减, LDPC码
AI.comments: 该论文通过推导傅里叶曲线星座下Chase合并中LLR差异的精确恒等式，提供了详细的理论分析。它量化了逐轮比特削减带来的巨大性能损失，为接收器设计提供了明确指导。精确削减和最大对数削减之间的区别，以及观察到的损失不一定需要候选依赖协方差的发现，是重要的贡献。对5G NR LDPC码的实际意义也很有价值。

title: A Foundation Model for Large-Scale Wireless Network Planning , Operation and Optimization
summary: Wireless cellular networks form the connective tissue of human society, sustained by a continuous physical dialogue between engineered infrastructure and its surroundings. Radio signals emitted from base stations traverse terrain, diffract around buildings and scatter through streets before reaching billions of users. Together, these interactions produce the city-wide radio environment on which every network decision rests. Shaping this environment through deployment and optimization determines the connectivity societies rely on, yet learning it effectively at city scale and generalizing across diverse cities and deployments remain open challenges. Here we answer positively by introducing ChaRT, a foundation model that learns transferable radio representations from measurement reports generated by deployed cellular networks. These reports provide abundant multi-cell, multi-beam observations without dedicated campaigns, forming a scalable data foundation for city-scale learning. ChaRT embeds beam-level angular structure, network hierarchy and propagation-regime diversity in its architecture, and is pretrained through context-aware masked beam modelling and self-distillation with channel-model-constrained augmentation. We pretrain ChaRT on over one billion reports comprising 18.2 billion beam-level observations from 3,503 cells in one city. With a single set of weights, ChaRT reconstructs radio environments in unseen cities and transfers to radio map construction, new-site prediction and network parameter tuning. With only 1% of labelled data, it supports user localization, beam prediction, propagation scenario classification and estimation of the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio. The learned representation further enables beamspace clustering for reusable radio-grid construction. These results establish ChaRT as a transferable foundation for network-wide intelligence.

AI.title_translation: 大规模无线网络规划、运营和优化的基础模型
AI.tldr: ChaRT是一个基础模型，通过学习蜂窝网络测量报告中的无线电表示，解决了城市尺度下无线电环境学习和泛化的挑战，并能应用于多种网络任务。
AI.motivation: 无线蜂窝网络构成了人类社会的连接组织，但有效学习城市尺度的无线电环境并泛化到不同城市和部署仍然是开放挑战。
AI.method: 引入了ChaRT，一个基础模型，它从已部署蜂窝网络生成的测量报告中学习可迁移的无线电表示。ChaRT在其架构中嵌入了波束级角度结构、网络层次和传播机制多样性，并通过上下文感知掩蔽波束建模和通道模型约束增强的自蒸馏进行预训练。
AI.result: ChaRT在未见过的城市中重建无线电环境，并可迁移到无线电地图构建、新站点预测和网络参数调优。仅用1%的标记数据，它支持用户定位、波束预测、传播场景分类和信噪比估计。学习到的表示还支持用于可重用无线电网格构建的波束空间聚类。
AI.conclusion: ChaRT为网络范围内的智能提供了可迁移的基础。
AI.translation: 无线蜂窝网络构成了人类社会的连接组织，通过工程基础设施与其环境之间持续的物理对话得以维持。从基站发出的无线电信号穿过地形，绕过建筑物衍射，并散布在街道上，最终到达数十亿用户。这些相互作用共同产生了每个网络决策所依赖的城市范围的无线电环境。通过部署和优化来塑造这种环境决定了社会所依赖的连接性，然而，在城市尺度上有效地学习它并泛化到不同的城市和部署仍然是开放的挑战。我们通过引入ChaRT积极回应，它是一个基础模型，从已部署蜂窝网络生成的测量报告中学习可迁移的无线电表示。这些报告提供了丰富的多小区、多波束观测数据，无需专门的活动，为城市尺度的学习奠定了可扩展的数据基础。ChaRT在其架构中嵌入了波束级角度结构、网络层次和传播机制多样性，并通过上下文感知掩蔽波束建模和通道模型约束增强的自蒸馏进行预训练。我们在一个城市中对超过10亿份报告（包含3,503个小区的182亿个波束级观测数据）进行了ChaRT的预训练。ChaRT以一套权重在未见过的城市中重建无线电环境，并可迁移到无线电地图构建、新站点预测和网络参数调优。仅用1%的标记数据，它支持用户定位、波束预测、传播场景分类和信噪比（SINR）估计。学习到的表示进一步支持用于可重用无线电网格构建的波束空间聚类。这些结果确立了ChaRT作为网络范围内智能的可迁移基础。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个名为ChaRT的基础模型，旨在解决大规模无线网络规划、运营和优化中无线电环境学习和泛化的挑战。ChaRT通过从蜂窝网络测量报告中学习可迁移的无线电表示，利用多小区、多波束观测数据。该模型在架构中整合了波束级角度结构、网络层次和传播机制多样性，并通过特定的预训练策略进行训练。实验结果表明，ChaRT能够重建未见城市的无线电环境，并成功应用于无线电地图构建、新站点预测、网络参数调优以及在少量标记数据下实现用户定位、波束预测等多种网络任务，从而为网络智能提供了可迁移的基础。
AI.keywords: 基础模型, 无线网络, 网络规划, 无线电环境, 机器学习
AI.comments: ChaRT的创新之处在于其作为无线网络领域的基础模型，能够从现有的网络测量报告中学习可迁移的无线电表示，无需专门的数据采集活动，解决了大规模无线电环境学习和泛化的痛点。其能力覆盖了从环境重建到多种具体网络任务，展现了强大的通用性和数据效率，对未来无线网络智能化具有重要意义。

title: Compression Hurts, Pooling Helps: Information Loss in Rayleigh-Scale Estimation from B-Mode Ultrasound
summary: Clinical B-mode images are widely available as potential data sources for quantitative ultrasound (QUS) analysis for tissue characterization. However, standard clinical ultrasound devices apply unknown log-compression to RF envelope data before display and storage. Previous work has demonstrated estimation of the underlying RF envelope statistics in the presence of an unknown compression law. Using Fisher information analysis, we show that finite-offset log compression causes severe information loss when estimating the Rayleigh scale $σ$, which controls diffuse speckle. For a single image window, unknown compression raises the minimum achievable variance for unbiased estimation of $σ$ by a compression-independent factor of approximately 34.98. When $M$ equal-sized windows share the same unknown compression settings, the excess variance decays as $1/M$; even in the most favorable regime, reducing the variance inflation factor below 1.1 requires 340 windows. Our analysis treats the contrast parameter $a$ as unknown and the boundary offset $b$ as known; estimating $b$ experimentally shows even larger variance. We validate this theory using synthetic estimation experiments and demonstrate RF-scale recovery on real RF-envelope windows from the OASBUD dataset. Together, these results clarify the limitations of using routine B-mode images for QUS.

AI.title_translation: 压缩有害，池化有益：B超瑞利尺度估计中的信息丢失
AI.tldr: B超图像的对数压缩会导致瑞利尺度估计产生严重的信息丢失和方差膨胀，而通过多个窗口的池化可以缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 临床B-mode图像常用于定量超声（QUS）分析以进行组织表征，但标准超声设备在显示和存储前会施加未知的对数压缩，这可能导致信息丢失。本研究旨在通过分析揭示对数压缩对瑞利尺度估计的影响及局限性。
AI.method: 采用Fisher信息分析方法，在假设对比参数未知且边界偏移已知的条件下，计算未知对数压缩下瑞利尺度估计的最小可达方差，并通过合成估计实验和OASBUD数据集的真实RF包络窗口进行了理论验证。
AI.result: 研究表明，未知压缩将估计瑞利尺度的最小方差提高了约34.98倍；当M个窗口共享未知压缩设置时，多余方差随1/M衰减，要将方差膨胀因子降至1.1以下需要340个窗口。实验验证了这一理论。
AI.conclusion: 对数压缩会导致瑞利尺度估计的方差显著膨胀，需要大量窗口进行池化才能降低这种影响，这明确了利用常规B超图像进行定量超声分析的局限性。
AI.translation: 临床B-mode图像作为潜在的数据源，被广泛用于定量超声（QUS）分析以进行组织表征。然而，标准的临床超声设备在显示和存储之前，会对RF包络数据应用未知的对数压缩。先前的研究证明了在存在未知压缩规律的情况下，对底层RF包络统计量的估计。通过Fisher信息分析，我们表明在估计控制漫反射散斑的瑞利尺度$\sigma$时，有限偏移对数压缩会导致严重的信息损失。对于单个图像窗口，未知的压缩将无偏估计$\sigma$的最小可实现方差提高了约34.98倍（与压缩无关的因子）。当$M$个大小相同的窗口共享相同的未知压缩设置时，超额方差以$1/M$的速度衰减；即使在最有利的范围内，也将方差膨胀因子降至1.1以下需要340个窗口。我们的分析将对比参数$a$视为未知，边界偏移$b$视为已知；实验估计$b$显示出更大的方差。我们使用合成估计实验验证了该理论，并展示了OASBUD数据集中真实RF包络窗口的RF尺度恢复。总之，这些结果阐明了使用常规B模式图像进行QUS的局限性。
AI.summary: 本研究通过Fisher信息分析，探讨了B超图像中有限偏移对数压缩对瑞利尺度估计的信息损失影响，发现对数压缩会导致严重的方差膨胀，而通过多个窗口池化可以缓解该问题，并通过合成实验和真实数据集验证了结论。
AI.keywords: 定量超声, B超图像, 对数压缩, 瑞利尺度估计, Fisher信息分析
AI.comments: 该论文从Fisher信息分析的角度定量揭示了B超图像中对数压缩对瑞利尺度估计造成的严重信息损失，并指出池化（多窗口共享参数）有助于缓解这一问题，对定量超声（QUS）领域的临床数据利用具有重要指导意义。

title: Forecasting Brain Tracer Distribution from Pre-Contrast MRI: A Comparison of Direct Regression and Flow Matching
summary: Intrathecal contrast-enhanced MRI shows how a tracer injected into the cerebrospinal fluid spreads through the brain, but requires repeated scans over 24--48\,h. We therefore ask how much of the later tracer distribution can be predicted from the pre-contrast scan and elapsed time alone. Using 104 training patients (878 MRI volumes), we compared a direct image-to-image regression model with a more complex generative model based on conditional flow matching, and tested both on 23 held-out patients and on 51 patients from a separate cohort with idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus (INPH). The direct model reduced the error of simply copying the pre-contrast scan by about 60\% in held-out patients and 25\% in the INPH cohort, and its predicted change maps agreed with the observed tracer enhancement rather than only reproducing anatomy. The generative model was less accurate in both cohorts. A substantial part of the later tracer distribution is therefore predictable from the patient's brain anatomy as seen on pre-contrast MRI, and the added model complexity gave no benefit at this data scale. With prospective validation, such forecasts could be studied for patient stratification and treatment planning in intrathecal therapies.

AI.title_translation: 从对比前MRI预测脑示踪剂分布：直接回归与流匹配的比较
AI.tldr: 研究表明，从对比前MRI和时间可以有效预测脑示踪剂的后期分布，其中直接图像到图像回归模型表现优于更复杂的生成模型。
AI.motivation: 鞘内对比增强MRI需要24-48小时的重复扫描，耗时且不便。本研究旨在探索是否可以仅凭对比前扫描和已逝时间来预测后期的示踪剂分布，以减少扫描次数和患者负担。
AI.method: 研究使用了104名训练患者（878个MRI体积）的数据。比较了两种模型：直接图像到图像回归模型和基于条件流匹配的生成模型。模型在23名独立患者和51名特发性正常压力脑积水（INPH）队列患者上进行了测试。
AI.result: 直接模型在独立患者中将误差降低了约60%，在INPH队列中降低了25%，并且其预测的变化图与观察到的示踪剂增强一致。生成模型在两个队列中均不准确。结果表明，后期示踪剂分布的很大一部分可以从对比前MRI中看到的患者脑解剖结构预测，且增加模型复杂性在此数据规模下没有带来益处。
AI.conclusion: 脑示踪剂的后期分布可以从患者的对比前MRI图像和时间中有效预测，其中直接回归模型表现良好，而增加模型复杂性在此数据规模下未能提供额外优势。未来，此类预测有望用于鞘内治疗中的患者分层和治疗计划。
AI.translation: 鞘内对比增强MRI显示了注入脑脊液的示踪剂如何在脑部扩散，但这需要24-48小时内的重复扫描。因此，我们提出一个问题：仅凭对比前扫描和已逝时间，能在多大程度上预测后期的示踪剂分布。我们使用104名训练患者（878个MRI体积），比较了直接的图像到图像回归模型与基于条件流匹配的更复杂的生成模型，并在23名独立患者和51名来自独立特发性正常压力脑积水（INPH）队列的患者上进行了测试。直接模型将简单复制对比前扫描的误差在独立患者中减少了约60%，在INPH队列中减少了25%，并且其预测的变化图与观察到的示踪剂增强一致，而不仅仅是复制解剖结构。生成模型在两个队列中准确性较低。因此，后期示踪剂分布的很大一部分可以从对比前MRI中看到的患者脑解剖结构预测，并且在此数据规模下，增加模型复杂性并未带来益处。通过前瞻性验证，此类预测可用于鞘内治疗中的患者分层和治疗计划研究。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在探索如何仅凭对比前MRI和时间来预测脑示踪剂的后期分布，以减少鞘内对比增强MRI的重复扫描需求。研究比较了直接图像到图像回归模型与基于条件流匹配的生成模型，并在多个患者队列中进行了测试。结果显示，直接回归模型在预测示踪剂分布方面表现出色，显著降低了误差，且其预测的变化图与实际示踪剂增强一致。相比之下，更复杂的生成模型效果不佳。这表明，大部分后期示踪剂分布可以通过对比前MRI预测，且在当前数据规模下，模型复杂性并未带来额外优势。这些预测有望应用于未来的患者分层和治疗计划。
AI.keywords: 脑示踪剂分布预测, 对比前MRI, 直接回归, 流匹配, 鞘内治疗
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新点在于探索了从单一对比前MRI预测动态示踪剂分布的可能性，有望减少患者的扫描负担。其重要性在于为鞘内治疗中的患者分层和治疗计划提供了潜在的新工具。研究结果表明，简单的直接回归模型在当前数据规模下表现优于复杂的生成模型，这为实际应用提供了更经济有效的方案。局限性可能在于其目前的验证仅限于回顾性数据，需要进一步的前瞻性验证。

title: Robust High-Dimensional MVDR Beamforming under Heavy-Tailed Noise via Spiked Covariance Modeling
summary: This paper proposes a robust high-dimensional minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamforming method for array observations corrupted by heavy-tailed noise. The proposed approach constructs an MVDR-oriented precision matrix estimator by combining Maronna's robust scatter estimator with spiked covariance modeling. Using tools from random matrix theory, we derive a deterministic equivalent of the MVDR output power and obtain asymptotically optimal shrinkage weights for the dominant signal subspace. A fully sample-based implementation is then developed for practical beamformer design. Numerical simulations under elliptically distributed noise demonstrate that the proposed beamformer achieves stronger interference suppression and higher output SINR than competing methods in high-dimensional and implusive noise regimes.

AI.title_translation: 鲁棒高维MVDR波束形成在尖峰协方差建模下的重尾噪声
AI.tldr: 提出一种鲁棒的高维MVDR波束形成方法，用于处理重尾噪声污染的阵列观测。该方法结合了Maronna的鲁棒散布估计器和尖峰协方差建模，利用随机矩阵理论推导了MVDR输出功率的确定性等价式，并获得了主信号子空间的最优收缩权重。最终的样本实现适用于实际波束形成器设计。仿真结果表明，该方法在重尾噪声和高维场景下具有更强的干扰抑制能力和更高的输出信干比。
AI.motivation: 在存在重尾噪声的情况下，开发一种能够处理高维数据的鲁棒MVDR波束形成方法。
AI.method: 结合Maronna的鲁棒散布估计器和尖峰协方差建模来构建面向MVDR的精度矩阵估计器。利用随机矩阵理论推导MVDR输出功率的确定性等价式，并获得主信号子空间的最优收缩权重。最后，开发了一个完全基于样本的实现。
AI.result: 在椭圆分布噪声下进行的数值模拟表明，与现有方法相比，所提出的波束形成器在高维和脉冲噪声情况下实现了更强的干扰抑制和更高的输出信干比。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在高维和重尾噪声环境下实现了鲁棒的MVDR波束形成，并在仿真中优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的高维最小方差无畸变响应（MVDR）波束形成方法，用于处理受重尾噪声污染的阵列观测。所提出的方法通过结合Maronna的鲁棒散布估计器和尖峰协方差建模来构建面向MVDR的精度矩阵估计器。利用随机矩阵理论的工具，我们推导了MVDR输出功率的确定性等价式，并获得了主信号子空间的最优收缩权重。然后，开发了一个完全基于样本的实现，用于实际的波束形成器设计。在椭圆分布噪声下的数值模拟表明，与现有方法相比，所提出的波束形成器在高维和脉冲噪声情况下实现了更强的干扰抑制和更高的输出信干比。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的鲁棒高维MVDR波束形成技术，旨在解决重尾噪声对阵列观测的影响。该方法通过整合Maronna的鲁棒散布估计器和尖峰协方差建模来构建MVDR精度矩阵估计器。利用随机矩阵理论，推导了MVDR输出功率的确定性等价式，并为信号子空间确定了最优收缩权重。最终的样本实现便于实际应用。仿真结果证明了该方法在高维和脉冲噪声环境下的优越性能，表现为更强的干扰抑制能力和更高的输出信干比。
AI.keywords: MVDR波束形成,重尾噪声,高维数据,尖峰协方差建模,鲁棒统计
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种在高维和重尾噪声环境下提高MVDR波束形成鲁棒性的新颖方法。通过结合鲁棒统计和随机矩阵理论，该方法在理论上和实践上都有显著的贡献。然而，该方法在实际应用中的计算复杂度和对噪声分布模型的依赖性可能需要进一步研究。

title: Curv-Tail: Lightweight Long-Tailed Encrypted Traffic Classification with Discrete Packet-Length Encoding and Lorentz Prototypes
summary: Long-tailed encrypted traffic classification requires accurate recognition of infrequent classes under limited computational budgets. We propose Curv-Tail, a lightweight, end-to-end packet--byte framework trained without a separate pretraining stage. Mixed-resolution tokenization preserves exact packet-length identities within a bounded range and coarsens larger values to limit the vocabulary. An auxiliary objective predicts observed length tokens from contextual packet features before pooling, encouraging length-token retention beyond flow-level supervision. Compact temporal encoders process packet sequences and directional byte patches, and Lorentz prototypes with a shared learnable curvature magnitude classify their fused representation. On NUDT-Mobile and DataCon-Website under natural class frequencies, Curv-Tail achieves three-seed mean Tail-F1 scores of 85.70% and 46.30%, exceeding the strongest evaluated baselines by 2.91 and 1.89 percentage points, respectively. In 300-class profiling on an RTX 4090 with FP32 and batch size 256, Curv-Tail uses 98.48% fewer parameters and achieves 10.2 times the batch inference throughput of MM4Flow.

AI.title_translation: Curv-Tail：基于离散包长编码和洛伦兹原型的轻量级长尾加密流量分类
AI.tldr: Curv-Tail是一种轻量级的端到端加密流量分类框架，通过混合分辨率标记化、辅助目标和洛伦兹原型来有效处理长尾分布，在NUDT-Mobile和DataCon-Website数据集上取得了优于基线模型的性能，并且参数量少、推理吞吐量高。
AI.motivation: 长尾加密流量分类需要在有限的计算预算下准确识别不频繁的类别。
AI.method: Curv-Tail采用混合分辨率标记化来保留精确的包长信息，并使用辅助目标来鼓励保留长度标记。它还使用紧凑的时间编码器处理包序列和字节块，并结合洛伦兹原型进行分类。
AI.result: 在NUDT-Mobile和DataCon-Website数据集上，Curv-Tail的平均Tail-F1分数分别为85.70%和46.30%，优于最强的基线模型。在300类分类任务中，Curv-Tail的参数量比MM4Flow少98.48%，批处理推理吞吐量高10.2倍。
AI.conclusion: Curv-Tail是一种轻量级的、端到端的长尾加密流量分类方法，在准确性和效率方面均表现出色，能够有效处理不频繁类别并满足计算预算限制。
AI.translation: 长尾加密流量分类需要计算预算有限的情况下准确识别不频繁的类别。我们提出了Curv-Tail，一个轻量级的、端到端的包-字节框架，无需单独的预训练阶段即可进行训练。混合分辨率标记化在有界范围内保留了精确的包长身份，并粗化了较大的值以限制词汇量。辅助目标在池化之前根据上下文包特征预测观察到的长度标记，鼓励长度标记超越流级别监督。紧凑的时间编码器处理包序列和定向字节块，并且具有共享可学习曲率幅度的洛伦兹原型对其融合表示进行分类。在自然类别频率下的NUDT-Mobile和DataCon-Website上，Curv-Tail实现了三种子平均Tail-F1分数分别为85.70%和46.30%，分别比评估的最强基线高2.91和1.89个百分点。在RTX 4090上，使用FP32和批大小256进行300类剖析，Curv-Tail使用的参数比MM4Flow少98.48%，批处理推理吞吐量是MM4Flow的10.2倍。
AI.summary: Curv-Tail是一种新颖的轻量级加密流量分类框架，它通过离散包长编码和洛伦兹原型来解决长尾分布问题。该方法采用混合分辨率标记化和辅助目标来有效捕捉包长信息，并利用紧凑的时间编码器和洛伦兹原型进行高效分类。实验结果表明，Curv-Tail在准确性和效率方面均优于现有方法，尤其是在处理不频繁类别时。
AI.keywords: 加密流量分类,长尾分布,包长编码,洛伦兹原型,轻量级框架
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的轻量级加密流量分类方法Curv-Tail，特别关注长尾分布问题。其混合分辨率标记化和洛伦兹原型设计在保留关键信息和提高效率方面具有潜力。然而，在实际部署中的鲁棒性和可解释性仍需进一步研究。

title: A Geometric Decision Procedure for STL Feasibility and Repair
summary:
Feasibility of a Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specification asks
  whether, from a given initial state, an admissible control input can
  satisfy its continuous-time requirements under actuator limits.
  Establishing feasibility is essential for detecting unrealizable tasks
  and repairing specifications before execution. State-of-the-art
  Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) methods face growing model
  sizes as temporal horizons and formula complexity increase, and can
  accept control witnesses that violate continuous-time STL semantics
  between samples. We propose a geometric approach to STL feasibility
  and temporal repair that translates temporal requirements into spatial
  constraints evaluated at the initial state. Its compiled feasibility
  check is independent of horizon length for fixed compiled dimensions.
  We prove nonnegative continuous robustness under a joint controller
  assumption. On 6D UAV benchmarks, median geometric repair times are
  0.265--1.510 ms; we show up to 1.68x10^4 speedup over MILP
  feasibility checker. All geometric runs pass continuous STL
  validation, whereas majority of completed MILP control witnesses
  violate continuous-time STL.

AI.title_translation: STL可行性和修复的几何决策过程
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的几何方法来检查STL规范的可行性并修复它们，该方法比现有的MILP方法更快、更准确，尤其是在处理复杂和长时序问题时。
AI.motivation: 现有的MILP方法在处理不断增长的模型尺寸、时间跨度和公式复杂度时面临挑战，并且可能接受违反连续时间STL语义的控制。需要一种更有效、更准确的方法来检测不可实现的任务并修复规范。
AI.method: 将时间要求转化为空间约束，并在初始状态下进行评估，形成一种几何方法来检查STL的可行性和进行时间修复。
AI.result: 在6D无人机基准测试中，几何修复的中位数时间为0.265-1.510毫秒，比MILP可行性检查器快1.68x10^4倍。所有几何运行都通过了连续STL验证，而大多数完成的MILP控制证据违反了连续时间STL。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的几何方法在STL可行性和时间修复方面比MILP方法更优越，能够提供更快的速度和更准确的结果，并且不受时间跨度长度的影响。
AI.translation: 可行性STL规范是指，在给定的初始状态下，是否可以实现一个可容许的控制输入，在执行器限制下满足其连续时间要求。建立可行性对于检测不可实现的任务和在执行前修复规范至关重要。最先进的混合整数线性规划（MILP）方法随着时间跨度和公式复杂度的增加，模型尺寸不断增大，并且可能接受在采样之间违反连续时间STL语义的控制证据。我们提出了一种用于STL可行性和时间修复的几何方法，该方法将时间要求转化为在初始状态下进行评估的空间约束。其编译后的可行性检查对于固定的编译维度，独立于时间跨度长度。我们证明了在联合控制器假设下非负连续鲁棒性。在6D无人机基准测试中，中位数几何修复时间为0.265-1.510毫秒；我们展示了比MILP可行性检查器高达1.68x10^4倍的加速。所有几何运行都通过了连续STL验证，而大多数已完成的MILP控制证据违反了连续时间STL。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的几何决策方法，用于解决信号时序逻辑（STL）的可行性问题和执行修复。与现有的混合整数线性规划（MILP）方法相比，该几何方法将时间约束转化为空间约束，并在初始状态下进行评估，从而实现了对STL规范的快速检查。该方法不受时间跨度长度的影响，并且在6D无人机基准测试中显示出显著的加速效果，同时保证了结果的准确性，避免了MILP方法中可能出现的连续时间STL语义违反问题。
AI.keywords: STL, 可行性, 几何方法, 修复, 信号时序逻辑
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的几何方法来解决STL可行性和修复问题，有效克服了传统MILP方法在处理复杂性和规模方面的局限性。该方法在速度和准确性上均表现出色，尤其在实际应用中具有重要意义。然而，对于“联合控制器假设”的进一步探讨和其对鲁棒性证明的影响，以及该方法在更广泛应用场景下的泛化能力，值得进一步研究。

title: Quantitative Assessment of Hemispheric Asymmetry in Alzheimer's Disease and Healthy Brains via QSM-Derived Biomarkers: A Proof of Concept Study
summary: Studying brain lateralization and the resulting hemispheric asymmetry has been a topic of interest for many researchers. Very few studies have focused on differences in brain lateralization and hemispheric asymmetry associated with neurodegeneration. Additionally, Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping (QSM) has not been extensively used to investigate these differences. This article aims to study differences in hemispheric asymmetry between healthy and Alzheimer's disease (AD)-affected brains by calculating the Myelin Hemispheric Ratio (MHR) and Oxygen Extraction Fraction Hemispheric Ratio (OEFHR) between the two hemispheres using QSM as an intermediate marker of neurodegeneration. The estimations and corresponding results show marginal yet promising differences between healthy subjects and AD patients. These encouraging initial results emphasize the need to further investigate structural brain asymmetry and its alteration as a potential marker of AD-related neurodegeneration.

AI.title_translation: 通过QSM衍生的生物标志物对阿尔茨海默病和健康大脑的半球不对称性进行定量评估：一项概念验证研究
AI.tldr: 该研究使用定量磁化率成像（QSM）来评估健康大脑和阿尔茨海默病（AD）大脑之间的半球不对称性差异，通过计算髓鞘半球比率（MHR）和氧提取分数半球比率（OEFHR）。结果显示出两者之间存在微小但有希望的差异，表明半球不对称性可能是AD神经退变的潜在标志物。
AI.motivation: 研究脑侧化和半球不对称性在神经退行性疾病中的作用，特别是利用定量磁化率成像（QSM）来探索这些差异。
AI.method: 使用定量磁化率成像（QSM）计算髓鞘半球比率（MHR）和氧提取分数半球比率（OEFHR），以评估健康大脑和阿尔茨海默病（AD）大脑之间的半球不对称性差异。
AI.result: 在健康受试者和AD患者之间观察到边际但有希望的差异。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果强调了进一步研究结构性脑不对称性及其改变作为AD相关神经退变的潜在标志物的必要性。
AI.translation: 研究脑侧化和由此产生的半球不对称性一直是许多研究人员感兴趣的话题。很少有研究关注与神经退变相关的脑侧化和半球不对称性的差异。此外，定量磁化率成像（QSM）尚未被广泛用于研究这些差异。本文旨在通过计算两个半球之间的髓鞘半球比率（MHR）和氧提取分数半球比率（OEFHR）来研究健康大脑和受阿尔茨海默病（AD）影响的大脑之间的半球不对称性差异，其中QSM作为神经退变的中间标志物。估计和相应的结果显示健康受试者和AD患者之间存在微小但有希望的差异。这些初步的令人鼓舞的结果强调了进一步研究结构性脑不对称性及其改变作为AD相关神经退变的潜在标志物的必要性。
AI.summary: 这项概念验证研究利用定量磁化率成像（QSM）来量化健康大脑和阿尔茨海默病（AD）大脑之间的半球不对称性。通过计算髓鞘半球比率（MHR）和氧提取分数半球比率（OEFHR），研究发现了两者之间存在微小但有希望的差异，这提示半球不对称性可能作为AD神经退变的生物标志物，值得进一步研究。
AI.keywords: 半球不对称性,阿尔茨海默病,定量磁化率成像,髓鞘半球比率,氧提取分数半球比率
AI.comments: 这项研究首次利用QSM衍生的生物标志物来量化阿尔茨海默病和健康大脑之间的半球不对称性。虽然结果是初步的，但它们为探索不对称性作为AD的潜在诊断工具开辟了新的途径。未来的研究可以扩大样本量，并结合其他成像技术以获得更全面的理解。

title: Secure Directional Modulation Enabled by Elevatable and Rotatable Antenna Array for Maritime Communications
summary: To address the dual challenges of limited transmission distance and wireless communication security in maritime communications, a directional modulation network enhanced by an elevatable and rotatable antenna array is investigated in this paper. Specifically, the base station, whose array and antenna elements can be rotated and whose antenna height can be adjusted, transmits information to legitimate users while resisting eavesdropping. Moreover, transceiver hardware impairments are taken into account. Accordingly, a worst-case secrecy rate maximization problem is formulated under the joint optimization of precoding vectors, array orientation, antenna orientations, and array height. To solve this non-convex optimization challenge, an alternating optimization scheme and a Transformer-based learning scheme are proposed for the single-user and multi-user scenarios, respectively. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms. Security performance gains can be obtained after optimizing the array height, array orientation, and antenna orientations. In addition, compared with the isotropic antenna benchmark, the Transformer-based learning scheme can achieve approximately 90\% power savings, 87\% antenna savings, and serve more legitimate users.

AI.title_translation: 一种可升降、可旋转天线阵列实现的安全定向调制用于海上通信
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合了可升降和可旋转天线阵列的定向调制网络，以解决海上通信中的传输距离和安全问题。通过优化预编码向量、阵列方向、天线方向和阵列高度，可以最大化安全速率，并有效抵抗窃听。针对单用户和多用户场景，分别提出了交替优化和基于Transformer的学习方案。仿真结果表明，该方法能显著提高安全性，并与各向同性天线相比，在功率、天线数量和用户服务能力方面具有显著优势。
AI.motivation: 海上通信面临传输距离有限和无线通信安全性的双重挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合可升降和可旋转天线阵列的定向调制网络。针对单用户场景，提出交替优化方案；针对多用户场景，提出基于Transformer的学习方案。联合优化预编码向量、阵列方向、天线方向和阵列高度，以最大化最差情况下的安全速率。
AI.result: 所提出的算法在仿真中被证明是有效的。优化阵列高度、阵列方向和天线方向可以获得安全性能增益。与各向同性天线基准相比，基于Transformer的学习方案可节省约90%的功率，节省87%的天线，并能服务更多合法用户。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化可升降和可旋转天线阵列的参数，可以显著提高海上通信的安全性和效率。
AI.translation: 为了应对海上通信中传输距离有限和无线通信安全性的双重挑战，本文研究了一种由可升降和可旋转天线阵列增强的定向调制网络。具体来说，基站的阵列和天线单元可以旋转，天线高度可以调节，从而在抵抗窃听的同时向合法用户传输信息。此外，还考虑了收发器硬件的损伤。因此，在联合优化预编码向量、阵列方向、天线方向和阵列高度的条件下，提出了一个最差情况下的保密速率最大化问题。为了解决这个非凸优化挑战，分别提出了用于单用户和多用户场景的交替优化方案和基于Transformer的学习方案。仿真结果验证了所提出算法的有效性。通过优化阵列高度、阵列方向和天线方向可以获得安全性能增益。此外，与各向同性天线基准相比，基于Transformer的学习方案可以节省大约90%的功率，节省87%的天线，并能服务更多的合法用户。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种用于海上通信的安全定向调制方法，该方法利用可升降和可旋转天线阵列来同时解决传输距离和安全问题。通过联合优化阵列和天线配置以及预编码向量，以最大化保密速率。针对不同场景，开发了交替优化和基于Transformer的学习算法，并通过仿真验证了其在提高安全性、降低功耗和节省天线资源方面的优越性。
AI.keywords: 定向调制,海上通信,可升降可旋转天线阵列,安全速率,Transformer学习
AI.comments: 该研究在解决海上通信中的安全性和传输距离挑战方面具有创新性，通过引入可升降和可旋转天线阵列，并提出有效的优化算法，取得了显著的性能提升。然而，实际部署中的硬件复杂性和成本可能是一个需要考虑的因素。

title: AngularWM: Wireless World Modeling for AoA Prediction from Multi-Antenna I/Q
summary: Tracking angle-of-arrival (AoA) under mobility enables proactive beam alignment in multi-antenna wireless systems. However, learning this evolution directly from raw I/Q data is challenging because multipath, channel-gain variations, hardware impairments, and noise mix with angular information. This paper proposes \emph{AngularWM}, a self-supervised wireless world-modeling approach that learns a predictive latent angular state from ordered multi-antenna I/Q observations. A joint-embedding predictive architecture is combined with a label-free trajectory-level geometric regularizer that encourages an approximately affine, non-collapsed latent evolution motivated by the antenna-array response. No AoA, motion, or displacement labels are used during pretraining. The resulting structured world state supports direct multi-step encoder-space extrapolation and generalizes to angular step sizes not seen during training. On large-scale over-the-air measurements, AngularWM reduces the mean predictor-free AoA error over eight steps from $29.97^\circ$ to $0.49^\circ$. After pretraining, only three or four labeled reference angles are required to calibrate the complete 225-point AoA grid, achieving $0.48^\circ$ and $0.43^\circ$ MAE, respectively. AngularWM also maintains robust beam alignment and spectral efficiency under increasing angular displacement, while reducing the deployed model size from 1.42M to 0.30M parameters and forecast latency.

AI.title_translation: AngularWM: 用于多天线I/Q的AoA预测的无线世界建模
AI.tldr: AngularWM是一种自监督无线世界建模方法，可以从多天线I/Q数据中预测AoA，显著降低了预测误差，并减少了校准所需的标签数量。
AI.motivation: 在移动性下跟踪到达角(AoA)可以实现多天线无线系统中的主动波束对齐。然而，直接从原始I/Q数据中学习AoA的演变是具有挑战性的，因为多径、信道增益变化、硬件缺陷和噪声会与角度信息混合。
AI.method: 论文提出了AngularWM，一种自监督的无线世界建模方法，它从有序的多天线I/Q观测中学习预测性潜在角度状态。该方法结合了一个联合嵌入预测架构和一个无标签的轨迹级几何正则化器，该正则化器鼓励一个近似仿射的、非坍塌的潜在演变，其灵感来源于天线阵列响应。预训练期间不使用AoA、运动或位移标签。
AI.result: 在八个步骤中，将平均无预测器AoA误差从29.97°降低到0.49°。预训练后，仅需要三到四个带标签的参考角度即可校准完整的225点AoA网格，分别实现0.48°和0.43°的MAE。AngularWM还在增加角度位移的情况下保持了鲁棒的波束对齐和频谱效率，同时将部署模型的大小从1.42M参数减少到0.30M参数，并降低了预测延迟。
AI.conclusion: AngularWM通过自监督学习和世界建模方法，实现了对AoA的准确、高效预测，显著提高了多天线系统的波束对齐能力，并减少了对标签数据的依赖。
AI.translation: 在移动性下跟踪到达角(AoA)可以实现多天线无线系统中的主动波束对齐。然而，直接从原始I/Q数据中学习这种演变是具有挑战性的，因为多径、信道增益变化、硬件缺陷和噪声会与角度信息混合。本文提出了AngularWM，一种自监督的无线世界建模方法，它从有序的多天线I/Q观测中学习预测性潜在角度状态。一个联合嵌入预测架构与一个无标签的轨迹级几何正则化器相结合，该正则化器鼓励一个近似仿射的、非坍塌的潜在演变，其灵感来源于天线阵列响应。预训练期间不使用AoA、运动或位移标签。由此产生的结构化世界状态支持直接的多步编码器空间外推，并推广到训练中未见的角度步长。在大型无线测量中，AngularWM将八个步骤的平均无预测器AoA误差从29.97°降低到0.49°。预训练后，仅需要三到四个带标签的参考角度即可校准完整的225点AoA网格，分别实现0.48°和0.43°的MAE。AngularWM还在增加角度位移的情况下保持了鲁棒的波束对齐和频谱效率，同时将部署模型的大小从1.42M参数减少到0.30M参数，并降低了预测延迟。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AngularWM，一种自监督的无线世界建模方法，用于从多天线I/Q数据中预测到达角(AoA)。该方法通过学习潜在角度状态，并结合联合嵌入预测架构和无标签几何正则化器，解决了直接从I/Q数据学习AoA演变的挑战。AngularWM在减少AoA预测误差、降低标签需求、保持波束对齐鲁棒性以及减小模型尺寸和预测延迟方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: AoA预测, 无线世界建模, 自监督学习, 多天线, I/Q数据
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其自监督的无线世界建模方法，能够从复杂的原始I/Q数据中有效地提取和预测AoA信息，且无需AoA、运动或位移标签进行预训练。这显著降低了数据标注的成本，并提高了系统的实用性。其在AoA预测精度、模型效率和波束对齐稳定性方面的显著提升，使其在未来的多天线无线系统中具有重要应用潜力。

title: RF Chain Count to Mitigate Beam Split in Wideband Hybrid Arrays: From Far-Field to Near-Field
summary: Deploying large antenna arrays transitions wireless communication into the radiative near-field (NF), where spherical wavefronts enable beamfocusing in the joint angle-distance domain. However, wideband beamforming with large antenna arrays suffers from beam split across both spatial dimensions. Although fully digital arrays can eliminate this impairment, their prohibitive hardware cost and power consumption motivate the adoption of hybrid array architectures equipped with a limited number of radio-frequency (RF) chains. This paper investigates the minimum number of RF chains required to mitigate the beam split. We derive closed-form expressions for the required number of RF chains in fully-connected (FC) architectures and propose an algorithm for sub-connected (SC) architectures, considering both uniform linear arrays (ULAs) and uniform circular arrays (UCAs). Our analysis reveals that beyond a focal distance of 10L, where L denotes the aperture length, the NF RF chain count converges to its far-field counterpart and becomes a function of the angle alone. Moreover, the FC hybrid architecture mitigates the beam split by using fewer RF chains than the SC architecture, albeit at the cost of increased complexity in the phase shifter network.

AI.title_translation: 宽带混合阵列中的射频链数量以缓解波束分裂：从远场到近场
AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在宽带混合阵列中，为了消除近场和远场中的波束分裂问题，所需的最小射频链数量。研究提出了针对全连接和子连接架构的解决方案，并发现当距离超过10L时，近场所需的射频链数量趋于远场情况。
AI.motivation: 全数字阵列在近场通信中会产生波束分裂问题，而全数字阵列的成本和功耗过高，因此需要研究使用混合阵列架构来解决这个问题。
AI.method: 推导了全连接架构中所需射频链数量的闭式表达式，并为子连接架构提出了一种算法，同时考虑了均匀线阵和均匀圆阵。
AI.result: 研究表明，当焦距超过10L时，近场所需的射频链数量会收敛于远场情况，并仅作为角度的函数。此外，全连接混合架构比子连接架构需要更少的射频链来消除波束分裂，但其移相器网络复杂度更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用混合阵列架构，可以有效解决宽带通信中的波束分裂问题，并且可以根据具体需求优化射频链的数量和架构选择。
AI.translation: 在宽带混合阵列中，将无线通信引入辐射近场（NF），其中球面波前能够在角度-距离域中实现联合波束聚焦。然而，具有大天线阵列的宽带波束形成在两个空间维度上都会受到波束分裂的影响。尽管全数字阵列可以消除这种损伤，但其高昂的硬件成本和功耗促使人们采用配备有限数量射频链的混合阵列架构。本文研究了缓解波束分裂所需的最小射频链数量。我们推导了全连接（FC）架构中所需射频链数量的闭式表达式，并为子连接（SC）架构提出了一种算法，同时考虑了均匀线阵（ULA）和均匀圆阵（UCA）。我们的分析表明，当焦距超过10L（其中L表示孔径长度）时，近场射频链数量会收敛于其远场对应值，并仅作为角度的函数。此外，FC混合架构通过使用比SC架构更少的射频链来缓解波束分裂，尽管其移相器网络的复杂度有所增加。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在宽带混合阵列中，特别是在近场通信场景下，如何通过优化射频链的数量来解决波束分裂问题。论文提出了针对全连接和子连接架构的解决方案，并给出了所需射频链数量的计算方法。研究发现，在一定距离之外，近场所需的射频链数量与远场情况趋于一致，并且全连接架构在减少射频链数量方面比子连接架构更具优势。
AI.keywords: 混合阵列, 近场通信, 波束分裂, 射频链数量, 宽带波束形成
AI.comments: 该研究为近场通信中的波束分裂问题提供了一个重要的解决方案，特别是在硬件成本和功耗受限的情况下。通过推导闭式表达式和提出算法，为实际工程应用提供了理论指导。然而，对于不同类型的近场应用场景，其最优架构和射频链数量可能还需要进一步的仿真和实验验证。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based 3D Beam Adaptation for Underwater Wireless Optical Communication with AUVs
comments: 6 pages, in IEEE International Conference on Wireless for Space and Extreme Environments (WiSEE), workshop on Optical Wireless Communications and Sensing in Sea, Air, and Space (OWC-SAS)
summary: Underwater Wireless Optical Communications (UWOC) provide essential high data rates for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs), but reliable connectivity is critically affected by transmitter-receiver misalignment. This work addresses the beam pointing problem for a moving AUV subject to unknown ocean currents through a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework. We develop a comprehensive 3D UWOC channel model incorporating depth-dependent attenuation, turbulence, and a discrete-ray method to accurately quantify geometric and misalignment losses. The resulting agent jointly optimizes beam steering and divergence angles, learning a policy that prioritizes continuous link maintenance. Evaluated using real oceanographic data, the framework's performance is assessed via the excess outage metric, which isolates outages occurring exclusively due to pointing errors. Relative to perfect alignment between nodes, the proposed method bounds this metric to 8.5% under ocean current-free tracking conditions and limits it to 16.2% when subjected to current-induced drift. The findings obtained in this work confirms that DRL-enabled beam control is capable of adaptive tracking and mitigating link outages in dynamic underwater environments.
