title: Differentiable Systematic Resampling for Variational Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: Particle filters are a standard tool for nonlinear state estimation, but their resampling step is discrete, preventing gradient-based learning in variational sequential Monte Carlo. We introduce Differentiable Systematic Resampling (DSR), a temperature-controlled relaxation of systematic resampling, that preserves the CDF-ordered, banded structure of systematic resampling while enabling full gradient flow. DSR converges to exact systematic resampling as the temperature vanishes, and we prove a pointwise exponential convergence rate for the induced bias. Compared to optimal-transport-based differentiable resampling, DSR avoids iterative solvers and has substantially lower computational overhead. Experiments on stochastic dynamical systems and real-world handwriting data show that DSR achieves comparable or superior filtering and dynamics learning performance.

title: Deploying RDMA for Distributed Inference and Training At Scale
summary: RDMA can reduce communication overhead in distributed machine learning systems, but realizing these benefits in production requires more than replacing TCP. Variable-size messages, concurrent connections, bursty incasts, and service failures introduce challenges that hardware offload alone cannot address. This paper reports our experience deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA, in ByteDance's parameter-server-based inference and training systems. We present three lessons from the deployment: efficient RDMA requires buffer management across application and transport layers; scalable communication requires coordinated management of connections, receive capacity, and outstanding data; and service availability requires recovery above the transport layer. ByteExpress combines an RDMA-aware allocator, zero-copy transfers, QP multiplexing, receive-credit flow control, a software send window, and RPC-assisted recovery. In production inference, ByteExpress reduces mean and P99 model parameter fetch latency by 35.7% and 43.7%, respectively, and total CPU usage by 10.69% compared with kernel TCP. In training, ByteExpress reduces P99 model parameter push latency by up to 74.0% compared with TCP, with no PFC pauses observed at runtime.

title: Changing Geographies of Violence in North and West Africa
summary: This paper analyses spatial trends in armed conflicts in North and West Africa. It shows that all types of violence saw a significant increase in 2025. However, these violent incidents are distributed very unevenly across the region: while conflict is at its lowest in North Africa, the vast majority of violent incidents and victims are concentrated in five West African countries: Nigeria, Cameroon, Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger. Coastal countries are experiencing a very mixed picture: jihadism is not advancing as a front, from the Sahel toward the Gulf of Guinea, and most of the violence stems from local disputes, ethnic conflicts, and banditry. Second, the spatial indicator developed by the OECD/SWAC to track the evolution of this violence confirms that the conflict landscape is expanding at its margins and intensifying at its center. Even more concerning is that peripheral areas are increasingly being drawn directly into well-established conflict zones, rather than going through a gradual, low-intensity transition phase. The geography of expansion is shifting from a diffuse, low-intensity spread toward peripheral areas to a rapid outward expansion from dense, well-established conflict hotspots. The local indicator used in the report suggests that violence continues to spread to new locations at the margins of established conflict zones. At the heart of these zones, tensions are intensifying relative to their historical baseline levels, and a growing number of regions have experienced clashes for a decade or more. Projections indicate that the intensity of violence is expected to increase in 2026, reaching more than 15,000 incidents and more than 32,500 deaths. Much of the increase is explained by the growing number of conflicts in Nigeria. In the Sahel, fatalities should increase in Mali and decrease in Burkina Faso.

title: A model-assisted design for phase I oncology drug combination trials incorporating backfill
summary: Historically, phase I oncology trials were designed with the focus to find the highest tolerable dose. However, given the FDA's acknowledgment that the highest tolerable dose might not be the dose which is optimal biologically, there is an increased emphasis the development of designs that explore the dose-toxicity and dose-efficacy relationship. Backfill designs have emerged as a popular response to address this need by allocating participants to doses deemed safe while awaiting participants outcomes. Previous designs have explored how to assign participants to doses in backfill designs in a rigorous manner while providing simplicity and performance (a class of designs known as model-assisted) for single agents. Still, a research gap exists in the lack of model-assisted backfill designs for drug combinations. Frequently, the combinations two of cancer agents are explored in phase I trials, with the goal of identifying the highest tolerable combination. This paper incorporates and extends methodology based on previous model-assisted backfill designs to provide clinicians with a simple-to-use backfill design for phase I drug combination trials.

title: Measuring intraday return-shape geometry with modified Brownian motion
summary: Realised kurtosis measures intraday tail risk but compresses the shape of the return distribution into a single scalar, so trading days with similar kurtosis may differ in how probability mass is spread across the peak, the shoulders and the tails. We propose a geometric description of intraday return shape based on the modified Brownian motion model (MBMM), which deforms a Gaussian benchmark through a nonlinear feedback governed by a shape parameter and a distortion intensity. Our main contribution is a peak-shoulder-tail decomposition that measures where the fitted return density gains or loses probability mass relative to the Gaussian, complemented by two feedback landmarks that explain how the shape parameter generates these deformations. We estimate the model at the stock-day level using a bin-free simulation-based minimum-distance estimator that matches empirical and model-implied intraday quantiles, and we document its finite-sample reliability by Monte Carlo. Using regular session one-minute returns for ten liquid U.S. stocks from May 2021 to April 2026, we find that the MBMM provides a substantially better in-sample fit than geometric Brownian motion on every estimator-ready stock-day, and that days with closely matched realised kurtosis can display materially different peak-shoulder-tail geometries. Finally, we show that the estimated shape parameters behave as persistent daily state variables: they are strongly forecastable relative to a random-walk benchmark, though their predictability reflects persistence around a slowly moving level rather than rich autoregressive dynamics. The proposed decomposition offers a risk-shape measurement layer that complements realised kurtosis by describing not only how large intraday tail risk is, but how it is formed, giving investors and risk managers additional distributional information for risk monitoring and, potentially, prediction.

title: Quantifying Precision in Measurement of Individualized, Evidence-Based Learning Across Sessions in Applied Behavior Analysis Therapy
summary: Current performance criteria used in Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) are often based on whether a learner meets a predetermined benchmark e.g., 8 out of 10 correct responses across several sessions. Although these criteria help practitioners make instructional decisions, they provide limited information about how likely it is that the learner has truly acquired the skill. In this paper, we introduce a Bayesian approach that combines practitioners' prior expectations with the learner's ongoing performance data to estimate the learner's future performance level. Rather than providing only a pass or fail decision based on the criteria, we add an element of precision around that criteria to make decisions more nuanced to the testing conditions used. We also developed an R Shiny application for Measurement of Individualized, Evidence-Based Learning (MIEBL) that allows practitioners to apply this method in practice, supporting more informed instructional decisions and providing insight into the strengths and limitations of commonly used mastery criteria.

title: Machine Learning Models Trained on a Longitudinal Survey Dataset Poorly Predict Hundreds of Life Outcomes
summary: Understanding the predictability of life outcomes is important for public policy and science, but existing studies focus on a limited number of outcomes and therefore struggle to describe the broad patterns of predictability. We developed a high-throughput approach that uses a single dataset to study the predictability of many future outcomes using past data. We deployed this approach with hundreds of outcomes and thousands of machine learning models per outcome in the Future of Families and Child Wellbeing Study. Three findings emerged. First, most outcomes were not very predictable, but some were much more predictable than others. Second, even for the most predictable outcomes, our complex prediction procedure typically exhibited little skill relative to a simple procedure. Third, we found modest patterns in how predictability varied across outcomes. We conclude by discussing scope conditions and how future research might address them.

title: Spatial Partner Markets: Effective Competition, Scale, and Opportunity
summary: Local partner markets differ not only in population size but in relative partner availability, the scale of opportunity, marriage timing, and population turnover. This paper develops a county-level framework for comparing these conditions across local partner markets. The empirical application focuses on unmarried women ages 25-34 and uses observed partner-age pairings to construct age-specific weights for the relevant unmarried male population. We model absolute opportunity separately, fitting a Michaelis-Menten diminishing-returns transformation to 192 scenarios that vary dating intensity, search horizon, fit, and first-date conversion. The resulting index also incorporates the share of women ages 35-39 who have never married and the inflow rate of adults ages 25-34. Among 320 counties with complete data, the District of Columbia ranks first and New York County second under the baseline specification, and rankings remain highly stable under alternative component weights. An endogenous mobility extension shows that favorable markets attract additional male participants, producing substantial adjustment while leaving the top composite rankings relatively stable over the parameter values considered. The framework is intended as a structural comparison of local partner-market conditions rather than a predictor of individual relationship outcomes.

title: Women and the Nobel Prize in the sciences: an update to 2026
summary: Every October, the Nobel Prizes in Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine and Economic Sciences are announced, with one to three prizes in each discipline. Of the 769 Laureates (since 1901) in these four disciplines only 4% are women (30 Laureates). In 2026, there are eight Laureates within these disciplines and they are all men. Based on historical data across four fields and a Bayesian hierarchical model, we update the 8 year old model on bias in Nobel Prizes and confirm the gender gap, with exceedingly large confidence.

title: Discrete-Time Survival Modelling with Dynamic Industrial Graphs for Mortgage Credit Risk
summary: Mortgage credit risk may exhibit dependence across economically connected areas, even when they are geographically distant. However, current models typically represent cross-area dependence through fixed geographical neighbourhoods, potentially overlooking economic connections that extend beyond physical proximity and evolve over time. These models may fail to capture shared risks among geographically distant but economically similar areas, and cannot describe a changing dependence of risk; it therefore risks retaining economically obsolete connections while omitting newly emerging ones. This paper uses similarities of industrial composition as a measure of economic proximity and develops a discrete-time survival model with dynamic industrial graphs to capture evolving cross-area dependence in mortgage default risk. The resulting graphs are reconstructed annually, allowing both their topology and edge weights to change as regional industrial compositions evolve. Jointly combining a proper conditional autoregressive process with a first-order autoregressive process governs the temporal cross-area dependence and the temporal persistence in latent risk simultaneously. The model is estimated using Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation and evaluated on U.S. mortgage loan-level data against the static industrial graph specifications. The results show that the proposed dynamic model achieves better in-sample fit and out-of-sample discrimination, while its estimated parameters indicate substantial graph-induced cross-area dependence and temporal persistence. These findings demonstrate the value of allowing economically defined neighbourhoods to evolve when modelling mortgage default risk.

title: Dynamic Extended Generalized Many-Facet Rasch Model: A Unified Approach to Rater-Mediated Assessment
summary: Rating procedures are crucial in psychological and medical diagnosis, educational assessment, peer review, and grant evaluation. A major methodological challenge is disentangling multiple sources of variability in ratings, such as subject ability, rater behavior, and item characteristics. Item Response Theory-based models, most notably many-facet Rasch models and hierarchical rater models, have been widely adopted for jointly estimating subject, rater, and item effects, while retaining high interpretability. We introduce the Dynamic Extended Generalized Many-Facet Rasch model, a general class of Bayesian semiparametric models that integrate and extend existing approaches. Its measurement model allows location and discrimination parameters to depend jointly on item and rater characteristics and incorporates subject-item and rater-subject variation. The dynamic extension introduces a rater-specific cross-lagged effect capturing dependence on the previously rated subject, and a Bayesian P-spline capturing systematic changes in discrimination over the rating sequence, accounting for learning, fatigue, or adaptation effects. Subject heterogeneity is addressed through Bayesian nonparametric mixtures, flexibly learning the latent ability distribution without strict parametric assumptions and enabling model-based subject clustering. We also derive a closed-form, model-based inter-rater consensus coefficient and study its characteristics. We discuss theoretical properties, develop posterior computation strategies, and evaluate the model in simulation studies and two real-data applications.

title: Decomposing the spectral density function of an ARMA process
summary: Quasi-periodic oscillations are characterized by fitting Lorentzian functions to a nonparametric estimate of the power spectral density, a two-step procedure that separates estimation from modeling and does not accommodate measurement error. We develop a parametric alternative based on autoregressive moving-average (ARMA) processes observed with measurement error. We derive an exact decomposition of the ARMA spectral density into real-valued components, one for each class of autoregressive roots under complex conjugation, plus a polynomial term when the moving-average order is at least the autoregressive order. Each component is a Wrapped Cauchy kernel, and for complex roots it is accompanied by a conjugate-Poisson term that makes the peak asymmetric and displaces its maximum from the frequency given by the argument of the root. We obtain closed-form expressions for the location, height, width, and asymmetry of each peak, and a matching variance decomposition. Parameters are estimated by maximum likelihood through the Kalman filter, and all descriptors follow by plug-in. Simulations show that the closed-form peak location is recovered without appreciable bias. An X-ray binary light curve illustrates the methodology.

title: Beyond the Damped Random Walk: Multiband AGN Variability from SDSS to Rubin LSST
summary: The flux variability of Active Galactic Nuclei (AGNs) is commonly modeled using the damped random walk (DRW), but increasingly rich multiband time-domain surveys motivate more flexible stochastic models that characterize variability beyond a single timescale and exploit dependence across bands. Multivariate continuous-time autoregressive moving average (MCARMA) processes extend the multivariate DRW to higher-order stochastic dynamics and provide a matrix-valued power spectral density for characterizing marginal variability and cross-band dependence. In a carefully selected Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) Stripe~82 sample, higher-order models are selected for 109 of 134 AGNs (81.3\%), with substantial rather than marginal support in most objects; convergence diagnostics indicate that this fraction is conservative. The fitted models also reveal strong cross-band dependence that generally decreases with wavelength separation. Motivated by this richer structure, we investigate its recoverability under Vera C. Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) observing conditions. Model-order recovery depends strongly on the underlying stochastic behavior as well as source brightness and observing cadence. Recovery is high across many of the simulated settings, but deteriorates when the characteristic features of higher-order variability become difficult to distinguish from the multivariate DRW. Additional simulations show that this loss of distinguishability can persist over a range of underlying variability behaviors. These results show that stochastic structure beyond the multivariate DRW is prevalent in our selected SDSS sample, while its recoverability with LSST depends on both observational conditions and the form of the underlying stochastic variability. The methodology is implemented in the Python package mcarma.

title: Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification of Breast-Cancer Pathology AI Agreement under Reader- and Annotation-Condition-Dependent Reference Labels
comments: In Review with Journal of Medical Imaging
summary: Human reference labels used to evaluate medical AI can vary across readers and annotation workflows. We quantified agreement of a fixed pathology AI system with a future qualified reader without treating inferred consensus as error-free biological truth. Linked Evaluation and Unbiased NuCLS multirater data were analyzed using a fixed external HoVer-Net decision vector. The selected frame contained 1,144 anchors, 52 fields of view, five slides/patients, and five primary readers. The target was fixed-AI agreement with a future reader, with descriptive contrast $Δ=θ_E-θ_U$. Analyses included raw agreement and iMRMC benchmarks, reader-only and shared-detectability Bayesian models, structural sensitivities, adversarial simulations, and predictive assessment. Among 5,188 reader-anchor pairs observed in both conditions, 19.62% changed AI-agreement state, while raw agreement was 0.5466 in Unbiased and 0.5473 in Evaluation. The reader-only model gave $Δ=-0.0008$ (95% CrI, $-0.0033$ to $0.0008$), and the shared-detectability model gave $Δ\approx0$ ($-0.0140$ to $0.0127$). Across structural perturbations, absolute agreement ranged from 0.420 to 0.646 in Unbiased and 0.409 to 0.640 in Evaluation. Frozen adversarial simulations met the comparative-stability criterion (median $R=0.295$; 14/16 model-scenario cells had $R<1$). Held-out-AI prediction supported shared predictive information, but varied by slide composition. The Evaluation-minus-Unbiased contrast was comparatively stable, whereas absolute agreement was structurally sensitive. These findings do not establish equivalence, causal assistance effects, biological accuracy, or new-patient transportability. Evaluations using variable human references should report reader population, selected frame, observation mechanism, and structural sensitivity.

AI.title_translation: 基于依赖读者与标注条件的参考标签下乳腺癌病理AI一致性的贝叶斯不确定性量化
AI.tldr: 本研究采用贝叶斯模型量化了乳腺癌病理AI与不同标注条件下读者的一致性，发现相对对比差异较稳定，但绝对一致性高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 用于评估医疗AI的人类参考标注常因读者差异和标注工作流程而发生变异，盲目将推导得出的共识视为无误差的生物学“真值”会导致评估存在偏差，因而需要量化固定AI与未来合格读者之间的一致性及不确定性。
AI.method: 基于关联的Evaluation和Unbiased NuCLS多读者数据集，结合固定的HoVer-Net算法决策向量，采用原始一致性、iMRMC基准分析、纯读者及共享可检测性贝叶斯模型，并进行了结构敏感性分析、对抗性模拟和留出预测评估。
AI.result: 在跨条件观察的5,188个读者-锚点对中，19.62%改变了AI一致性状态；纯读者模型的对比差异Δ为-0.0008，共享可检测性模型的Δ约为0；在结构扰动下，绝对一致性在0.409至0.646之间剧烈变动；对抗性模拟满足了对比稳定性标准（中位数R=0.295）。
AI.conclusion: 评估条件与无偏条件之间的对比差异相对稳定，但AI与人类读者的绝对一致性对结构扰动具有高度敏感性。因此，使用存在变异的人类参考标注评估AI时，必须透明报告读者群体、抽样框架、观察机制以及结构敏感性。
AI.translation: 用于评估医疗AI的人类参考标签会因读者和标注工作流程的不同而产生差异。我们在不将推导共识视为无误差生物学真值的前提下，量化了固定病理AI系统与未来合格读者之间的一致性。本研究结合固定的外部HoVer-Net决策向量，分析了关联的Evaluation和Unbiased NuCLS多读者数据。所选样本框包含1,144个锚点、52个视野、5张切片/患者以及5名主要读者。分析目标是固定AI与未来读者的一致性，描述性对比为Δ = θ_E - θ_U。分析方法包括原始一致性与iMRMC基准评估、纯读者和共享可检测性贝叶斯模型、结构敏感性、对抗性模拟及预测评估。在两种条件下均被观察到的5,188个读者-锚点对中，有19.62%改变了AI一致性状态，而Unbiased组的原始一致性为0.5466，Evaluation组为0.5473。纯读者模型得出的Δ为-0.0008（95%可信区间，-0.0033至0.0008），共享可检测性模型得出的Δ≈0（-0.0140至0.0127）。在各种结构扰动下，Unbiased组的绝对一致性范围为0.420至0.646，Evaluation组为0.409至0.640。冻结对抗性模拟满足了相对稳定性标准（中位数R=0.295；16个模型-场景单元中有14个R<1）。留出AI预测支持共享预测信息，但随切片组成而异。Evaluation减去Unbiased的对比结果相对稳定，而绝对一致性则对结构具有敏感性。这些发现并未证明等效性、因果辅助效应、生物学准确性或对新患者的可迁移性。使用易变人类参考标准进行的评估，应报告读者群体、所选样本框、观察机制和结构敏感性。
AI.summary: 本研究针对医学图像AI评估中人类参考标准不稳定的问题，提出了一种不将标注共识视作绝对金标准的贝叶斯不确定性量化框架。通过在乳腺癌病理多读者数据集上的实验发现，虽然不同标注条件间的相对对比差异较为稳定，但AI与读者的绝对一致性极易受结构扰动影响，强调了医疗AI验证报告需考虑标注变异性的必要性。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯不确定性量化, 乳腺癌病理, 人工智能一致性, 多读者多病例, 标注变异性
AI.comments: 该研究的重要创新在于摒弃了将人类标注共识直接视作“无误差金标准”的传统假设，采用贝叶斯不确定性量化方法严谨评估病理AI与未来读者的契合度。研究揭示出绝对一致性对结构扰动高度敏感，提示医学AI评估在面对读者变异性和标注工作流差异时，亟需更全面的报告标准与敏感性分析。局限性在于样本量较小（仅5张切片/患者），且无法推断因果辅助效应或新患者层面的泛化能力。

title: A Cosine-Projection Framework for Choosing Among Cox HR, D-RMST, and Average-Hazard Tests in Survival Trials
summary: The log-rank/Cox hazard-ratio test remains the standard approach for the primary analysis of randomized trials with time-to-event endpoints and is fully efficient under proportional hazards (PH). Two model-free alternatives that have recently gained attention are the difference in restricted mean survival time (D-RMST), a contrast on the time scale, and the more recently proposed ratio of average hazards (RAH), a contrast on the rate scale. Simulation studies suggest that the RAH-based test can outperform both under delayed treatment effects, but its efficiency has not been characterized analytically, and no unified framework explains how censoring and accrual affect the efficiency ordering among these tests. We show that all three statistics share a weighted-log-rank representation and derive their asymptotic relative efficiencies under local alternatives, including the first analytic efficiency results for the RAH-based test. Geometrically, each test defines a direction in a function space and the anticipated treatment effect defines a signal direction. A test's efficiency relative to the oracle test equals the squared cosine of the angle between these directions, so the asymptotic relative efficiency of any two tests is a ratio of squared cosines. Because censoring and accrual enter through an information weight, the framework shows how design choices can alter, and even reverse, the efficiency ordering. We illustrate the framework using the CheckMate 057 immunotherapy trial and corroborate the theoretical results through simulations spanning proportional- and non-proportional-hazards settings.

AI.title_translation: 生存试验中选择Cox HR、D-RMST和平均风险检验的余弦投影框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个余弦投影框架，用于分析性地表征和比较Cox HR、D-RMST和平均风险检验在生存试验中的效率，并解释审查和入组如何影响它们的表现。
AI.motivation: 对数秩/Cox风险比检验在比例风险（PH）假设下是标准且有效的。然而，D-RMST和平均风险比（RAH）作为替代方法受到关注，尤其RAH在延迟治疗效果下表现良好，但其效率尚未得到分析表征。目前缺乏一个统一的框架来解释审查和入组如何影响这些检验之间的效率排序。
AI.method: 本文证明所有三种统计量（Cox HR、D-RMST、RAH）都共享一个加权对数秩表示，并推导了它们在局部替代假设下的渐近相对效率，包括RAH-based检验的首次分析效率结果。在几何学上，每个检验在函数空间中定义了一个方向，预期治疗效果定义了一个信号方向。一个检验相对于最佳（oracle）检验的效率等于这两个方向之间角度的余弦平方，因此任意两个检验的渐近相对效率是余弦平方的比率。审查和入组通过信息权重进入该框架。该框架通过CheckMate 057免疫治疗试验进行说明，并通过模拟（涵盖比例和非比例风险设置）证实了理论结果。
AI.result: 所有三种统计量（Cox HR、D-RMST、RAH）都共享一个加权对数秩表示。本文首次推导了RAH-based检验的分析效率结果，以及所有检验在局部替代假设下的渐近相对效率。一个检验相对于最佳检验的效率等于其方向与预期治疗效果信号方向之间角度的余弦平方。该框架表明，审查和入组通过信息权重可以改变甚至逆转这些检验的效率排序。理论结果已通过CheckMate 057试验和模拟得到证实。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个统一的余弦投影框架，分析性地表征和比较了Cox HR、D-RMST和平均风险检验的效率，并解释了审查和入组对其效率排序的影响，为生存试验中选择合适的检验提供了指导。
AI.translation:
生存试验中选择Cox HR、D-RMST和平均风险检验的余弦投影框架

对具有事件发生时间终点的随机试验进行主要分析时，对数秩/Cox风险比检验仍然是标准方法，并且在比例风险（PH）假设下是完全有效的。最近受到关注的两种无模型替代方法是受限平均生存时间差（D-RMST），它是一种时间尺度上的对比；以及最近提出的平均风险比（RAH），它是一种速率尺度上的对比。模拟研究表明，RAH-based检验在延迟治疗效果下表现优于两者，但其效率尚未得到分析表征，并且没有统一的框架来解释审查和入组如何影响这些检验之间的效率排序。我们表明，所有这三种统计量都共享一个加权对数秩表示，并推导了它们在局部替代假设下的渐近相对效率，包括RAH-based检验的首次分析效率结果。从几何学上讲，每个检验在函数空间中定义了一个方向，预期的治疗效果定义了一个信号方向。一个检验相对于最佳（oracle）检验的效率等于这两个方向之间角度的余弦平方，因此任意两个检验的渐近相对效率是余弦平方的比率。由于审查和入组通过信息权重进入，该框架展示了设计选择如何改变甚至逆转效率排序。我们使用CheckMate 057免疫治疗试验说明了该框架，并通过涵盖比例和非比例风险设置的模拟证实了理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个新颖的余弦投影框架，用于分析性地比较Cox HR、D-RMST和平均风险（RAH）这三种关键生存分析检验的效率。研究表明，这三种检验都可表示为加权对数秩统计量，并首次提供了RAH的分析效率结果。该框架从几何角度将效率解释为检验方向与信号方向之间角度的余弦平方，并阐明了审查和入组如何影响甚至逆转效率排序。这种统一的方法为生存试验中选择最佳检验提供了重要指导，并通过真实试验案例和模拟得到了验证。
AI.keywords: 生存分析, Cox HR, D-RMST, 平均风险比, 效率, 余弦投影框架
AI.comments: 本文通过提供一个统一的分析框架来理解不同生存分析检验的效率，做出了重要的理论贡献。余弦投影的视角是创新的，为效率提供了一种直观的几何解释。RAH效率的分析表征以及对设计选择（审查、入组）如何影响检验性能的解释对于生存试验中的实践者和研究人员尤其有价值，可能有助于做出更明智的检验选择。

title: Precision follows the decision: how well an acceptance probability is known for mean-spread release rules
comments: 63 pages (29-page article followed by the supplementary appendices), 11 figures. Builds on arXiv:2609.21577
summary: Many release rules accept a lot when a statistic built from the sample mean and standard deviation stays within a limit, and the probability that a process passes such a rule can be computed exactly for a broad class of parent distributions. This paper asks how well that probability is itself known once the parent has been estimated. Under a stated reference posterior the answer is an interval, narrow where a lot clearly passes or fails and wide where it is contested. In ninety-eight published content-uniformity lots that position, not the sample size, sets the width: among the forty-eight lots assayed at the same ten units, and so equally informed about the spread, the $95\%$ interval runs from essentially zero width to $0.96$. With the operating point held fixed while test and estimation sample grow together, the interval narrows only slowly, the contraction of the posterior being offset by the steepening of the operating characteristic; a calibrated study at the sample sizes of $1207$ occupational exposure assessments shows the same under a half-plane rule. For a pure-spread rule under a Normal parent the interval has an exact chi-square form in the plug-in value and the two sample sizes, extending to the mean-spread wedge with a measured residual and containing Bergum's lower bound as one endpoint. With the parent's posterior formed from the same published summaries through the evaluator's own likelihood, the qualitative pattern survives but shape moves both endpoints and width: on the same lots a strong right skew lowers the pessimistic endpoint by up to a fifth and widens the interval by up to $0.22$. At the content-uniformity operating point studied, under a Normal parent, the symmetric error bar in standard use puts the lower endpoint $0.21$ too high and returns an upper endpoint above one, even with the full posterior covariance.
comment: 63 pages (29-page article followed by the supplementary appendices), 11 figures. Builds on arXiv:2609.21577

AI.title_translation: 精确度取决于决策：均值-离散度放行规则的接受概率已知程度如何
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在估计母体分布后，均值-离散度放行规则的接受概率的已知程度。研究发现，这种概率的精度（区间宽度）更多地受操作点而非样本量的影响，并且标准的误差棒可能不准确。
AI.motivation: 许多放行规则基于样本均值和标准差来接受批次，其通过概率可以精确计算。本文旨在探讨在母体分布被估计后，这种通过概率本身的已知程度如何。
AI.method: 本研究使用了一个既定的参考后验分布来确定接受概率的已知程度，并将其表示为一个区间。它分析了98批已发布的含量均一性数据，并对在相同10个单位进行测定的48批数据进行了比较。研究还探讨了在测试和估计样本同时增长时，操作点保持固定情况下的区间变化。通过对1207个职业暴露评估的样本量进行校准研究，验证了半平面规则下的情况。对于正态母体下的纯离散度规则，研究推导了精确的卡方形式。此外，研究还通过评估者自己的似然函数，从已发布的摘要中构建了母体的后验分布，并与标准使用的对称误差棒进行了比较。
AI.result: 研究发现，接受概率的已知程度表现为一个区间，当批次明确通过或失败时区间较窄，当批次存在争议时区间较宽。在98批已发布的含量均一性数据中，区间的宽度由操作点而非样本量决定。在相同10个单位测定的48批数据中，95%区间从接近零宽度到0.96。当操作点固定且测试和估计样本量同时增长时，区间收缩缓慢，后验分布的收缩被操作特性曲线的陡峭所抵消。对1207个职业暴露评估样本量的校准研究在半平面规则下也显示了相同结果。对于正态母体下的纯离散度规则，区间具有精确的卡方形式，并包含Bergum的下限。当使用评估者自己的似然函数从已发布的摘要中形成母体的后验分布时，定性模式得以保留，但形状会改变端点和宽度：在相同的批次中，强烈的右偏度将悲观端点降低了五分之一，并将区间宽度增加了0.22。在研究的含量均一性操作点，在正态母体下，标准使用的对称误差棒将下端点设置得过高0.21，并且即使有完整的后验协方差，上端点也高于1。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论，在均值-离散度放行规则中，接受概率的精度（已知程度）主要受操作点而非样本量的影响，尤其是在样本量同步增长时。标准的对称误差棒在估计接受概率时可能存在显著不准确性，它会高估下限并可能导致上限超过1，这表明需要更精确地表征接受概率的不确定性。
AI.translation: 许多放行规则在基于样本均值和标准差构建的统计量保持在某个限度内时接受批次，并且对于各类母体分布，过程通过此类规则的概率可以精确计算。本文提出了一个问题：一旦母体被估计，该概率本身的已知程度如何？在一个既定的参考后验分布下，答案是一个区间，当批次明显通过或失败时区间较窄，当批次存在争议时区间较宽。在98批已发布的含量均一性批次中，是位置（操作点）而非样本量决定了宽度：在相同10个单位测定的48批批次中，在离散度信息相同的情况下，95%区间从基本零宽度到0.96。当操作点保持固定，而测试和估计样本量同时增长时，区间收缩缓慢，后验分布的收缩被操作特性曲线的陡峭所抵消；在1207个职业暴露评估的样本量下进行的校准研究显示，在半平面规则下也存在同样的情况。对于正态母体下的纯离散度规则，区间具有精确的卡方形式，其值取决于插入值和两个样本量，并扩展到均值-离散度楔形区域，带有测量的残差，且包含Bergum的下限作为其中一个端点。当通过评估者自己的似然函数，从相同的已发布摘要中形成母体的后验分布时，定性模式得以保留，但形状会移动端点和宽度：在相同的批次上，强烈的右偏度将悲观端点降低了五分之一，并将区间宽度增加了0.22。在研究的含量均一性操作点，在正态母体下，即使有完整的后验协方差，标准使用的对称误差棒将下端点设置得过高0.21，并且返回的上端点高于1。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在均值-离散度放行规则中，估计母体分布后接受概率的已知精度问题。研究发现，这种概率的不确定性（通过区间表示）主要受操作点而非样本量影响，在批次结果存在争议时区间会更宽。通过对含量均一性数据和校准评估的研究，结果表明标准的对称误差棒可能存在显著不准确性，会高估下限并导致上限超过一，即便考虑了完整的后验协方差。
AI.keywords: 接受概率, 均值-离散度放行规则, 含量均一性, 精度, 操作特性
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于挑战了关于接受概率精度的传统观念，明确指出在均值-离散度放行规则中，操作点对精度区间的宽度影响远大于样本量。它揭示了标准对称误差棒在估计接受概率时可能存在的严重偏差，强调了在质量控制中需要对不确定性进行更精确和细致的评估，这对于决策制定具有重要意义。

title: One Goodness-of-Fit Test Is Not Enough: Error-Controlled Localization of Misfit in Logistic Risk Models
comments: 41 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables, including appendices with the proofs and additional studies. Code, per-data-set results and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23192535. The procedures are implemented in the R package ebrahim.gof (version 2.10.0, functions localize.gof and localize.external)
summary: A goodness-of-fit test tells whether a logistic risk model fits, but the analyst also needs to know what is wrong: an overall risk that is too high is repaired by updating the intercept, risks that are too extreme by recalibration, a curved relation between score and risk by a flexible recalibration, and misfit within groups of patients only by revising the model. We split any misfit into these four parts, which are orthogonal and match the calibration hierarchy. Each part gets a group of score tests that sees that part only, and the failing parts are named by closed testing. In external validation, in large samples and for small departures, a part is wrongly named with probability at most the chosen level, and the highest part named points to the lightest update that removes the misfit. Checking a model on its development data never sees an error in the overall risk or the calibration slope, and with binary or skewed covariates it can mistake misfit within patient groups for a curved link. External validation sees all four parts, for any prediction model. In simulations it kept its error rate when the model was right and for small departures, and usually pointed to the right update. On intensive-care data its verdicts for one model differed in-sample, on similar patients and after transport.
comment: 41 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables, including appendices with the proofs and additional studies. Code, per-data-set results and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23192535. The procedures are implemented in the R package ebrahim.gof (version 2.10.0, functions localize.gof and localize.external)

AI.title_translation: 一个拟合优度检验不足以：逻辑风险模型中失拟的误差控制定位
AI.tldr: 现有拟合优度检验无法定位逻辑风险模型中的失拟问题。本文提出将失拟分为四个正交部分，通过评分检验和闭合检验，在外部验证中以误差控制的方式定位失拟来源，并指示最轻微的模型更新。
AI.motivation: 拟合优度检验只能告诉分析师逻辑风险模型是否拟合，但无法指出具体哪里出了问题，而分析师需要知道具体的问题（如整体风险过高、风险过于极端、评分与风险关系弯曲或患者群体内部失拟），以便进行有针对性的模型修正。
AI.method: 本文将任何失拟分解为四个正交部分，这些部分与校准层次结构相匹配。为每个部分设计一组评分检验，这些检验只针对该部分。通过闭合检验来识别出失败的部分。在外部验证中，该方法能在误差受控的情况下指出需要更新的“最轻微”部分。
AI.result: 在外部验证中，对于大样本和小偏差，错误命名一个部分的概率最多为所选水平，并且最高被命名的部分指向消除失拟的最轻微更新。在开发数据上检查模型永远不会发现整体风险或校准斜率的错误，并且在二元或偏斜协变量存在时，可能将患者群体内部的失拟误认为弯曲链接。外部验证能看到所有四个部分。在模拟中，当模型正确且偏差较小时，该方法保持了其错误率，并且通常指向正确的更新。在重症监护数据上，对于一个模型，其在样本内、在相似患者和传输后的判断有所不同。
AI.conclusion: 现有的拟合优度检验不足以诊断逻辑风险模型中的具体失拟问题。本文提出的方法通过将失拟分解为四个正交部分，并结合评分检验和闭合检验，能够在外部验证中误差受控地定位失拟来源，从而指导分析师进行最轻微且有效的模型更新。外部验证对于全面诊断模型失拟至关重要。
AI.translation: 一个拟合优度检验可以告诉我们逻辑风险模型是否拟合，但分析师还需要知道哪里出了问题：整体风险过高可以通过更新截距来修复；风险过于极端可以通过重新校准来修复；评分与风险之间的弯曲关系可以通过灵活的重新校准来修复；而患者群体内部的失拟只能通过修改模型来修复。我们将任何失拟分解为这四个部分，它们是正交的并且与校准层次结构相匹配。每个部分都有一组评分检验，这些检验只针对该部分，并通过闭合检验来命名失败的部分。在外部验证中，在大样本和小偏差的情况下，错误命名一个部分的概率最多为所选水平，并且最高被命名的部分指向消除失拟的最轻微更新。在开发数据上检查模型永远不会发现整体风险或校准斜率的错误，并且在二元或偏斜协变量存在时，它可能将患者群体内部的失拟误认为弯曲链接。外部验证可以看到所有这四个部分，适用于任何预测模型。在模拟中，当模型正确且偏差较小时，它保持了其错误率，并且通常指向正确的更新。在重症监护数据上，对于一个模型，其在样本内、在相似患者和传输后的判断有所不同。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种新的方法，用于在逻辑风险模型中定位失拟的具体来源，而非仅仅判断模型是否拟合。该方法将失拟分解为四个正交部分，分别对应整体风险、极端风险、评分与风险的弯曲关系以及患者群体内部失拟。通过一系列针对性的评分检验和闭合检验，该方法能够在外部验证中以误差受控的方式识别出失拟的具体类型，并指导进行最轻微且有效的模型修正。研究强调了外部验证的重要性，因为它能全面发现所有四种失拟类型，而内部验证则存在局限性。
AI.keywords: 逻辑风险模型, 拟合优度检验, 失拟定位, 校准, 外部验证
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它超越了传统的拟合优度检验，提供了一种精细化、可操作的失拟诊断工具。通过将失拟分解为正交的、与校准层次结构匹配的部分，并结合误差控制的检验方法，它为模型修正提供了明确的指导。特别强调外部验证的重要性，指出了内部验证的局限性，这对于实际应用中构建稳健的风险模型具有重要意义。该方法对于提高逻辑回归模型在临床和其他领域的可靠性具有重要价值。

title: Beyond the Kullback--Leibler divergence: the likelihood-ratio distribution as a detectability measure
summary: The Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence is the expectation value of the log-likelihood ratio between two specified models, evaluated with respect to one of the two models. It provides an average measure of the distinguishability of the models. We examine its connection to discovery potential and the accuracy of parameter estimates when one model represents a null hypothesis, and the alternative is a family of models characterized by one or more continuous parameters. For data drawn from a multivariate Gaussian distribution, we derive the log-likelihood-ratio distribution and its cumulants under two such hypotheses. We then search over the alternative model's parameter space and use peak prominence, the height of a likelihood-profile peak above its surrounding baseline, as an operational detection statistic. Repeating this search on simulated data drawn from the null model allows us to calibrate the prominence threshold for a specified false-positive rate. We study a toy Gaussian model as well as three cosmological examples involving cosmic topology, the tensor-to-scalar ratio, and dark energy. In all these cases, detectability of a particular model depends not only on KL divergence, but also on the size of the model parameter space, the likelihood-ratio distributions, and the distance of the model from any parameter space boundaries. The relationship between KL divergence, discovery potential, and parameter estimation must therefore be calibrated for each family of models and detection statistic under consideration.

AI.title_translation: 超越Kullback--Leibler散度：似然比分布作为可检测性度量
AI.tldr: KL散度作为模型可区分性的平均度量存在局限。本文提出使用似然比分布和峰值突出度作为检测统计量，并发现模型的检测能力还受参数空间大小、似然比分布和模型与参数边界距离等因素影响，强调需对KL散度与发现潜力及参数估计的关系进行校准。
AI.motivation: Kullback--Leibler（KL）散度是模型可区分性的平均度量，但其与发现潜力以及当替代模型具有连续参数时的参数估计精度之间的联系需要更深入的探讨。
AI.method: 研究了KL散度与发现潜力及参数估计精度的联系。针对多元高斯分布数据，推导了对数似然比分布及其累积量。使用峰值突出度作为操作检测统计量，通过在替代模型参数空间中搜索并校准假阳性率。在玩具高斯模型和三个宇宙学例子（宇宙拓扑、张量-标量比、暗能量）中进行了研究。
AI.result: 特定模型的可检测性不仅取决于KL散度，还取决于模型参数空间的大小、似然比分布以及模型与任何参数空间边界的距离。
AI.conclusion: KL散度、发现潜力与参数估计之间的关系必须针对每种模型族和所考虑的检测统计量进行校准。
AI.translation: Kullback--Leibler（KL）散度是两个指定模型之间对数似然比的期望值，根据其中一个模型进行评估。它提供了模型可区分性的平均度量。我们研究了当一个模型代表零假设，而替代模型是一族由一个或多个连续参数表征的模型时，KL散度与发现潜力以及参数估计精度之间的联系。对于从多元高斯分布中提取的数据，我们在两种这样的假设下推导了对数似然比分布及其累积量。然后，我们在替代模型的参数空间中进行搜索，并使用峰值突出度（即似然剖面峰值高于其周围基线的程度）作为操作检测统计量。在从零模型中提取的模拟数据上重复此搜索，使我们能够校准指定假阳性率的突出度阈值。我们研究了一个玩具高斯模型以及三个宇宙学例子，涉及宇宙拓扑、张量-标量比和暗能量。在所有这些情况下，特定模型的可检测性不仅取决于KL散度，还取决于模型参数空间的大小、似然比分布以及模型与任何参数空间边界的距离。因此，KL散度、发现潜力与参数估计之间的关系必须针对每种模型族和所考虑的检测统计量进行校准。
AI.summary: 本研究超越了Kullback--Leibler (KL) 散度作为模型可区分性度量，探讨了其与发现潜力及参数估计精度之间的联系。作者推导了多元高斯数据下的对数似然比分布，并引入峰值突出度作为检测统计量。研究发现，模型的检测能力不仅受KL散度影响，还与参数空间大小、似然比分布及参数边界距离有关。因此，KL散度与发现潜力及参数估计的关系需根据具体模型和检测统计量进行校准。
AI.keywords: Kullback--Leibler散度, 似然比分布, 可检测性, 峰值突出度, 参数估计
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将似然比分布和峰值突出度引入作为可检测性度量，超越了传统KL散度的局限性。它强调了在模型检测和参数估计中，除了平均可区分性外，参数空间特性和似然比的详细分布也至关重要，这对于天体物理学等领域的新物理发现具有重要指导意义。

title: Frequentist and Bayesian population pharmacometrics: similarities, differences, and practical implications
summary: Although the frequentist versus Bayesian debate has a long-standing history, and both are well-established approaches for inference, they are often considered separately in pharmacometric literature, with their theoretical and practical differences receiving limited direct comparison. We address this gap by providing a conceptual background and comparative evaluation of frequentist and Bayesian methods for parameter inference in pharmacometrics. First, we highlight the theoretical and algorithmic differences between approaches within a general and pharmacometric context. We then apply both to classical compartmental pharmacokinetic models using simulated and real data; initially through evaluating four inference methods (two frequentist, two Bayesian) across a range of simulated data conditions, followed by investigating each inference approach in the practical setting. The simulation studies facilitate evaluation of the sensitivity of the methods to sample size, number of observations, residual noise and inter-individual variability, comparing the performance with respect to relative error, confidence/credible interval coverage and bias in the estimated variability. The real-world data analysis further highlights how each approach quantifies and presents uncertainty estimates by examining this for both the parameter estimates and system dynamics. By providing a theoretical and practical comparison that highlights the similarities and differences between approaches, this work aims to lower the barrier to understanding and implementing Bayesian and frequentist inference in pharmacometrics.

AI.title_translation: 频率论和贝叶斯群体药物计量学：异同及实际应用
AI.tldr: 本文比较了频率论和贝叶斯方法在群体药物计量学参数推断中的理论和实践差异，并使用模拟数据和真实数据进行了评估，旨在降低理解和应用这两种方法的障碍。
AI.motivation: 尽管频率论和贝叶斯方法在药物计量学文献中常被分开讨论，但它们之间的理论和实践差异缺乏直接比较。本文旨在填补这一空白，为药物计量学中参数推断的频率论和贝叶斯方法提供概念背景和比较评估。
AI.method: 首先，在一般和药物计量学背景下，强调了这两种方法之间的理论和算法差异。然后，将这两种方法应用于经典房室药代动力学模型，使用模拟数据和真实数据进行评估；通过评估四种推断方法（两种频率论，两种贝叶斯）在一系列模拟数据条件下的表现，比较了它们在相对误差、置信/可信区间覆盖率和估计变异偏差方面的性能。最后，通过检查参数估计和系统动力学的不确定性量化和呈现，进一步探讨了每种推断方法在实际设置中的应用。
AI.result: 模拟研究有助于评估方法对样本量、观测次数、残余噪声和个体间变异性的敏感性，并比较了这些方法在相对误差、置信/可信区间覆盖率和估计变异偏差方面的性能。真实世界数据分析进一步突出了每种方法如何通过检查参数估计和系统动力学来量化和呈现不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: 通过提供理论和实践的比较，突出这两种方法之间的异同，这项工作旨在降低在药物计量学中理解和实施贝叶斯和频率论推断的障碍。
AI.translation: 尽管频率论与贝叶斯之争历史悠久，且两者都是成熟的推断方法，但在药物计量学文献中，它们通常被分开考虑，其理论和实践差异很少得到直接比较。我们通过提供药物计量学中参数推断的频率论和贝叶斯方法的概念背景和比较评估来弥补这一空白。首先，我们在一般和药物计量学背景下强调了这两种方法之间的理论和算法差异。然后，我们使用模拟数据和真实数据将两者应用于经典的房室药代动力学模型；首先通过评估四种推断方法（两种频率论，两种贝叶斯）在一系列模拟数据条件下的表现，然后调查每种推断方法在实际设置中的应用。模拟研究有助于评估这些方法对样本量、观测次数、残余噪声和个体间变异性的敏感性，比较它们在相对误差、置信/可信区间覆盖率和估计变异偏差方面的性能。真实世界数据分析进一步突出了每种方法如何通过检查参数估计和系统动力学来量化和呈现不确定性估计。通过提供理论和实践的比较，突出这两种方法之间的异同，这项工作旨在降低在药物计量学中理解和实施贝叶斯和频率论推断的障碍。
AI.summary: 本文旨在弥合药物计量学中频率论和贝叶斯推断方法之间直接比较的空白。通过提供概念背景，并使用模拟和真实数据对经典房室药代动力学模型进行应用和评估，研究详细比较了这两种方法在理论、算法、性能（如误差、覆盖率、偏差）以及不确定性量化方面的异同。最终目标是促进对这两种强大推断方法的理解和实际应用。
AI.keywords: 频率论, 贝叶斯, 群体药物计量学, 参数推断, 比较评估
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过对频率论和贝叶斯方法在群体药物计量学中的直接比较，填补了一个重要的空白。其创新之处在于提供了全面的理论背景和实践评估，有助于研究人员更好地理解和选择适合的统计推断方法。这对于提高药物开发和个性化治疗中的模型准确性和可靠性具有重要意义。

title: Selective Inference for Clustering Under Unknown Covariance
summary: Unsupervised clustering is widely used to discover underlying group structure, after which researchers often seek to validate these groups via post-hoc hypothesis testing on the population means. However, using the same data both to form clusters and to test for a difference in means inflates the Type I error rate. Recent work in selective inference has proposed solutions when the underlying data are drawn from a multivariate Gaussian distribution with a known covariance matrix or an unknown isotropic covariance matrix. We propose a new selective test for the difference in means between two clusters that provably controls the Type I error rate under an arbitrary unknown covariance matrix. Our test statistic does not require estimating the feature covariance matrix; instead, it leverages a Monte Carlo sampling procedure over the set of orthogonal matrices. We show that this new selective test can be computed efficiently, and we derive closed-form solutions when clusters are formed using k-means or hierarchical clustering. In simulations, we demonstrate that our proposed p-value controls the selective Type I error rate and achieves substantial power, and we illustrate its application on gene expression and drug review data sets.

AI.title_translation: 未知协方差下聚类的选择性推断
AI.tldr: 针对未知协方差下的聚类结果，提出了一种新的选择性检验方法，用于控制检验两个聚类均值差异时的I类错误率，该方法无需估计协方差矩阵，并通过蒙特卡洛采样实现，在模拟和实际数据中表现良好。
AI.motivation: 无监督聚类后，研究人员常使用相同数据进行事后假设检验来验证聚类组，但这会增加I类错误率。现有选择性推断方法在底层数据协方差矩阵未知且任意时存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的选择性检验方法，用于检验两个聚类均值之间的差异，该方法在任意未知协方差矩阵下可证明地控制I类错误率。其检验统计量不依赖于特征协方差矩阵的估计，而是利用正交矩阵集上的蒙特卡洛采样过程。对于k均值或层次聚类形成的簇，该方法可推导出闭式解，并能高效计算。
AI.result: 模拟结果表明，所提出的p值能有效控制选择性I类错误率并实现显著的功效。该方法已成功应用于基因表达和药物评论数据集。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一种在任意未知协方差矩阵下，对聚类后均值差异进行选择性推断的新方法。该方法有效解决了现有技术在未知任意协方差情况下的局限性，并成功控制了I类错误率，同时保持了高功效。
AI.translation: 无监督聚类被广泛用于发现潜在的群体结构，之后研究人员通常通过对总体均值的事后假设检验来验证这些群体。然而，使用相同的数据来形成聚类和检验均值差异会增加I类错误率。最近的选择性推断工作在底层数据来自已知协方差矩阵或未知各向同性协方差矩阵的多元高斯分布时提出了解决方案。我们提出了一种新的选择性检验方法，用于检验两个聚类之间的均值差异，该方法在任意未知协方差矩阵下可证明地控制I类错误率。我们的检验统计量不需要估计特征协方差矩阵；相反，它利用正交矩阵集上的蒙特卡洛采样过程。我们表明这种新的选择性检验可以高效计算，并且在聚类使用k均值或层次聚类形成时，我们推导出了闭式解。在模拟中，我们证明了我们提出的p值控制了选择性I类错误率并实现了显著的功效，并且我们展示了它在基因表达和药物评论数据集上的应用。
AI.summary: 本文针对在未知任意协方差条件下，聚类后使用相同数据进行均值差异假设检验导致I类错误率膨胀的问题，提出了一种新的选择性检验方法。该方法能够在任意未知协方差矩阵下，有效控制两个聚类间均值差异检验的I类错误率，且无需估计协方差矩阵，通过蒙特卡洛采样实现。模拟和实际应用均验证了其有效性和高功效。
AI.keywords: 选择性推断, 聚类, 未知协方差, I类错误率, 假设检验
AI.comments: 这项工作在选择性推断领域迈出了重要一步，解决了在更复杂且实际的未知任意协方差矩阵情况下，聚类后推断的I类错误率控制问题。其无需估计协方差矩阵的创新方法，通过蒙特卡洛采样和正交矩阵的应用，显著提升了方法的实用性和计算效率。对于需要对聚类结果进行严格统计验证的研究人员来说，这是一个非常有价值的工具。

title: Hurricane recovery gaps lie in reconnection, not local restart
summary: Climate-intensified hurricanes disrupt urban mobility, yet whether recovery is equitable across the rural-urban gradient is unclear. Analyzing device-based mobility for Hurricanes Helene and Milton, we find local activity restarted within approximately 4.5 days in both storms, whereas reconnection to the outside world took 5 days in coastal-urban Florida but 11 in inland-rural Appalachia. The gap lies in external reconnection, not local restart, implying planners should target rural isolation.

AI.title_translation: 飓风恢复差距在于重新连接而非本地重启
AI.tldr: 飓风后，本地活动恢复迅速，但农村地区与外界的重新连接比城市地区慢得多，规划者应关注农村隔离问题。
AI.motivation: 气候强化的飓风扰乱城市交通，但农村和城市地区恢复是否公平尚不清楚。
AI.method: 分析了飓风Helene和Milton期间基于设备的移动数据。
AI.result: 本地活动在约4.5天内恢复；与外界的重新连接，沿海城市佛罗里达需要5天，内陆农村阿巴拉契亚需要11天。恢复差距在于外部重新连接，而非本地重启。
AI.conclusion: 规划者应针对农村地区的隔离问题。
AI.translation: 气候强化的飓风扰乱了城市交通，但恢复在城乡梯度上是否公平尚不清楚。通过分析飓风Helene和Milton期间基于设备的移动数据，我们发现两次风暴中本地活动在大约4.5天内重新启动，而与外界的重新连接在沿海城市佛罗里达需要5天，但在内陆农村阿巴拉契亚则需要11天。这种差距在于外部重新连接，而非本地重启，这意味着规划者应该针对农村地区的隔离问题。
AI.summary: 本研究分析了飓风Helene和Milton期间的移动数据，发现尽管飓风后本地活动恢复迅速，但农村地区与外界的重新连接时间显著长于城市地区。研究指出，飓风恢复的主要差距在于外部连接而非本地重启，并建议规划者应重点解决农村地区的隔离问题，以实现更公平的灾后恢复。
AI.keywords: 飓风恢复, 农村隔离, 移动性, 灾后规划, 重新连接
AI.comments: 这项研究通过对比城市和农村地区在飓风后的恢复情况，揭示了一个重要的恢复不平等现象。其创新之处在于明确指出恢复差距在于“重新连接”而非“本地重启”，这为灾后规划者提供了具体的干预方向，即关注农村地区的外部连接和隔离问题。这对于制定更具针对性和公平性的灾害恢复策略具有重要意义。

title: From Fourier Amplitudes to Persistence Images for Impact-Echo Defect Detection
summary: Impact-echo testing is a nondestructive testing method used to detect internal defects in concrete structures. However, boundary reflections, structured interference, and measurement noise can produce complex Fourier amplitude spectra, making defect classification difficult. We constructed a two-dimensional frequency--amplitude persistence image (FA-PI) from the Fourier amplitude spectrum. Using a fixed parameterization of exact multi-parameter persistent homology, each retained Fourier component is represented with frequency-bin location as one coordinate and amplitude as the other, and Gaussian kernels are then applied in this two-dimensional space. This construction has a direct analytical connection to the corresponding one-dimensional Gaussian-smoothed Fourier amplitude spectrum. FA-PI was evaluated on an experimental backfill-void dataset and a public bridge-deck impact-echo dataset, and compared with raw and Gaussian-smoothed Fourier amplitude spectra using a linear classifier with a Softmax output and identical signal-level data splits. The evaluation included original signals and signals corrupted by Gaussian noise, sinusoidal interference, or mixed noise, with matching noise types and signal-to-noise ratios during training, validation, and testing. Performance was assessed using accuracy and macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1-score. Across the two datasets, FA-PI consistently outperformed the raw and Gaussian-smoothed Fourier baselines in the noisy-condition summaries. These findings indicate that representing Fourier spectral components in a two-dimensional frequency--amplitude space can improve impact-echo defect classification beyond frequency-axis smoothing alone.

AI.title_translation: 从傅里叶幅度到持久性图像用于冲击回声缺陷检测
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为FA-PI的新型持久性图像方法，用于分析冲击回声测试中的傅里叶幅度谱，以提高混凝土结构内部缺陷的检测精度，尤其是在存在噪声干扰的情况下。
AI.motivation: 冲击回声测试在检测混凝土结构内部缺陷时，会受到边界反射、结构干扰和测量噪声的影响，导致傅里叶幅度谱复杂，难以对缺陷进行分类。
AI.method: 研究人员构建了一个二维频幅持久性图像（FA-PI），该图像由傅里叶幅度谱生成。利用精确的多参数持久性同调的固定参数化，将每个保留的傅里叶分量表示为频bin位置和幅度的二维坐标，并在该二维空间中应用高斯核。该方法在实验回填-空洞数据集和公开的桥面板冲击回声数据集上进行了评估，并与原始和高斯平滑的傅里叶幅度谱进行了比较，使用了具有Softmax输出的线性分类器和相同的信号级数据划分。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上，FA-PI在有噪声条件下始终优于原始和高斯平滑傅里叶基线，表明在二维频幅空间中表示傅里叶谱分量可以单独通过频轴平滑来提高冲击回声缺陷分类。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，将傅里叶谱分量表示在二维频幅空间中，可以提高冲击回声缺陷分类的性能，优于单独进行频轴平滑的方法。
AI.translation: 冲击回声测试是一种用于检测混凝土结构内部缺陷的无损检测方法。然而，边界反射、结构干扰和测量噪声会产生复杂的傅里叶幅度谱，从而难以进行缺陷分类。我们从傅里叶幅度谱构建了一个二维频幅持久性图像（FA-PI）。利用精确的多参数持久性同调的固定参数化，每个保留的傅里叶分量都用频bin位置作为一维坐标，幅度作为另一维坐标来表示，然后在该二维空间中应用高斯核。这种构造与相应的1D高斯平滑傅里叶幅度谱有直接的解析联系。FA-PI在实验回填-空洞数据集和公开的桥面板冲击回声数据集上进行了评估，并与原始和高斯平滑的傅里叶幅度谱进行了比较，使用了具有Softmax输出的线性分类器和相同的信号级数据划分。评估包括原始信号和被高斯噪声、正弦干扰或混合噪声破坏的信号，在训练、验证和测试过程中噪声类型和信噪比匹配。通过准确率和宏平均精度、召回率和F1分数评估性能。在两个数据集上，FA-PI在有噪声条件下的摘要中始终优于原始和高斯平滑的傅里叶基线。这些发现表明，在二维频幅空间中表示傅里叶谱分量可以提高冲击回声缺陷分类，优于单独进行频轴平滑。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新的傅里叶幅度谱分析方法——频幅持久性图像（FA-PI），用于改进冲击回声无损检测技术中混凝土结构内部缺陷的识别。该方法通过将傅里叶幅度谱映射到二维频幅空间并应用持久性同调技术，能够更有效地处理边界反射、结构干扰和测量噪声等复杂因素，从而提高缺陷分类的准确性。实验结果表明，FA-PI在各种噪声条件下均优于传统的傅里叶幅度谱分析方法。
AI.keywords: 冲击回声, 持久性图像, 傅里叶幅度谱, 缺陷检测, 噪声鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该研究提出的FA-PI方法在处理冲击回声测试中的噪声干扰方面显示出潜力，通过将傅里叶幅度谱映射到二维空间来提高缺陷检测的鲁棒性。然而，该方法在计算复杂度和实际工程应用中的可扩展性方面可能需要进一步的评估。

title: Decomposing Basketball Team Efficiency Using the Four Factors and Shapley Values
summary: Understanding how different aspects of basketball performance translate into overall team efficiency is central to analysis and strategy. This paper derives a mathematical expression that presents team offensive, defensive, and net ratings directly in terms of a team's four factors and shooting percentages. The resulting formula captures the full nonlinear structure of how shooting, turnovers, rebounding, and free throws jointly interact to determine team efficiency. Using this relationship, we introduce a Shapley value-based framework that decomposes team net rating into a sum of contributions from individual factors. This way, different facets of the game are made commensurable. The decomposition requires only standard box-score statistics and a single parameter $μ$, which represents the relative frequency of possession-ending free throws and remains constant for a given league and season. Consequently, it can be applied equally to individual games, full seasons, or league-wide trends. Moreover, it is immediately applicable to box-score statistics from any league or competition level by a simple change of reference point and the estimation of league- and season-specific parameter $μ$. Empirical analyses using NBA data from 2000 to 2025 validate the offensive ratings produced by the formula against exact play-by-play data, showing a nearly perfect correlation ($r = 0.999$) and a low Mean Absolute Error of $0.188$ points per 100 possessions. These analyses further illustrate how the proposed framework can be used to quantify how teams achieve success in different ways or to explain the results of individual games.

AI.title_translation: 使用四因素和Shapley值分解篮球团队效率
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的框架，使用四因素和Shapley值来分解篮球团队的净效率。该框架能够量化每个因素对整体效率的贡献，并且只需要标准的比赛数据。
AI.motivation: 理解不同篮球表现方面如何转化为整体团队效率，对于分析和制定策略至关重要。
AI.method: 该研究推导了一个数学表达式，将球队的进攻、防守和净评分直接表示为其四因素和投篮命中率的函数。在此基础上，引入了一个基于Shapley值的框架，将球队净评分分解为各个因素的贡献总和。
AI.result: 使用2000年至2025年NBA数据进行实证分析，验证了该公式产生的进攻评分与精确的逐次数据高度相关（r = 0.999），平均绝对误差（MAE）低至每100次拥有0.188分。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的基于Shapley值的分解框架能够量化不同因素对篮球团队效率的贡献，并且具有广泛的应用前景，可以用于分析比赛、赛季或整个联赛的趋势。
AI.translation: 理解不同方面的篮球表现如何转化为整体团队效率是分析和策略的核心。本研究推导了一个数学表达式，该表达式直接根据球队的四因素和投篮命中率来表示球队的进攻、防守和净评分。所得公式捕捉了投篮、失误、篮板和罚球如何共同作用以确定团队效率的完整非线性结构。利用这种关系，我们引入了一个基于Shapley值的框架，将团队净评分分解为各个因素贡献的总和。这样，游戏的各个方面都可以进行比较。该分解仅需要标准的比赛统计数据和一个参数μ，该参数代表每次拥有结束的罚球的相对频率，并且对于给定的联赛和赛季保持不变。因此，它可以同样应用于个人比赛、整个赛季或全联盟的趋势。此外，通过简单地更改参考点和估计特定于联赛和赛季的参数μ，它可以立即应用于任何联赛或竞争水平的比赛统计数据。使用2000年至2025年NBA数据的实证分析验证了该公式产生的进攻评分与精确的逐次数据，显示出近乎完美的[相关性]（r = 0.999）和每100次拥有0.188分的低平均绝对误差。这些分析还进一步说明了所提出的框架如何用于量化不同球队如何以不同方式取得成功，或解释个人比赛的结果。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的方法，利用四因素和Shapley值来分解篮球团队的净效率。通过数学推导，将团队效率与投篮、失误、篮板和罚球等关键因素联系起来，并引入Shapley值来量化每个因素的贡献。该方法仅需标准比赛数据，并经过NBA数据的验证，显示出高度准确性，为理解和量化团队成功因素提供了新途径。
AI.keywords: 四因素, Shapley值, 篮球效率, 净评分, 比赛统计
AI.comments: 该研究在篮球分析领域具有重要意义，它提供了一种严谨的数学方法来量化不同因素对团队效率的贡献。Shapley值的应用使得不同因素的比较更加公平和直观。然而，参数μ的准确估计可能依赖于数据质量和统计模型的选择，这可能是未来研究的一个方向。

title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Monte Carlo Simulations in A/B Testing
summary: This paper examines the use of Monte Carlo simulations to understand statistical concepts in A/B testing and Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs). We discuss the applicability of simulations in understanding false positive rates and estimating statistical power, implementing variance reduction techniques and examining the effects of early stopping. By comparing frequentist and Bayesian approaches, we illustrate how simulations can clarify the relationship between p-values and posterior probabilities, and the validity of such approximations. The study also references how Monte Carlo simulations can be used to understand network effects in RCTs on social networks. Our findings show that Monte Carlo simulations are an effective tool for experimenters to deepen their understanding and ensure their results are statistically valid and practically meaningful.

AI.title_translation: 蒙特卡洛模拟在A/B测试中超乎寻常的有效性
AI.tldr: 本文展示了蒙特卡洛模拟是理解A/B测试核心统计概念（如功效、假阳性、提前终止及贝叶斯对比）并确保实验有效性的强大工具。
AI.motivation: 为了帮助实验人员深入理解A/B测试和随机对照试验（RCT）中的核心统计概念，保障实验分析的统计有效性与实际业务意义。
AI.method: 运用蒙特卡洛模拟技术，对假阳性率、统计功效、方差缩减技术、提前终止效应进行模拟分析，对比频率学派与贝叶斯学派方法（如p值与后验概率的关系），并探讨其在社交网络RCT网络效应中的应用。
AI.result: 模拟成功阐明了假阳性率、统计功效、方差缩减及提前终止的影响，厘清了p值与后验概率之间的关系及其近似的有效性，并展示了模拟在理解社交网络RCT网络效应中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 蒙特卡洛模拟是实验人员深化统计学理解、确保实验结果兼具统计有效性与实际应用意义的极为有效的工具。
AI.translation: 本文研究了利用蒙特卡洛模拟来理解A/B测试和随机对照试验（RCT）中的统计学概念。我们讨论了模拟在理解假阳性率、估计统计功效、实施方差缩减技术以及检验提前终止效应方面的适用性。通过对比频率学派和贝叶斯学派的方法，我们阐明了模拟如何理清p值与后验概率之间的关系以及此类近似的有效性。本研究还提及了如何使用蒙特卡洛模拟来理解社交网络RCT中的网络效应。我们的研究结果表明，蒙特卡洛模拟是实验人员加深理解、确保其实验结果具备统计有效性和实际意义的有效工具。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了蒙特卡洛模拟在A/B测试与RCT中的应用，重点分析了其在理解统计功效、假阳性率、方差缩减、提前终止、频率学派与贝叶斯学派对比以及网络效应中的作用，证明模拟是保障实验统计严谨性与实践意义的高效工具。
AI.keywords: 蒙特卡洛模拟, A/B测试, 随机对照试验, 统计功效, 假阳性率
AI.comments: 本文突出了计算模拟方法在解决A/B测试复杂统计难题中的直观性与实用价值，有助于弥合复杂统计理论与工业界实际应用之间的鸿沟。局限性在于摘要偏向综合性方法与教学式概念探讨，未展现特定新型算法或具体的量化实验指标。

title: Fluoride Varnish in a Changing Preventive Environment: A Reanalysis and Temporal Meta-Regression of Historical and Contemporary Trials
summary: Historical trials of fluoride varnish reported large reductions in dental caries, but contemporary trials are often conducted against more intensive background prevention, so the incremental effect may be smaller. For positive continuous outcomes, we modeled the log ratio of treatment to control means and report the prevented fraction, $\mathrm{PF}=1-\exp(y)$. A nine-trial historical dataset was reanalyzed using REML with Hartung--Knapp inference, Bayesian hierarchical models, and sensitivity analyses; completeness was checked against all 13 Cochrane permanent-surface trials. Temporal change was examined in a 14-study dataset combining nine historical and five contemporary trials, with time specifications compared by AICc. The historical pooled PF was $39.7\%$ (95% CI $18.0\%$ to $55.6\%$), with a much wider 95% prediction interval ($-26.5\%$ to $71.2\%$). Expanding to 13 Cochrane trials barely changed the direct estimate ($0.439$ to $0.435$). The calendar coefficient was $0.0986$ log-ratio units per decade (95% CI $-0.0445$ to $0.2417$), with fitted PF declining from $34.8%$ in 2005 to $20.6%$ in 2025. A Bayesian model gave a similar slope (posterior median $0.091$; 95% CrI $-0.036$ to $0.231$). The intercept-only model had the lowest AICc, though the linear-time model was within two units. Adjusting for background prevention reduced the slope to $0.057$ per decade. The historical average effect is stable across modeling choices, whereas prediction for a new setting is much less certain. Contemporary evidence is compatible with attenuation of the incremental varnish effect but does not require a temporal moderator; the pattern is consistent with a changing treatment contrast rather than weakened biological action.

AI.title_translation: 不断变化的预防环境中的氟化物清漆：历史与当代试验的重新分析与时间元回归
AI.tldr: 随着背景预防的加强，氟化物清漆的增量效果在当代有所减弱，但这主要是由于预防环境的改变而非其本身效用的降低。
AI.motivation: 历史试验表明氟化物清漆可大幅减少龋齿，但在背景预防更为密集的当代试验中，其增量效果可能较小，需要重新分析和评估其随时间的变化趋势及原因。
AI.method: 使用REML与Hartung-Knapp推断、贝叶斯分层模型及敏感性分析对9项历史试验数据集进行重新分析，并通过包含14项研究的数据集利用AICc比较时间规范，进行时间元回归分析。
AI.result: 历史汇总预防分数为39.7%，但预测区间较宽。日历年系数显示，拟合的预防分数从2005年的34.8%下降到2025年的20.6%。调整背景预防后斜率减小。截距模型具有最低的AICc，但线性时间模型在其两个单位之内。
AI.conclusion: 当代证据与氟化物清漆增量效果的减弱相兼容，但这主要是由于背景预防的改变导致的处理对比度变化，而非生物学作用的削弱。
AI.translation: 氟化物清漆的历史试验报告了牙齿龋损的大幅减少，但当代试验通常在更密集的背景预防下进行，因此其增量效果可能会更小。对于积极的连续性结果，我们对处理均值与对照均值的对数比进行了建模，并报告了预防分数 $\mathrm{PF}=1-\exp(y)$。使用带有 Hartung-Knapp 推断的 REML、贝叶斯分层模型和敏感性分析对九项试验的历史数据集进行了重新分析；并针对所有 13 项 Cochrane 恒牙面试验检查了完整性。在一个结合了 9 项历史试验和 5 项当代试验的 14 项研究数据集中检查了时间变化，并通过 AICc 比较了时间规范。历史汇总 PF 为 $39.7\%$（95% CI 为 $18.0\%$ 至 $55.6\%$），但 95% 预测区间宽得多（$-26.5\%$ 至 $71.2\%$）。扩展到 13 项 Cochrane 试验几乎没有改变直接估计值（从 $0.439$ 到 $0.435$）。日历系数为每十年 $0.0986$ 个对数比单位（95% CI 为 $-0.0445$ 至 $0.2417$），拟合的 PF 从 2005 年的 $34.8\%$ 下降到 2025 年的 $20.6\%$。贝叶斯模型给出了相似的斜率（后验中位数为 $0.091$；95% CrI 为 $-0.036$ 至 $0.231$）。截距唯一模型具有最低的 AICc，尽管线性时间模型在两个单位以内。调整背景预防将斜率降低至每十年 $0.057$。历史平均效应在不同的建模选择中是稳定的，而对新环境的预测则更加不确定。当代证据与清漆增量效应的衰减相容，但不需要时间调节因子；这种模式与改变的处理对比度一致，而不是减弱的生物学作用。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对历史和当代氟化物清漆试验的重新分析与时间元回归，发现虽然当代氟化物清漆的增量效果有所衰减，但这一趋势可由背景预防的改变（处理对比度的改变）来解释，而非其生物学效用的削弱。
AI.keywords: Fluoride Varnish, Dental Caries, Meta-Regression, Background Prevention, Treatment Contrast
AI.comments: 该论文对氟化物清漆的历史和当代临床试验进行了重新分析和时间元回归，探讨了在现代更为密集的背景预防环境下，氟化物清漆增量效果的变化及其原因。分析严谨，结合了频率学派与贝叶斯方法，具有重要的临床和公共卫生指导意义。

title: Consistent and scalable detection and comparison of spatial patterns
comments: Expanded revision: adds spatial pattern comparison, differential-frequency methods and applications to disease and embryogenesis; updated title, author list and supplementary material. Total 90 pages, including 5 main figures, 5 Extended Data figures, 18 supplementary figures, and 5 supplementary notes
summary: Spatial omics maps molecular features within tissues to study their organization across biological contexts, including disease and development. Interpreting these maps requires distinguishing patterns from noise and comparing them across samples. Yet pattern detection remains unresolved, and comparisons based on regional summaries lose spatial detail. Here we show that spatial frequency provides a common basis for detecting and comparing these patterns. Our framework, SONIC, unifies spatial detection tests through a common quadratic form, establishes conditions for reliable detection and explains how kernel choice determines sensitivity to different spatial patterns. It also separates changes in spatial organization from changes in overall abundance without aligning tissues. Fast, memory-efficient algorithms make detection and comparison practical across large datasets. Applying SONIC, we identify plaque-associated responses in Alzheimer's disease and differences in the spatial expression of blood-clotting genes between glioma subtypes. We further construct a gene-centric atlas that traces changes in spatial expression through mouse and human embryogenesis and supports retrieval of related patterns across species. These results extend spatial analysis from identifying individual patterns to following their changes across anatomically different tissues. Together, SONIC establishes a shared language for integrating molecular maps across studies and technologies.

AI.title_translation: 空间模式的一致且可扩展的检测与比较
AI.tldr: 论文提出了SONIC框架，利用空间频率实现空间组学中分子模式的一致性检测与高效跨样本比较。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间组学模式检测问题尚未完全解决，而基于区域汇总的比较方法会丢失空间细节，缺乏一个能够在一系列生物学背景、样本和技术中一致且可扩展地检测和比较空间模式的框架。
AI.method: 提出了名为SONIC的框架，利用空间频率作为公共基础，通过通用二次型统一空间检测检验，建立可靠检测条件，并开发了快速、内存高效的算法。
AI.result: 应用SONIC成功识别了阿尔茨海默病中与斑块相关的反应、胶质瘤亚型间凝血基因空间表达的差异，并构建了追踪小鼠和人类胚胎发生过程中空间表达变化的基因中心图谱。
AI.conclusion: SONIC为空间组学中的模式检测和比较提供了一个统一、可扩展且基于数学理论支撑的框架，极大地扩展了空间分析在不同组织和生物学背景下的应用潜力。
AI.translation: 空间组学绘制了组织内的分子特征图谱，以研究它们在疾病和发育等生物学背景下的组织结构。解释这些图谱需要区分噪声模式并在样本之间进行比较。然而，模式检测仍未完全解决，基于区域汇总的比较则会丢失空间细节。在此，我们表明空间频率为检测和比较这些模式提供了共同的基础。我们的框架SONIC通过一个通用的二次型统一了空间检测检验，建立了可靠检测的条件，并解释了核的选择如何决定对不同空间模式的敏感性。它还可以在不对齐组织的情况下，将空间组织的变化与整体丰度的变化区分开来。快速、内存高效的算法使得跨大型数据集的检测和比较变得切实可行。应用SONIC，我们识别了阿尔茨海默病中与斑块相关的反应以及胶质瘤亚型之间凝血基因空间表达的差异。我们进一步构建了一个基因中心图谱，追踪了小鼠和人类胚胎发生过程中空间表达的变化，并支持跨物种相关模式的检索。这些结果将空间分析从识别个体模式扩展到追踪它们在解剖学不同组织中的变化。总之，SONIC为跨研究和技术整合分子图谱建立了一种共同语言。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了SONIC，一个基于空间频率的统一且可扩展的计算框架，用于空间组学中的模式检测和跨样本比较，通过高效的算法揭示了不同组织和生物学背景下分子特征的空间组织变化。
AI.keywords: 空间组学, 空间频率, 模式检测, 算法框架, 阿尔茨海默病
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于空间频率的统一框架SONIC，不仅解决了空间组学中模式检测与跨样本比较的难题，还兼具高效的可扩展性，为跨技术和跨物种的空间组学数据整合奠定了基础。

title: Inference for Heterogeneous Graphical Models using Doubly High-Dimensional Linear-Mixed Models
summary: Inferring the structure of population-level functional connectivity networks from multi-subject functional magnetic resonance imaging data is essential for understanding the connectivity patterns underlying cognitive and behavioral functions. Graphical models provide a formal statistical framework for inferring the graph structure. However, the multi-level nature of functional magnetic resonance imaging data---where each level corresponds, for instance, to a subject---compromises the inferential validity of most existing methods. In this paper, we develop a valid inference framework for high-dimensional graphical models that accounts for cross-level heterogeneity. We introduce a neighborhood-based method to learn the graph structure and reframe the problem as that of inferring fixed effect parameters in a doubly high-dimensional linear mixed model. We then propose a LASSO-based estimator and a de-biased LASSO-based inference framework for these fixed effect parameters. We evaluate the performance of the proposed framework using benchmark simulation studies and apply it to descriptively compare graph structures between the functional connectivity networks of two predefined groups of subjects from the Human Connectome Project.

AI.title_translation: 使用双高维线性混合模型推断异构图模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的高维图模型推断框架，用于处理多主体fMRI数据中的跨层异质性，通过将问题重构为双高维线性混合模型中的固定效应参数推断，并利用基于LASSO的方法进行估计和推断。
AI.motivation: 从多主体功能磁共振成像（fMRI）数据中推断群体水平的功能连接网络对于理解认知和行为功能背后的连接模式至关重要。然而，fMRI数据的多层性质（例如，每个层对应一个主体）损害了大多数现有方法的推断有效性，尤其是在存在跨层异质性时。

AI.result: 提出的框架通过基准模拟研究进行了性能评估。该框架被应用于描述性比较人类连接组项目中两个预定义受试者组的功能连接网络的图结构。

title: Direction Preferring Confidence Intervals
summary:
Confidence intervals (CIs) are fundamental in statistical analysis, providing interval estimates for unknown parameters. We introduce direction-preferring CIs that prioritize inference for parameters with a specific sign (e.g., positive sign). Unlike previous methods of constructing CIs, our intervals are based on the inversion of acceptance regions that differ for positive and negative parameters, to enhance the probability of determining the sign in the prespecified preferred direction while maintaining standard coverage. We apply our suggestion in the typical context that multiple parameters are considered, but only some of the constructed CIs are of interest, e.g.,
  when CIs are reported only for the subset of parameters that are found to differ significantly from zero.
  This leads us to suggest direction-preferring CIs with false coverage rate (FCR) control, as well as conditional direction-preferring CIs that adjust for selection by conditioning on the selection event. We compare the two selection adjustment methods in theory and using numerical experiments. The procedures we develop are useful for inference on secondary outcomes in medical applications, a setting we highlight through two motivating examples.

AI.title_translation: 偏好特定方向的置信区间
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种优先推断特定符号参数的方向偏好置信区间，并解决了多重参数筛选中的选择性偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 在同时考虑多个参数但仅对部分参数（如显著不为零的参数子集）感兴趣的统计分析中，传统置信区间未考虑特定方向的推断需求以及选择性偏差，因此需要一种能提高特定方向符号确定概率并控制误差的方法。
AI.method: 通过对正参数和负参数采用不同的接受域进行反演，构建方向偏好置信区间，并提出基于假覆盖率（FCR）控制和条件选择事件的两种选择调整方法。
AI.result: 理论与数值实验结果表明，所提出的方向偏好置信区间及其选择调整方法能够有效提高在预设偏好方向上确定参数符号的概率，同时满足覆盖率控制要求，特别适用于医学等领域的次要结局推断。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功开发了方向偏好置信区间及其两种选择调整方法（FCR控制和条件调整），并通过理论与数值实验证明了其在解决多重比较和选择性偏差方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 置信区间（CIs）是统计分析的基础，为未知参数提供区间估计。我们引入了偏好特定方向的置信区间，该区间优先对具有特定符号（例如正号）的参数进行推断。与以往构建置信区间的方法不同，我们的区间基于正参数和负参数不同的接受域的反演，以在保持标准覆盖率的同时，提高在预设偏好方向上确定符号的概率。我们将该方法应用于考虑多个参数但仅对部分构建的置信区间感兴趣的典型场景，例如仅报告与零有显著差异的参数子集对应的置信区间。这促使我们提出了具有假覆盖率（FCR）控制的方向偏好置信区间，以及通过对选择事件进行条件化来调整选择的条件方向偏好置信区间。我们在理论上和通过数值实验对这两种选择调整方法进行了比较。我们开发的过程对于医学应用中的次要结局推断非常有用，我们通过两个激励性例子强调了这一设置。
AI.summary: 论文引入了方向偏好置信区间，旨在优先对具有特定符号的参数进行推断。通过反演不同的接受域，该方法在保持标准覆盖率的同时提高了确定偏好方向符号的概率，并针对选择性偏差提出了假覆盖率控制和条件调整两种方法，在医学次要结局分析中具有重要应用。
AI.keywords: 置信区间, 方向偏好, 选择性推断, 假覆盖率控制, 次要结局
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的方向偏好置信区间（Direction-Preferring CIs），通过不对称的接受域反演来优先推断具有特定符号的参数，同时保持标准的覆盖率。这在多重检验和选择性推断（如医学应用中的次要结局分析）中具有很高的实用价值。

title: Watermarking Continuous Tabular Data Generation
comments: A revised version of this manuscript has been accepted for publication in the Journal of the American Statistical Association
summary: In this paper, we introduce a simple yet effective tabular data watermarking mechanism with statistical guarantees. We show theoretically that the proposed watermark can be effectively detected, while faithfully preserving the data fidelity, and also demonstrates appealing robustness against additive noise attack. The general idea is to achieve the watermarking through a strategic embedding based on simple data binning. Specifically, it divides the feature's value range into finely segmented intervals and embeds watermarks into selected ``green list" intervals. To detect the watermarks, we develop a principled statistical hypothesis-testing framework with minimal assumptions: it remains valid as long as the underlying data distribution has a continuous density function. The watermarking efficacy is demonstrated through rigorous theoretical analysis and empirical validation, highlighting its utility in enhancing the security of synthetic and real-world datasets.
comment: A revised version of this manuscript has been accepted for publication in the Journal of the American Statistical Association

AI.title_translation: 连续表格数据生成的水印
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单有效的表格数据水印机制，具有统计学保证，能够有效检测并保持数据保真度，同时对加性噪声攻击具有鲁棒性。其通过基于数据分箱的策略性嵌入实现，并开发了基于假设检验的检测框架。
AI.motivation: 增强合成和真实世界数据集的安全性。
AI.method: 通过简单的数据分箱实现水印嵌入，将特征值范围划分为细分区间，并将水印嵌入到选定的“绿名单”区间。水印检测通过一个基于统计假设检验的框架进行，该框架对底层数据分布的连续密度函数有效。
AI.result: 所提出的水印可以被有效检测，同时忠实地保持数据保真度，并对加性噪声攻击表现出吸引人的鲁棒性。水印的有效性通过严格的理论分析和实证验证得到证实。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的表格数据水印机制在理论分析和实证验证中均表现出有效性，可用于增强合成和真实世界数据集的安全性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们介绍了一种简单而有效的表格数据水印机制，具有统计学保证。我们从理论上证明，所提出的水印可以被有效检测，同时忠实地保持数据保真度，并且对加性噪声攻击表现出吸引人的鲁棒性。其基本思想是通过基于简单数据分箱的策略性嵌入来实现水印。具体来说，它将特征的值范围划分为细分的区间，并将水印嵌入到选定的“绿名单”区间。为了检测水印，我们开发了一个原则性的统计假设检验框架，该框架具有最小的假设：只要底层数据分布具有连续密度函数，它就保持有效。水印的有效性通过严格的理论分析和实证验证得到证实，突出了其在增强合成和真实世界数据集安全性方面的实用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种具有统计学保证的表格数据水印机制，通过数据分箱策略性地将水印嵌入到特定数据区间。理论分析和实证验证表明，该方法能够有效检测水印，同时保持数据保真度，并对加性噪声攻击具有鲁棒性，有助于提升合成及真实数据集的安全性。
AI.keywords: 表格数据水印, 连续数据, 数据分箱, 统计假设检验, 数据安全

title: A longitudinal Bayesian framework for estimating causal dose-response relationships
summary: Existing causal methods for time-varying exposure and time-varying confounding focus on estimating the average causal effect of a time-varying binary treatment on an end-of-study outcome, offering limited tools for characterizing marginal causal dose-response relationships under continuous exposures. We propose a scalable, nonparametric Bayesian framework for estimating marginal longitudinal causal dose-response functions with repeated outcome measurements. Our approach targets the average potential outcome at any fixed dose level and accommodates time-varying confounding through the generalized propensity score. The proposed approach embeds a Dirichlet process specification within a generalized estimating equations structure, capturing temporal correlation while making minimal assumptions about the functional form of the continuous exposure. We apply the proposed methods to monthly metro ridership and COVID-19 case data from major international cities, identifying causal relationships and the dose-response patterns between higher ridership and increased case counts.

title: Learning Smooth Populations of Parameters with Trial Heterogeneity
summary: We consider the classical problem of estimating the mixing distribution of binomial mixtures, but under trial heterogeneity and smoothness. This problem has been studied extensively when the trial parameter is homogeneous, but not under the more general scenario of heterogeneous trials, and only within a low smoothness regime, where the resulting rates are slow. Under the assumption that the density is s-smooth, we derive fast error rates for the kernel density estimator under trial heterogeneity that depend on the harmonic mean of the trials. Importantly, even when reduced to the homogeneous case, our result improves on the state-of-the-art rate of Ye and Bickel (2021). We also study nonparametric estimation of the difference between two densities, which can be smoother than the individual densities, in both i.i.d. and binomial-mixture settings. Our work is motivated by an application in criminal justice: comparing conviction rates of indigent representation in Pennsylvania. We find that the estimated conviction rates for appointed counsel (court-appointed private attorneys) are generally higher than those for public defenders, potentially due to a confounding factor: appointed counsel are more likely to take on severe cases.

title: Detecting Impact of the Great Recession on Macroeconomic Indicators
summary: We study structural changes in multivariate time series by estimating and comparing stationary graphs of macroeconomic time series before and after an economic crisis, such as the Great Recession. Building on a latent time series framework called Orthogonally-rotated Univariate Time-series (OUT), we propose a shared-parameter framework-the spOUT autoregressive model (spOUTAR)-that jointly models two related multivariate time series and enables coherent Bayesian estimation of their corresponding stationary precision matrices. This framework provides a principled mechanism for detecting and quantifying which conditional relationships among the variables changed or formed following the crisis. Specifically, we study the impact of the Great Recession (December 2007-June 2009) that substantially disrupted global and national economies, prompting long-lasting shifts in macroeconomic indicators and their interrelationships. While many studies document its economic consequences, less is known about how the underlying conditional dependency structure among economic variables changed as economies moved from pre-crisis stability through the shock and back to normalcy. Using the proposed approach to analyze U.S. and OECD macroeconomic data, we demonstrate that spOUTAR effectively captures recession-induced changes in stationary graphical structure, offering a flexible and interpretable tool for studying structural shifts in economic systems.

title: Prior Smoothing for Multivariate Disease Mapping Models
summary: To date, we have seen the emergence of a large literature on multivariate disease mapping. That is, incidence of (or mortality from) multiple diseases is recorded at the scale of areal units where incidence (mortality) across the diseases is expected to manifest dependence. The modeling involves a hierarchical structure: a Poisson model for disease counts (conditioning on the rates) at the first stage, and a specification of a function of the rates using spatial random effects at the second stage. These random effects are specified as a prior and introduce spatial smoothing to the rate (or risk) estimates. What we see in the literature is the amount of smoothing induced under a given prior across areal units compared with the observed/empirical risks. Our contribution here extends previous research on smoothing in univariate areal data models. Specifically, for three different choices of multivariate prior, we investigate both within prior smoothing according to hyperparameters and across prior smoothing. Its benefit to the user is to illuminate the expected nature of departure from perfect fit associated with these priors, providing measures of their smoothing behavior not captured by conventional measures of predictive performance. We propose both theoretical and empirical metrics for our investigation and illustrate with both simulated and real data.

title: Estimating marginal association between paired outcomes in clustered data with an application to analyzing caries and periodontal disease data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
comments: 19 pages, 4 tables, 5 figures in Main.tex 11 pages, 6 tables in Supplementary.tex
summary: The within-cluster subgroup composition of units can inform on the marginal distribution of those units outcomes, denoted informative subgroup size (ISS). Moreover, within-cluster subgroup composition of paired outcomes can allow one outcome to inform upon the marginal distribution of the other. If this type of ISS ignored, it can bias marginal association estimates by allowing subgroup composition to influence how clusters contribute to the analysis. We develop two weighting approaches for estimating marginal association between paired outcomes in this setting. The weights are derived using within-cluster resampling arguments and extend conventional cluster weighting to paired response subgroups. We adapt an existing test of marginal dependence to assess ISS by examining this subgroup structure in both directions. In simulated data exhibiting this bidirectional ISS, pair-based weighting reduced bias when association was primarily carried through the paired observations. These weights also allow scientifically or clinically meaningful dichotomizations to enter directly into the weighting scheme, with the choice of subgroup definition further improving estimation in several simulated settings. Application to NHANES oral-health data showed strong evidence of ISS for filled-surface outcomes across subgroups defined by clinical attachment loss and pocket depth, with the corresponding periodontal--caries associations generally small and positive. These methods provide a practical approach for estimating marginal association when paired subgroup composition is informative.
